Title: Analyst
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential Team Placements Include


Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.


About The Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do


Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.
Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.
Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.
Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.
AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.


What We Look For


1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.
Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.
Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.


Pay Grade - I

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

  • Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
  • Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
  • Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
  • Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
  • Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
  • International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.

About The Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do

  • Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.
  • Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.
  • Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.
  • Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.
  • AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.

What We Look For

  • 1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.
  • Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
  • Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.
  • Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.
  • Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.

Pay Grade - I

Equity Grade - 5

Title: Inventory Planning Data Analyst
Description:
About the Inventory Planning Data Analyst Position

The Inventory Planning Data Analyst is responsible for the data, analytics, and forecasting that drive Washington Shoe Company’s inventory decisions. The analyst owns replenishment planning for Amazon and our other replenishment customers, executes seasonal buys, and manages the company’s item performance metric (the M Score) to keep top-selling items in stock and to identify underperforming items for exit. The role builds and maintains the data foundation for planning using our ERP (Ai2000/Oracle), SQL, Excel, and Power BI, and builds a machine learning forecasting tool and AI-assisted planning tools using Claude. The company operates an on-premises NVIDIA DGX Spark, giving the analyst dedicated local GPU compute to train and run forecasting models and AI agents against company data. The analyst reports to the Director of Production Operations and works closely with Sales, eCommerce, Sourcing, and Logistics.




The company’s inventory targets for this position are an 80% fill rate and an inventory turn of 4 on an annualized basis.




Role and Responsibilities




Data, Analytics & AI

•     Build and maintain the data foundation for inventory planning: pull, join, and validate data from the ERP (Ai2000/Oracle), customer portals, and SharePoint using SQL, Excel, and Power BI.

•     Build a machine learning forecasting tool for replenishment items; measure forecast accuracy against actuals and improve the model over time.

•     Design and build an AI planning agent using Claude to automate routine planning work, including weekly data pulls, exception flagging, draft purchase order recommendations, and customer-ready reporting.

•     Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and standard reports covering fill rate, in-stock rate, weeks of supply, inventory turns, aged inventory, and forecast accuracy.

•     Prepare clear, concise analysis and recommendations for Sales, eCommerce, and leadership; present findings in a form that supports decisions.

•     Document data sources, models, and planning processes so they are repeatable and can be maintained by others.




Replenishment and Seasonal Planning

•     Own replenishment planning for Amazon and our other replenishment customers: maintain item- and size-level forecasts, set target weeks of supply and safety stock, and place timely purchase orders to achieve the company’s 80% fill rate target without overstocking.

•     Plan seasonal buys by season and customer, aligning quantities and size curves to customer projections and historical sell-through, and working backward from vendor lead times and required in-stock dates.

•     Review demand signals weekly, including customer point-of-sale data, Amazon Vendor Central, open orders, and on-hand inventory, and act on stockouts, overstocks, and forecast misses.

•     Coordinate with Sourcing, Production, and Logistics on lead times, capacity, and delivery timing.




M Score and Assortment Management

•     Maintain and review the M Score, the company’s item performance metric, and use it to rank items for backfill, hold, or exit.

•     Proactively reorder high-performing items so they remain in stock throughout their selling window.

•     Identify underperforming items and recommend exit strategies (markdown, channel shift, or discontinuation) to the Sales and eCommerce teams, supported by data.

•     Track the results of backfill and exit decisions and incorporate findings into the next planning cycle.

Other Duties

•     Support Operations and Production with ad-hoc analysis and reporting.

•     Reconcile customer-specific inventory positions as needed.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

•     Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

•     2+ years of experience in inventory planning, demand planning, replenishment, buying, or business/data analytics, preferably in consumer products, footwear, apparel, or retail.

•     Working proficiency in SQL, including joins and aggregations against a relational database.

•     Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and Power Query.

•     Experience building reports or dashboards in Power BI or a comparable BI tool.

•     Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude in day-to-day analytical work, and a demonstrated interest in applying AI to automate and improve processes.

•     Strong attention to detail and the ability to validate data and explain the reasoning behind a recommendation.

•     Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to present data clearly to sales, eCommerce, and leadership audiences.

•     Ability to work independently, prioritize, and manage multiple deadlines in a small team.




Preferred Skills

•     Experience with Python or R for data analysis or forecasting.

•     Exposure to forecasting methods or machine learning models.

•     Experience with Amazon Vendor Central or other retailer replenishment portals.

•     Experience with enterprise ERP systems (Oracle preferred).

•     APICS CPIM or CSCP certification.




Work Environment and Physical Requirements

This position works in an office setting with occasional visits to the warehouse. Standard business hours, with flexibility during peak seasonal planning periods.




Top Perks

•     Medical, dental, vision

•     401(k) plus company match

•     Paid time off and paid holidays

•     Employee purchase credit and wholesale pricing on our products

•     Paid volunteer hours

•     Open work environment with casual dress code and flexible schedule

•     Flat organization with high exposure to the leadership team




Compensation and Benefits

Job Type: Full-time, exempt

Salary: $75,000 – $100,000 per year, depending on experience

Location: Renton, WA

Reports To: Director of Production Operations




Benefits:

•     Medical and Dental Insurance: Eligible the first of the month after 60 days of employment.

•     401(k): Eligible the first of the month after 6 months of employment. The company matches 100% of the employee’s first 3% contribution and 50% of the next 2%.

•     PTO and the normal annual holidays. Wellness days are available after 90 days of employment; additional days accrue annually for each year of service.

•     Employee Purchase Program: $100 annual allowance for wholesale purchases, with products available at wholesale cost once the allowance is used.

Description:
Job Description

UW Medicine Department of Analytics for Quality, Population Health and Value has an outstanding opportunity for a Business Systems Analyst.

WORK SCHEDULE


HYBRID opportunity (one day onsite/week)
100% FTE
Monday – Friday; Core hours are 8:00AM – 5:00PM (PST)


Department Description

The UW Medicine Department of Analytics for Quality, Population Health and Value supports a wide range of data collection, analysis, and reporting activities across UW Medicine. UW Medicine’s Chief Quality Office, Department of Analytics for Quality, Population Health and Value is a shared services organization that supports all of UW Medicine. Value Based Analytics is responsible for providing analytics support in value-based contracting by facilitating data workflows and creating tools and reporting that facilitate and support strategic decision making and internal goal setting and tracking.

This position reports to the UW Medicine Director of Analytics for Quality, Population Health, and Value and plays an integral role in data management, reporting process improvement, and operational support. The position works closely across UW Medicine’s healthcare system, collaborating with population health affiliated departments, contracting, IT Services and Epic departments, UW Medicine stakeholders, and external organizations.

POSITION HIGHLIGHTS


15 days of vacation your first year – Also, 12 days of sick time, 1 personal holiday, and 11 paid holidays each year
100% matching, 100% immediately vesting 403(b)


Primary Job Responsibilities


Provides data programming and analytics in support of physician and system leadership, encompassing quality, financial, and utilization reporting, population health tools, value measurement, and ad hoc analyses
Apply expert-level SQL database development skills, including SSRS/SSIS and other Microsoft platform technologies, to deliver high-quality reporting solutions and dashboards
Designs, codes, tests, and maintains BI/reporting and analytics objects using industry best practices
Develops, cleanses, prepares, validates, and distributes reports and files from multiple data sources

Title: Go-To-Market Analyst
Description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive OKR and revenue dashboards across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or Finance
3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience querying large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery); comfort navigating messy, high-volume data is essential
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools


Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance


Emotional Health


Paid sabbatical program after four years
Paid family and paternity leave
Annual educational stipend
Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement
CFA exam stipend
Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program
Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days


Social Health


Matching gifts program
Employee resource groups
Subsidized emergency childcare
Dependent Care FSA
Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events


Financial Health


401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program
Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000
Target annual bonus percentage: 10%


Working Conditions

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

We are excited to get to know you and your background. Concerned that you might not meet every requirement? We encourage you to still apply as you might be the right candidate for the role or other roles at PitchBook.

Title: Analytics Lead, Full Stack (Strategic Revenue Insights)
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Revenue Team

The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.

About The Role

We’re looking for intelligent, driven professionals to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team is responsible for comprehensive analyses, reporting, and data solutions to support and grow our Revenue segments.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem solving skills, the ability to craft comprehensive narratives for both internal and external stakeholders, and produce tools and solutions to scale data usage with Revenue. In addition to analytical rigor, the ideal candidate has strong interpersonal skills to work proactively within the organization and with clients to drive forward recommendations.

What You’ll Do

Optimize decisions and execution with analyses, and communicate to internal and external partners


Be a strategic partner with our Client Success and Marketplace Teams as the data SME for respective Revenue segments and merchants for their point-of-sale and Marketplace business
Create business cases, insights, and dashboards as well as handle experiments to engage Affirm’s external merchant base; demonstrating Affirm’s value proposition and product performance
Create internal analyses to assess Revenue performance, drive recommendations, and inform critical decisions; using insights to serve segment strategy and execution


Scale impact


Standardize common use cases, provide the analytics infrastructure, and automate analyses and dashboards to scale decisions and execution within Revenue and with top external merchants


Own comprehensive analytics solution


Define KPIs, performance benchmarks, and methodologies, including identifying and working with unstructured and structured data sources (in-house and third-party) to enable solutions and generate actionable insights
Provide project and analytics guidance to a cross-functional team, acting as the analytics point of contact
Propose, monitor, and contextualize experiment design and execution to drive optimizations of Affirm’s GTM efforts, empirically quantify the value of Affirm to our prospective merchants, and upsell enhanced offers to existing merchants


What We Look For


5+ years of experience in an analytically-driven role (consulting, finance, analytics, etc.)
Strong working knowledge of SQL, data visualization tools (e.g. Sigma, Looker, Tableau). Understanding or a demonstrated aptitude to learn Python is a plus
Demonstrated aptitude in leveraging AI tools for analytics (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)
Exceptional problem-solving skills, including ability to operate in ambiguity and establishing analytical frameworks to apply to business problems
Ability to create structure in ambiguous situations, such as aligning stakeholders, or choosing the most impactful data to drive decisions
Ability to communicate effectively, and craft compelling narratives to influence business and technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization, internally and externally
Strong organization and execution skills, including ability to operate independently and drive multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously to drive business goals
Prior track record in building successful cross-functional relationships with partners internally and externally
Self-starter and a track record of successfully driving projects from end to end (from building strategy to implementation)
Passion and drive to disrupt both the retail and lending industry for the better
Enough laziness to find a faster way to do your least favorite tasks
Humility and a team player - you go out of your way to help teammates


Nice to Have


Knowledge of the FinTech or Payments industry
Prior experience performing data analytics for marketplace platforms
Demonstrated aptitude in AI tools for analytics (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)


Pay Grade - M

Equity Grade - 8

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $185,000 - $245,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $164,000 - $224,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Title: Retail Business Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

At Brooks, we believe movement is the key to feeling more alive. That’s why we’re driven to create gear and experiences that take people to the place that makes them feel more alive — whether it’s a headspace, a feeling, or a finish line.

Everyone who works at Brooks is propelled by a company culture that sparks excitement, fuels collaboration, inspires creativity, and ignites innovation.

Our brand values help bond us together and drive our success:


Runner First
We act in the best interest of the runner
Word is Bond
We do what we say we’ll do
Champion Heart
We give our all in everything we do
There is no “I” in Run
We stay generous with our humanity
Keep Moving
We find ways to move every day, because joy is kinetic!

We welcome everyone from every walk of life looking to inspire others through the power of movement - because we’re all moving towards something. Let’s run there.

Your Job: As the Retail Business Analyst at Brooks, you will play a critical role in driving performance across Brooks’ branded retail fleet by delivering data-driven insights that inform decision-making across store operations, merchandising, and customer experience. You will support Retail Operations, Store Leadership, and crossfunctional partners by analyzing business performance across multiple locations, identifying opportunities, and translating insights into actionable recommendations that improve sales, inventory productivity, and operational effectiveness. You have a combined passion for retail, analytics, and the Brooks brand, with a strong ability to influence through data storytelling and business partnership.

Your Responsibilities

Business Performance & Reporting


Analyze store and fleet-level performance across key KPIs including sales, conversion, traffic, average transaction value (ATV), and units per transaction (UPT).
Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports that provide visibility into daily, weekly, and seasonal performance.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities across stores, regions, and product categories.
Partner with Retail leadership to deliver clear, actionable insights that drive decision-making.


Merchandising & Inventory Insights


Evaluate product performance across footwear, apparel, and accessories to inform assortment and allocation decisions.
Analyze size curves, sell-through, and inventory levels to recommend replenishment and depth strategies.
Support inventory optimization efforts to minimize markdown risk and maximize in-stock availability.
Partner with Merchandising and Planning teams on seasonal strategies and performance reviews.


Store Operations & Productivity


Provide analytics that support labor optimization, store productivity, and operational efficiency.
Analyze store processes and customer flow to identify opportunities to enhance the in-store experience.
Support new store openings with forecasting, benchmarking, and performance tracking.
Identify and scale best practices across the retail fleet.


Customer & Omnichannel Insights


Analyze customer behavior and purchase patterns across in-store and digital touchpoints.
Support initiatives that connect retail and eCommerce experiences (e.g., omnichannel capabilities).
Partner with Marketing and CRM teams to evaluate campaign performance and customer engagement in retail.
Identify opportunities to improve customer retention and lifetime value.


Strategic Projects & Cross-Functional Partnership


Support strategic initiatives including retail expansion, store format evolution, and performance segmentation.
Conduct ad hoc analysis for leadership to support business priorities and decision-making.
Partner cross-functionally with Retail, Finance, Marketing, Planning, and Product teams to ensure alignment.
Contribute to annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field; equivalent combination of education and years of experience can be considered in lieu of degree(s)
5+ years of experience in retail analytics, business analysis, or a related field, preferably at a specialty retail, athletic/footwear, or branded retail environment
Strong proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools (i.e., Power BI, Tableau, or similar); experience with SQL or data query tools a plus
Experience working with POS systems, traffic data, and inventory management platforms
Familiarity with omnichannel retail models
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, demonstrating effective listening through concise, clear verbal and written communication
Excellent interpersonal skills that inspire and build trust resulting in effective working relationships across the company
Keen attention to detail in planning, organization, and execution of tasks, while still seeing the big picture and understanding how all the pieces fit together and affect one another
Ability to anticipate how a decision made can affect our customers, our partners, our products, or other departments’ operations and/or morale; “connecting the dots”
Demonstration of innovation and initiative – always looking at improving our products and processes while also displaying a willingness to dive into the details and help wherever necessary
Passionate participation in Brooks’ sports activities a plus, overridden by the ability to understand and empathize with the runner to develop loyal, engaging relationships with our customers and the Brooks community
Embraces and lives the Brooks values!


Compensation: The pay range for this position, based out of the Brooks Seattle HQ, is $91,931 - $137,896 per year. Base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Other

Brooks is proud to offer a robust benefits package to our employees and their families!

Benefits- including medical, dental, vision, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance, HSA and employer contribution, FSA, family & fertility assistance, 401K Savings Plan and match, employee assistance program, and transportation assistance.

Paid Time Off- Brooks offers generous time off including five weeks of paid time off, eleven paid holidays, paid sick and parental leave.

Bonus- in addition to base pay, Brooks employees may also be offered an annual bonus based on company performance.

Perks- including product discounts, employee recognition, fitness discounts, volunteer and donation benefits.

Location- You will spend 4 days per week in our Seattle offices, as we believe our organization flourishes when connections, collaboration, creativity, problem-solving, and celebrations happen in person.

At Brooks, we celebrate diversity & equity. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment, and encourage people of all backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and skills to apply. The E-commerce Strategy team for TikTok Shop plays a critical role in setting direction and accelerating growth of the US market. We are looking for a Strategy & Analytics Associate for Business Analytics team.

Responsibilities:
- Develop short-term and long-term scale and revenue targets for our Global E-commerce business, focusing on establishing a metric system, setting business goals, and developing performance tracking mechanisms.
- Leverage insights from analysis to provide informed recommendations for future business strategy.
- Conduct thorough market segmentation research and track industry trends to identify potential business opportunities.
- Familiarity with E-commerce business logic and analytical frameworks, possessing the ability to think structurally, provide data-driven insights, identify key factors, simplify complex issues, align thinking with business objectives.
- Identify problems and business pain points (focusing on merchant growth, traffic efficiency/conversion, and user behavior) to help the business increase revenue.

- Bachelor's degree or above, with 5+ years of work experience.
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL/Python.
- Experience in strategic consulting and analysis.
- Demonstrate strong communication and coordination skills, excellent logical thinking, and data sensitivity.
- Ability to quickly grasp business contexts and identify key business drivers behind data.

Preferred Qualification:

Title: Sr Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Global Data Center Ops Central Insight and Analytics Team
Description:
Description

We are looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to build the diagnostic analytics layer for Amazon's global data center operations. You will move our analytics capability beyond reporting *what* happened to explaining *why* — identifying which factors drive metric deviation, decomposing performance into attributable components, and building the analytical frameworks that enable operational leaders to take the right action.

GDCO operates one of the world's largest physical infrastructure fleets — hundreds of data centers across 20+ countries — with thousands of technicians performing hardware repairs, rack installations, and preventive maintenance daily. We have strong descriptive analytics (dashboards, WBR metrics), but has opportunity in terms of explaining root causes, attribute performance gaps to specific factors, or recommend proven corrective actions. This leader will focus on building that diagnostic layer.

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role. You will scope analytical problems, build decomposition frameworks, partner with operational leaders to validate findings, and deliver insights that directly influence resource allocation, process design, and investment decisions at the VP level. You'll work with rich operational data at scale: millions of repair tickets, rack lifecycle events, parts inventory flows, workforce scheduling data, and hardware validation results.

Basic Qualifications


10+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
Expert SQL skills — complex analytical queries across large-scale datasets (multi-system joins, window functions, statistical aggregations across petabyte-scale data)
Strong statistical foundation — regression analysis, statistical process control, hypothesis testing, and metric decomposition applied to real business problems
Experience building automated, reproducible analytical pipelines — scheduled systems that serve ongoing business processes at production quality
Proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and visualization
Demonstrated ability to decompose complex business metrics into attributable components — translating "this metric moved" into "here's why, here's who owns each piece, here's the impact"
Strong written and verbal communication — ability to write diagnostic narratives and present complex analysis clearly to VP-level audiences


Preferred Qualifications


Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
Experience in operational analytics — manufacturing, logistics, field operations, supply chain, or physical infrastructure domains where you've analyzed process efficiency, failure modes, or workforce productivity
Experience with workforce analytics — productivity measurement, skill-gap analysis, labor planning, or efficiency modeling that accounts for varying task complexity and work mix
Experience building composite metrics or indices that combine multiple dimensions into weighted scores (similar to OEE, NPS, or operational health indices)
Experience with multivariate analysis — identifying which factors among many are most strongly associated with performance outcomes
Experience building decision-support tools, recommendation frameworks, or analytical playbooks — structured systems where analysis directly translates to operational action
Familiarity with forecasting methods (time-series decomposition, trend analysis, seasonality modeling) for operational planning
Experience building analytical frameworks adopted across multiple teams — reusable tools and methods that scale beyond individual analyses
Experience with Amazon internal data tools (Redshift, Athena, QuickSight) is a plus for internal candidates
Experience with data center, cloud infrastructure, or hardware operations is valuable but not required — domain knowledge can be learned; analytical rigor cannot

Description:
SystImmune is a leading and well-funded clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company located in Redmond, WA and Princeton, NJ. It specializes in developing innovative cancer treatments using its established drug development platforms, focusing on bi-specific, multi-specific antibodies, and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). SystImmune has multiple assets in various stages of clinical trials for solid tumor and hematologic indications. Alongside ongoing clinical trials. SystImmune has a robust preclinical pipeline of potential cancer therapeutics in the discover and IND-enabling stages, representing cutting-edge biologics development. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company's success.

The Spotfire Clinical Data Analyst will specialize in the installation, maintenance, and development of clinical data visualizations utilizing Spotfire. This role emphasizes creating and enhancing Spotfire-based patient profiles, real-time data review dashboards, clinical metrics dashboards, and other customized visualization reports such as live TLFs. Additionally, the Analyst will collaborate closely with Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Clinical Science, and Clinical Operations to optimize data visualization strategies.

This position requires a full-time onsite presence at our Redmond, WA office.

Responsibilities:


Lead the installation, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of Spotfire for clinical data analysis and visualization
Design, develop, and maintain Spotfire dashboards for patient profiles, real-time clinical data review, surveillance, metrics tracking, and other customized visualizations
Develop sophisticated, interactive visualizations to support internal data review processes, surveillance, reconciliation, and reporting needs
Collaborate with Clinical Data Managers, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Clinical Science teams to identify requirements and translate them into effective Spotfire visualizations
Manage and continually improve the Spotfire analytics environment, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and performance
Establish and maintain a Global Spotfire Library, aligning visualization standards across multiple studies and programs
Train and mentor Clinical Data Managers and other stakeholders in effectively utilizing Spotfire dashboards and reports
Coordinate timelines and deliverables with Clinical Data Management and other cross-functional teams to ensure visualizations meet expectations
Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of new technologies and methodologies to enhance Spotfire capabilities
Document visualization specifications, maintain clear documentation for Spotfire-related processes, and contribute to departmental SOPs
Uphold industry standards including protocol compliance, ICH GCP, FDA regulations, and CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM)


Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Biostatistics, Computer Science, Life Science, or a related field
Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in Spotfire visualization development and administration in a clinical trial setting, preferably in oncology and hematology
Expert-level proficiency in Spotfire including installation, configuration, dashboard development, data integration, scripting (IronPython, TERR, etc.) and performance optimization
Strong experience developing patient profiles, real-time data review dashboards, clinical metrics dashboards, and complex reports
Experience with SAS/R, SQL programming, and data manipulation
Familiarity with clinical trial data standards (CDISC SDTM, ADaM), experience with TLF generation preferred
Experience integrating Spotfire with clinical databases and EDC systems (e.g., Medidata RAVE, Oracle Inform, Veeva)
Strong organizational skills, critical thinking, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Familiarity with regulatory guidelines including GCP, ICH, and FDA requirements
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

The expected base salary range for this position is $90,000 - $130,000 annually. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s qualifications, experience, and skills.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Cambia:


Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Operational Technology Management, Computer Science, Operations Research, or an equivalent related field, plus 7+ years of job-related work experience, including 2+ years in healthcare and healthcare business processes — or an equivalent combination of education and related work experience


Skills And Attributes


Demonstrated proficiency in SQL coding (Toad, DBeaver, Snowflake, etc.), ETL tools (Talend, DBT, etc.), and reporting tools (Tableau, Sigma, etc.)
Familiarity with relational databases and client-server concepts
Proven ability to perform complex analytical tasks with minimal supervision and manage large-risk, complex projects independently
Strong understanding of software testing principles and the full development lifecycle, including coding, testing, and debugging
Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into clear design specifications and technical documentation
Skill in negotiating solutions and building consensus among stakeholders with competing Business Intelligence needs
Advanced knowledge of program evaluation concepts, including effectiveness analysis, measurement, and reporting
Experience with AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity and decision-making in professional settings highly desired
Solid oral and written communication skills, including presentation and technical writing
Knowledge of healthcare and healthcare business processes a plus


What You Will Do At Cambia


Design, develop, and maintain reports, programs, and analytical models that meet the needs of business partners across Cambia Health Solutions

Mentor and assist team members and internal business partners to build collective capability

At Cambia, You Can


Work alongside diverse teams building cutting-edge solutions to transform health care.

Medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members, including mental health benefits.

Title: Anti-Fraud Analyst, TikTok Shop - USDS
Description:
Responsibilities
About the team
E-commerce's Governance and Experience is a global team responsible for ensuring our marketplace is safe and trustworthy for users, sellers, and creators. We value user satisfaction and work on policies, rules, and systems to ensure quality.

The USDS Risk Control and Security team within GNE focuses on fighting various forms of fraud and abuse within the TikTok Shop ecosystem via insight generation, scaled enforcement, automation, and prevention.

About the role
As an Anti-Fraud Analyst, you will be responsible for investigating, analyzing, and deep diving into various types of fraudulent activity within TikTok's e-commerce platform. You will use the insights that you discovered to build automated detection and enforcement rules, improve operational efficiency, and work cross-functionally to push for policy and product enhancements to close known fraud loopholes. You will also develop and track key metrics to monitor progress.

The position ensures that the business complies with US regulations and relevant laws, helps mitigate risk, and ensures adherence to company policies and procedures.

Responsibilities
- Leverage data analysis tools and query databases to conduct risk/fraud investigations. Gather and analyze data and trends to draw out key insights, document them, and then recommend policy, process, and product improvements.
- Conduct timely root cause analyses on emerging fraud trends and escalations, documenting findings to inform and initiate policy, process, and product improvements.
- Maintain our enforcement rules and policies to ensure accuracy and compliance.
- Dive into the business and dig into user behavior to identify abnormalities. Develop regulations, models and risk control strategies for policy violations based on business requirements.
- Develop key metrics to track progress and monitor fraud trends
- Create standard operating procedures as needed for scaled manual operations workflows
- Provide training and guidance to other team members on fraud detection and prevention techniques.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- 2+ years of hands-on and in-depth experience in fraud and risk detection, enforcement, and investigations.
- Proficient in MySQL or other querying languages.
- Strong ability to analyze, manipulate, and identify insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
- Experience with creating rules or models to automate fraud detection or enforcement
- Demonstrated analytical thinking and problem-solving.
- Experience managing projects and coordinating with regional and cross-functional partners.
- Strong work ethic and demonstrated ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with LLM prompt engineering or LLM agent development
- Experience with Python or other scripting languages

About USDS
TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​


USDS Reasonable Accommodation
USDS is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS-RA​

Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Prime Video Partner Experience & Supply Chain
Description:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

What You'll Do

Join Prime Video's Partner Experience & Supply Chain team as a Business Intelligence Engineer and become the data expert who transforms how we work with our content partners and optimize our supply chain.

You'll be the go-to person for turning complex supply chain data into clear insights that drive real decisions. Working alongside product managers, engineers, and operations teams, you'll build the analytics tools and dashboards that help everyone understand what's working, what's not, and where we should focus next.

The Problems You'll Solve

Our supply chain generates massive amounts of data, but data alone doesn't drive change - insights do. You'll tackle questions like: Where are the bottlenecks slowing down content delivery? Which partner workflows need improvement? How can we predict and prevent supply chain issues before they impact customers?

You'll create the visibility tools that turn these questions into actionable answers, helping teams spot trends early and make confident, data-backed decisions.

What Makes This Role Different

You won't just be running reports - you'll be a strategic partner shaping how Prime Video manages relationships with content partners and optimizes the entire supply chain. Your work will directly influence how quickly and efficiently we bring content to millions of viewers worldwide.

You'll have the autonomy to identify opportunities, propose solutions, and build the tools that matter most. If you love diving deep into data, translating complexity into clarity, and seeing your insights drive tangible improvements, this role offers that impact.

Key job responsibilities


Analyze data to identify and execute on business opportunities
Understand data resources and select appropriate sources for each analysis
Build fast prototypes using Amazon AI tools (Kiro, Claude CLI, QuickSuite) and translate them into production-grade data products
Evaluate requirements and select optimal tools, balancing speed, efficiency, and scalability
Build data pipelines and dashboards from multi-dimensional datasets to report product metrics and KPIs
Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders verbally and in writing


About The Team

We are part of the central Product and Data Team within the Partner Experience & Supply Chain organization at Prime Video. Our structure and scope is a hybrid model where we collaborate closely with our tech teams to build data products that solve problems affecting PV customers and our internal stakeholders.

We optimize the supply chain and deliver the highest standard of video streaming content to our customers. Our team is the trusted analytical powerhouse that drives unified data solutions, making Prime Video the preferred entertainment destination for customers worldwide.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
4+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
Proven ability to determine when and how to integrate GenAI tools, evaluate and refine GenAI outputs, and apply responsible AI practices to augment productivity and quality


Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

NTT DATA North America is seeking a GTM Decision Intelligence Quantitative Analyst to develop, test, explain, operationalize, and improve evidence-based go-to-market recommendations for sales leaders and sellers. The Analyst combines bookings, market data, account plans, partner targets and offerings, internal solutions, sales plays, industry points of view, and historical outcomes using quantitative methods and approved AI capabilities. The role converts fragmented information into prioritized account-partner-solution opportunities and next-best-motion recommendations without replacing seller judgment or Solution & Strategy content ownership.

Responsibilities Include:

Analytical Design and Data Fusion


Frame ambiguous commercial questions as testable analytical problems, data requirements, features, hypotheses, acceptance criteria, and experiments.
Combine structured and unstructured internal and external data into governed, analysis-ready features with documented lineage and limitations.
Design account-solution-partner-fit, whitespace, propensity, relevance, timing, and next-best-motion methods.
Use approved AI capabilities for synthesis, classification, comparison, research acceleration, and analytical workflow orchestration while preserving human review and source traceability.


Recommendation Engine and Validation


Develop and maintain recommendation scoring logic, confidence thresholds, prompts, transformations, business rules, versions, and controlled release criteria.
Test recommendations against known outcomes, holdout samples, business rules, edge cases, stakeholder challenge, and observed field outcomes.
Assess coverage, missing data, skew, instability, drift, unintended bias, false precision, and model risk; escalate material concerns before use.
Create explainable recommendation outputs that communicate supporting evidence, confidence, assumptions, limitations, and suggested seller action.


Cross-Tower Collaboration and Learning


Partner with Solution & Strategy for governed solution, sales-play, offering, and industry-content inputs.
Partner with the Sales Tower for seller context, business validation, recommendation release, field activation, and feedback.
Capture recommendation disposition, seller feedback, opportunity progression, and observed outcomes to improve methods without overstating causality.
Operationalize repeatable analytical workflows with KPI Reporting, Analytics Shared Services, Data and AI teams, and responsible-AI stakeholders.


Qualifications:


Bachelor’s or advanced degree in statistics, economics, operations research, data science, computer science, engineering, applied mathematics, business analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience translating business questions into quantitative analysis, scoring methods, experiments, or recommendation systems.
Proficiency with SQL, Python or comparable analytical tools, plus strong Excel and business-intelligence skills.
Experience using AI-assisted analytical workflows with source traceability, validation, human review, and responsible-AI controls.
Strong knowledge of feature design, validation, explainability, data quality, bias and drift considerations, and analytical documentation.
Ability to build broad knowledge across partner ecosystems, industries, solutions, sales motions, market signals, account planning, and commercial performance.
Strong communication skills and ability to influence senior sales, strategy, data, and business stakeholders without owning final commercial decisions.


Systems and Tools

SQL, Python or comparable analytical language, Approved AI platforms, Power BI, Excel, Model / code repository, Salesforce and approved data environments.

Role Success Indicators


Recommendation precision and useful coverage
Validation and explainability quality
Seller adoption and feedback capture
Stable, documented methods
Improvement from observed outcomes
Responsible-AI compliance and reusable analytical assets


Key Working Relationships

Works with Sales leaders and sellers, the Sales Tower, Solution & Strategy, Data and AI stakeholders, KPI Reporting, Analytics Shared Services, Finance and Sales Operations, and Partner Execution leadership.

Role Scope Clarification

This role requires generalist knowledge across strategic partners and the ability to learn partner-specific programs, terminology, systems, and processes. This role is not dedicated to a single partnership.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

As a Lunar Data Applications Engineer, you are responsible for building data models, crafting intuitive visuals, and providing analysis that helps Blue Origin build a road to the Moon. Within the Lunar business operations organization, we build relationships with budget owners to technical design teams that cover the design, build, and operate lifecycle. Our team accelerates program operations and strengthens the value of analytics in modern aerospace.

We are looking for someone to apply technical expertise, customer focus, and dedication to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight.

A Successful Candidate Demonstrates


Active listening, digs into root causes, and translates pain points into actionable solutions
Demonstrates strong business acumen and understands complex program operations
Takes ownership of ambiguous problems and delivers high-quality solutions independently
Creates intuitive data visualizations that tell compelling stories and drive adoption
Writes clear documentation that enables others to understand and extend your work
Thrives in fast-paced environments where priorities shift as programs evolve


Key Responsibilities


Designs and builds data models supporting Lunar program planning, tracking configuration, schedule, and technical performance across Lunar Permanence programs
Creates dashboards and key metrics used by program leadership for decision-making and business reviews
Develops automated data pipelines using Python and SQL to enable teams across engineering, supply chain, configuration management, production, and operations
Partners with budget owners and technical teams to identify analytics needs and deliver self-service reporting solutions
Leads technical data modeling efforts for cross-functional analyses spanning multiple Lunar programs
Establishes data quality standards and documentation practices that enable team scalability


Minimum Qualifications


Passion For Our Mission: Millions of people living and working in space!
4+ years SQL experience with either Python, and/or Spark as a plus
Demonstrable experience with GenAI tools to generate, review, and deploy code, especially data reporting tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Databricks Apps)
Experience with professional visualization tools (e.g. Databricks / Tableau / PowerBI / etc.)
Experience working with customers to gather requirements and present data solutions


Preferred Qualifications


2+ years building models and reports with Databricks (preferably with Certified Data Analyst Associate)
Experience using Git, Gitlab for code management (Branching / Merging, CI/CD, Variables, Deployment)
Experience building automated data pipelines using Python, DBSQL, and/or Spark
Experience with AWS infrastructure and tools (ECS, RDS, Lambda, etc.)
Experience with hierarchical data structures, especially with hardware bill of materials and production plans
Domain knowledge in engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and/or aerospace

WA applicants is $141,162.00 - $197,626.80

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Title: Engineering Analyst, Trust and Safety, AdSpam
Description:
In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:


Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
Holidays: 13 paid days per year


Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Kirkland, WA, USA; Austin, TX, USA.Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
2 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.


Preferred qualifications:


Master's degree in a quantitative discipline.
2 years of experience with one or more of the following languages: SQL, R, Python, or C++.
2 years of experience with machine learning systems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


About The Job

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

The mission of the Trust and Safety Ad Traffic Quality team is to make the ads ecosystem universally trusted and defended against invalid Traffic. We analyze billions of events and create scalable methods to stop motivated fraudsters from causing harm. When we get this right, we help users, advertisers, publishers, and Google gain information and monetize the internet safely and usefully.
