Title: Product Data Analyst II
Description:
About Checkr

Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About The Team/role

As a Product Analyst II, you will work hand-in-hand with multiple business departments to develop complex models and effectively communicate their business impacts, ensuring Checkr maintains its leadership position in efficiency, quality, and other key metrics identified by you and pertinent stakeholders.

This pivotal role falls under the Data Platform organization and you will report directly to the Head of Data Platform. Moreover, your strong partnership with Checkr's Product, Financial Planning & Strategy, Data Engineering, and cross-functional business teams will be the key to unlocking their potential through the strategic use of data and be the last mile for translation to impact on business.

What you’ll do:


Partner with business stakeholders to gain deep understanding of our products and customers
Effectively communicate insights and recommendations from your analysis to a non-technical audience across all organizational levels
Collaborate closely with product owners and finance partners to analyze the value of new features, enhancements, and projects
Based on exploratory analysis, create customer profiles, develop metrics to inform pricing and monetization strategies
Develop AI context, evals to enable your business stakeholders to self-serve your data models
Work with engineers to develop data sources and core metrics to be utilized by the entire company
Experimentation Evangelist - educate and promote a data driven culture through experimentation


What you bring:


2+ years of experience in a highly analytical role, with at least 1 year in a product analytics/data science role
Advanced proficiency in SQL, as well as an understanding of data warehouse principles including data modeling; Bonus points for experience with dbt
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and prioritize growth opportunities based on data and experiment results
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to distill complex analytical solutions into actionable insights and communicate business impact to non technical audiences
A demonstrated self-starter with excellent prioritization skills, able to drive projects to completion with minimal guidance.
An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.


Pay Transparency Disclosure

We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website.

On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (San Francisco, CA)

$115,000—$135,000 USD

A fast-paced and collaborative environment
Learning and development allowance
Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement
100% medical, dental, and vision coverage
Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services
Flexible PTO policy
Monthly wellness stipend


At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. A relocation stipend may be available for those willing to relocate to a Checkr hub location.

Title: Sr. Customer & Business Data Analyst II
Description:
About Slickdeals:

We believe shopping should feel like winning. That’s why 10 million people come to Slickdeals to swap tips, upvote the best finds, and share the thrill of a great deal. Together, our community has saved more than $10 billion over the past 26 years.

We’re profitable, passionate, and in the middle of an exciting evolution—transforming from the internet’s most trusted deal forum into the go-to daily shopping destination. If you thrive in a fast-moving, creative environment where ideas turn into impact fast, you’ll fit right in.

The Purpose:

Slickdeals is looking for a Senior Customer & Business Data Analyst to join our Finance & Business Operations team. This is a high-visibility role that will help shape how we understand our business, our users, and the opportunities that will drive Slickdeals' long-term growth.

Reporting to the VP of Finance & Business Operations, you will work across some of the most important questions facing the company—from understanding changes in customer behavior and marketplace performance, to identifying business trends for senior leadership and the Board, to sizing new products, markets, and strategic opportunities.

We're looking for someone who goes well beyond reporting what happened. The right candidate is naturally curious, commercially minded, and proactive about identifying the questions that matter. You should be comfortable moving from raw data to a clear point of view:

What is happening? Why is it happening? Why does it matter? And what should we do about it?

This role will have significant exposure to Slickdeals' executive team and cross-functional leadership and will play an important part in informing the company's long-term strategy. You will have the opportunity to work with rich customer, deal, merchant, and transactional datasets and significant autonomy in determining where deeper analysis can create value.

What You'll Do:


Drive strategic and operational analysis. Analyze customer, deal, merchant, product, financial, and external market data to identify the trends, risks, and opportunities most important to Slickdeals' performance and long-term strategy.
Develop a deep understanding of customer and marketplace behavior. Evaluate changes in acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, customer value, merchant performance, and deal economics to understand not just what is changing, but why.
Size new products and growth opportunities. Build data-driven assessments of new products, markets, customer segments, revenue streams, and strategic initiatives, translating ambiguous questions into clear analytical frameworks and recommendations.
Validate new and evolving data sources. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to understand how new products and features work, validate that underlying datasets and metrics accurately reflect real-world product behavior, and identify data quality or tracking issues before they influence business decisions.
Proactively identify and answer important business questions. Go beyond responding to requests by surfacing anomalies, developing hypotheses, and independently pursuing analyses that can materially improve decisions. Leverage AI and other emerging tools where useful to accelerate deep analysis, dashboard development, and the path from question to action.
Influence decisions through clear communication. Distill complex analyses into concise insights, recommendations, dashboards, and presentations for cross-functional leaders, senior executives, and the Board.


What We're Looking For:


7+ years of experience in business analytics, customer analytics, product analytics, strategy, business intelligence, finance analytics, or a similarly analytical and business-oriented role.
Advanced SQL skills and demonstrated ability to independently explore and analyze large, complex datasets.
Exceptional business judgment and an ability to connect analytical findings to customer behavior, underlying business economics, and broader strategic implications.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous business questions, structure them analytically, identify the right data and methodology, and develop a clear recommendation or point of view.
A naturally curious and proactive mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you exactly what analysis to run—you develop hypotheses, investigate anomalies, and identify opportunities others may have missed.
Strong analytical storytelling skills, including the ability to distill a complex analysis into the few insights that actually matter.
Experience analyzing customer or user behavior, including areas such as acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, segmentation, cohorts, or lifetime value.
Ability to move comfortably between highly detailed analyses and broad strategic questions.
Experience partnering directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders and using analytics to influence meaningful business decisions.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau or similar platforms and Excel / Google Sheets.
BS degree in economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, business, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.


Nice to Have:


Experience in a consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplace, digital media, affiliate marketing, or advertising business.
Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or another environment emphasizing rigorous analytical problem solving and executive communication.
Experience analyzing merchant, marketplace, advertising, or transaction-level economics.
Experience combining internal data with external market, competitive, consumer, or industry data to explain business performance and identify emerging trends.
Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, and causal analysis, including the ability to interpret results and translate them into business decisions.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to accelerate analytical workflows, from ad hoc investigation and deep-dive analysis to dashboard development, automation, data visualization, and communicating insights.
A demonstrated interest in emerging analytical tools and a track record of using technology to reduce time from question → analysis → insight → action.
Experience with Python or another analytical programming language. Python is helpful, but this is not a data science or machine learning role.
Familiarity with modern data infrastructure and tools such as Databricks, dbt, Spark, or similar technologies.


How You'll Succeed:

The strongest person in this role will combine the analytical depth of a senior analyst with the mindset of a business operator.

You will be successful if you can:


Spot an important change in the business before someone asks about it.
Determine which questions are worth spending time answering—and which aren't.
Turn a vague business question into a structured analytical approach.
Move comfortably between customer-level data, deal and merchant performance, financial results, and broader market trends.
Develop hypotheses and determine which analyses will actually help distinguish between competing explanations.
Distinguish an interesting data point from something that actually matters to the business.
Develop a point of view rather than simply delivering analysis.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance company in San Francisco. We're not bolting AI onto insurance — we're rebuilding the entire business as software, on a simple bet: turning expert human judgment into compute is one of the largest transitions left to make, and a trillion-dollar industry still run 90% by hand is the place to prove it. We've grown ~100x in the last year and we move at that speed — on-site, in person, long days, very high standards. Almost no one joins Harper for insurance; they join to build the company that replaces how it works.

The role

Harper's GTM Engineer builds the data infrastructure. You're the one who tells us what it's saying. Every morning you'll wake up asking the same question: what does the data want us to do today? You sit closest to our Growth Marketing Lead, synthesizing signal from across every channel and turning it into clear, confident recommendations they can act on. You're not a report generator — you're an analytical partner who helps drive decisions, translating the noise into the two or three things that actually matter and helping the team move on them.

You're a growth-oriented data analyst who's as comfortable drawing a conclusion as you are running the query that supports it. You've worked closely with marketing or growth teams before — not as a data service desk, but as a real partner in the work. You know what good channel performance looks like, you understand the metrics that matter in paid acquisition, and you can translate a cohort analysis into a budget recommendation without anyone having to ask. You report to the Head of Marketing, work day-to-day alongside the Growth Marketing Lead, and collaborate closely with the GTM Engineer who owns the underlying data systems. Winning in 6–12 months looks like the growth team making better decisions faster because you're in the room.

What You'll Do


Synthesize channel performance. Pull together data across paid, organic, and partner channels — and identify what's working, what's not, and what to do about it.
Partner with the Growth Marketing Lead. Serve as their analytical right hand; translate data outputs into clear recommendations they can act on in real time.
Own growth KPI reporting. Define, maintain, and communicate core marketing and funnel metrics so the team is always looking at the right numbers.
Build and maintain LTV/CAC analysis. Give leadership a clear, current picture of unit economics by channel, cohort, and customer segment.
Run experiment analysis. Evaluate A/B tests and campaign experiments — and turn results into decisions, not slide decks.
Surface what the data is asking for. Proactively flag trends, anomalies, and opportunities before anyone has to ask you to look.


Who You Are


You've worked as an analytical partner to a marketing or growth team — not just supported them from a distance.
You can draw a clear conclusion from messy data and defend it in a room with people who will push back.
You think in recommendations, not just findings — you're not done until you've said "and therefore we should…"
You're fast: you can turn a question into an answer in hours, not days.
You understand paid acquisition channels well enough to have opinions about where the budget should go.
You thrive in a high-tempo environment where the questions change faster than the data does.
You're based in San Francisco or willing to relocate.


The reality — read this before you apply

This is a decision-driving seat, measured by the decisions your analysis changes — not dashboards shipped or tickets closed. It's on-site in San Francisco, in person, long days, high standards. The questions move fast and the data is messy, which means you'll be expected to draw a conclusion and stand behind it, often before the picture is fully clean. You're the analytical engine for the growth team, so when a number looks wrong or a channel turns, finding out why is yours — frequently the same day.

This is explicitly not a data service desk, and it isn't a place to produce reports no one acts on. Almost no one takes it for insurance — they take it because being the analytical right hand to a growth team at a company scaling ~100x, with a direct line from your recommendation to where the budget goes, is a rare seat. If being measured on decisions is the appeal, apply. If it's a deterrent, it won't get easier here.

Compensation & Logistics


Salary: $140,000–$180,000, plus performance bonus and equity.
Location: On-site, San Francisco. Based here or willing to relocate.
Schedule: Monday–Friday, long days, in the building with the team.


Benefits


Uber commuter benefits
Meals provided — breakfast, lunch, and dinner
Snacks, drinks, and coffee stocked daily
Free gym membership
Health, dental, and vision insurance


Requirements


4+ years of analytics experience with direct exposure to marketing, growth, or revenue teams
Strong SQL; Python proficiency preferred
Hands-on experience with funnel analysis, cohort analysis, attribution, and LTV/CAC modeling
Experience analyzing paid acquisition channel performance (Google, Meta, or comparable)
Proven ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions
Experience partnering with a marketing or growth counterpart to act on data in real time — not just produce reports


Nice to have


Familiarity with PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or comparable product analytics platforms
Experience working alongside a data engineer or GTM engineer and understanding how data pipelines work
Background in insurance, fintech, or another industry with complex funnel and attribution dynamics
Exposure to AI-assisted analytics workflows and modern BI tooling
Experience in a high-growth startup environment where speed and adaptability were required


Process


People screen — fit and alignment
Lead screen — skills and judgment
Super day — how you operate in real time


To apply

Send your resume and an example of analysis you ran — what you recommended, and what the team did with it.

Compensation Range: $140K - $180K

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Title: Sales Operations Data Analyst
Description:
Cytek Biosciences is a leading life sciences technology company advancing the next generation of cell analysis solutions for biomedical research, drug discovery, and clinical research. The company develops innovative flow cytometry and cell analysis technologies designed to provide researchers with high-resolution, high-content, and high-sensitivity data to better understand complex biological systems.

Cytek is recognized for its patented Full Spectrum Profiling™ (FSP®) technology, which captures the full fluorescence spectrum from multiple lasers to enable highly multiplexed and sensitive single-cell analysis. Its portfolio includes advanced flow cytometry platforms such as the Cytek Aurora®, Northern Lights™, Aurora CS, Aurora Evo, and Borealis™, along with reagents, software, and services that provide integrated solutions for researchers.

Headquartered in Fremont, California, Cytek serves pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, contract research organizations, and leading academic research institutions worldwide. The company’s mission is to enable scientists to obtain deeper biological insights and accelerate scientific innovation through powerful, accessible cell-analysis technologies.

The Sales Operations Data Analyst will drive forecasting excellence, process optimization, and advanced analytics initiatives across our global sales organization. In this role, the candidate supports forecast accuracy improvements, leads sophisticated projects to streamline operational efficiency, and contributes to data-driven initiatives by applying advanced data processing techniques to extract, combine, and analyze data from multiple CRM and ERP sources. This role will focus on collaborating with Global Sales Leadership, Finance, Operations, and IT teams.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform essential duties and responsibilities satisfactorily.


Improve forecast reliability and accuracy for enterprise products, focusing on forecasting support and providing actionable insights for strategic accounts.
Incorporate data insights to guide sales strategies, inform business decisions, and align with forecasting objectives.
Assist with global data reconciliation across CRM, financial, and forecasting systems to validate data, resolve discrepancies, and ensure consistent, reliable reporting.
Ensure data hygiene in Salesforce and forecasting platforms by managing product updates, system configurations, pricing analysis and conducting regular pipeline reviews.
Establish metrics to measure forecasting performance, pipeline health, and data quality, and pinpoint areas for process improvement.
Provide hands-on support to the sales team by managing pipeline data, sales attainment dashboards, troubleshooting system issues, and delivering training and tools to enable efficient forecasting workflows.
Support forecasting projects, process automation, and analytics improvements to improve sales projections and operational scalability.
Perform exploratory data analysis to identify data inconsistencies, patterns, trends, and correlations in large data sets.
Support the identification and resolution of data anomalies, working closely with stakeholders to address issues promptly.
Extract reliable data from various sources to identify key insights and opportunities and challenges our clients should act on.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer specific business questions and provide accurate and actionable recommendations.


Requirements & Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.


Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline.
5+ years of data analytics experience; leading multiple projects of various scope/complexity from initiation to closeout, with data quality as a focus.
Exceptional data expertise in all aspects of data analysis, insights creation, and visualization.
Advanced CRM and ERP data processing skills, including building advanced reports and queries.
Strong flexibility to work with a variety of application development applications.
Exceptional organizational skills, detail-oriented, adaptive, and strong client-focused mindset.
Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Salesforce, SAP, and Integrated Business Planning (IBP), experience with Python, SQL, or other data tools is a plus.
Background in supporting instrument manufacturing and life science products in forecasting or revenue planning is highly preferred.
Ability to manage a variety of tasks with tight timelines.
Excellent quantitative, analytical, written, and oral communication skills.
Comfortable navigating through ambiguity and crafting solutions without a defined guideline.
Strong work ethic and highly developed problem-solving skills.
Enjoy working under time constraints and can excel under pressure.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. 


The role is on-site in the Fremont, CA office.
Individuals may be required to travel to and from Cytek offices and other locations, as needed.
Prolonged periods of sitting and working on a computer.


Cytek is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Research Data Analyst 2
Description:
Job Description

Stanford University is seeking a Research Data Analyst 2 to manage and analyze large amounts of information, typically technical or scientific in nature, independently with minimal supervision.

Stanford University is one of the world’s most renowned universities. Sitting in the heart of the San Francisco Bay Area among the valley’s most progressive companies.

You will be working with an unparalleled leading-edge community of faculty and staff that are fundamentally changing the world of health care. You will have the opportunity to influence and drive change with your innovative ideas, the ability to make a difference and participate in human advancements. Our culture is fast-paced, energetic, and growing all of the time.

We offer a variety of benefits beyond traditional medical, dental, retirement, and savings options:


Events and program for children, sports camps, tuition options
World-class intellectual stimulation through learning and development classes, workshops, and onsite conferences from leading-edge speakers and faculty
Work/life and family-friendly policies and reimbursement
Participation in Stanford’s social responsibility and sustainable programs for a better world
A vibrant university culture that values the uniqueness of each individual


We are seeking candidates who are progressive thinkers, see challenges as simply problems to solve, and have the spirit and energy to change the world.

About The Department Of Pathology

The Department of Pathology at Stanford School of Medicine, one of its founding departments, stands as a leader among its peers nationwide. Our preeminent faculty spans from emerging leaders to highly accomplished physicians and scientists, including a Nobel laureate and members of the National Academy. Our mission is to improve the diagnosis, treatment, and basic understanding of the human disease. This is done through discovery (research), education, and clinical care. Comprised of extraordinary faculty and staff, our mission is to improve the ability to diagnose, treat and understand the origin and

manifestation of human disease, and to care for those who have or are at risk to develop disease. We accomplish this through our clinical services (in all fields of anatomic and clinical pathology, including molecular and genomic pathology, histocompatibility testing and transfusion medicine) and be research (which includes basic, translational and clinical research into the origins and manifestations of disease, including efforts to improve disease prediction and prevention as part of the goal of achieving precision medicine and health), and also by educating future leaders in pathology and related fields. Everything we do is to achieve the goals of providing the highest quality of clinical services to the patients for whom we passionately care, to advance our ability to understand, diagnose, monitor and ultimately to cure disease or to prevent or delay its occurrence, and to provide outstanding education and career development opportunities to those who share these goals.

For more information about the department visit http://pathology.stanford.edu/

About The Lab

The Research Data Analyst 2 will be working within the Stanford Pathology EMERALD (Enhancing Medical Excellence via Research in Advanced Laboratory Diagnostics) Program. EMERALD is engaged in diagnostics research and novel test development with the goal of rapid deployment in the clinical laboratories.

About The Position

Stanford University is seeking a Research Data Analyst 2 to join our comprehensive cancer genomics program. The RDA2 will be involved in the development and application of bioinformatic tools for the analysis of oncology-related sequencing data including, but not limited to, whole exome, whole genome, and whole transcriptome data from solid tumor and hematopoietic cell malignancies. The RDA2 will also support the implementation of distributed pipeline architectures for medical NGS data analysis. The emphasis is on clinical grade quality, scalability and maintainability in an in-house cluster or cloud environment.

Duties Include


Prioritize and extract data from a variety of sources such as notes, survey results, medical reports, and laboratory data, and maintain its accuracy and completeness.
Determine additional data collection and reporting requirements.
Design and customize reports based upon data in the database. Oversee and monitor regulatory compliance for utilization of the data.
Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and eliminate root cause for data problems or justify solutions to be implemented by others.
Create complex charts and databases, perform statistical analyses, and develop graphs and tables for publication and presentation.
Serve as a resource for non-routine inquiries such as requests for statistics or surveys.
Test prototype software and participate in approval and release process for new software.
Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff.
Analyze sequencing data generated as part of the comprehensive cancer genomics program.
- Other duties may also be assigned


Physical Requirements*:


Sitting in place at computer for long periods of time with extensive keyboarding/dexterity.
Occasionally use a telephone.
Rarely writing by hand.
- Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.


Working Conditions


Some work may be performed in a laboratory or field setting.
Due to the nature of the work, this position will be hybrid

Create complex charts and databases, perform statistical analyses, and develop graphs and tables for publication and presentation.
Serve as a resource for non-routine inquiries such as requests for statistics or surveys.
Test prototype software and participate in approval and release process for new software.
Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff.


Minimum Education

Bachelor's degree and three years of relevant experience or combination of education and relevant experience.

Minimum Experience

Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics or engineering.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs.
Excellent writing and analytical skills.
Ability to prioritize workload.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
What You’ll Do


Confidential Client is hiring a Growth Data Analyst to provide cross-functional analytical support to Development, Commercial/Sales, and Operations teams. You will lead depot/site suitability and network analysis, own energy and utility rate analyses, support commercial analytics for customer acquisition, and build internal operations reporting.

Lead depot site suitability analysis and scoring to support expansion and portfolio decisions.
Use GIS tools, AI-assisted coding, and public/private datasets to design and optimize depot networks across Heavy‑Duty (HD), Medium‑Duty (MD), Light‑Duty (LD), and Autonomous Vehicle (AV) segments.
Analyze shipper/BCO data and trucking routes to identify high-density corridors and ideal depot locations.
Build data-driven location strategies and maintain market knowledge relevant to real estate/infrastructure development.
Track and analyze energy and utility tariffs across markets; build and maintain a centralized tariff database with standardized methodologies and quarterly updates.
Conduct end-to-end tariff and rate structure analysis; engage with utilities, regulators, and market participants as needed.
Provide sales and market analytics to identify prospective customers, map routes, and build top‑of‑funnel pipelines using external market intelligence.
Develop dashboards and KPIs for Commercial and Sales (CAC, LTV, conversion rates) and prepare metrics for investor communications (TAM, fleet size, utilization).
Bring operations analytics in‑house: design dashboards, reporting systems, and performance-tracking tools to surface utilization and operational efficiency insights.
Run simulations and models to evaluate route, customer, and network scenarios that inform decision-making.




Qualifications

Recent graduate or 1–2 years relevant experience in analytics, real estate/infrastructure markets, or related fields.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, real estate, or related discipline.
Practical experience with GIS tools and spatial analysis.
Strong quantitative and modeling skills; experience running data-driven simulations is preferred.
Proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, etc.). Familiarity with Salesforce is a plus.
Comfortable engaging directly with external partners (utilities, regulators, BCOs/shippers) to gather information and build relationships.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to synthesize complex analyses into clear recommendations.
Self-motivated, highly organized, and able to manage multiple priorities across Development, Commercial, and Operations teams in a fast-paced environment.




Compensation & Benefits

Base salary range: $80,000–$100,000 per year, commensurate with experience.
Health benefits.
Matching 401(k).
Unlimited PTO.
Health & wellness stipend.

(Compensation is listed to comply with applicable pay transparency requirements.)




Location & Employment Type

Location: San Francisco, CA (role supports remote/hybrid work as operationally appropriate; primary location is San Francisco).
Employment Type: Full‑time.




Why Join

Work at the intersection of infrastructure development, electrification, and logistics for a fast-growing company in the truck transportation space.
Cross-functional exposure to Development, Commercial, Finance, Product, and Operations teams — great visibility and development opportunities.
Make measurable impact on network planning, cost optimization, and customer acquisition.

This position is fully remote, with occasional travel for team‑building on client site.

Overview

In this role, you will partner with product, clinical, operational, and analytics stakeholders to understand business objectives, prepare and model data, and deliver reporting that clearly communicates progress toward key product goals. You will support the development of KPIs, build Power BI dashboards, and provide analytical insights that guide product and operational decisions. You will work under the supervision of the Sr. Director of Data & Analytics and collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Identify, define, and document key performance metrics for digital products, ensuring consistent and repeatable KPI definitions.
Clean, model, and prepare data from the enterprise data warehouse and other primary sources using SQL, Python/Pandas, and Databricks.
Develop, maintain, and optimize Power BI dashboards and visualizations that clearly communicate product performance to stakeholders.
Respond to ad‑hoc reporting requests by gathering and analyzing data to answer business and operational questions.
Communicate analytical findings through clear written summaries, presentations, and discussions with product, clinical, and operational teams.
Collaborate with data scientists and analytics staff to operationalize data workflows and support modeling efforts.
Partner with product teams to understand business needs, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide data‑driven recommendations.
Participate in departmental meetings, cross‑functional committees, and quality/service improvement initiatives.
Adhere to departmental policies, procedures, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
Perform additional duties as assigned.


Qualifications

Education & Training


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.


Experience


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis or a related field.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Strong data modeling and analysis skills, including experience with Databricks, Python/Pandas, and SQL.
Proficiency working with large relational databases (Microsoft SQL Server preferred).
Experience with version control tools such as GitHub or Azure DevOps.
Advanced Power BI skills, including building dashboards, visuals, and DAX measures.
Strong Excel proficiency.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights for diverse audiences.


Compensation & Benefits


Salary: $105,000 – $115,000 annually.
Work Environment: Fully remote with occasional travel for team‑building.
Comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO, holidays, and sick leave as required by law.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Job Summary

The Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) is seeking experienced candidates for a Data Analyst IV - Advanced Analytics & Reporting position within Access & Eligibility Services (AES), Data Management & Reporting team. The position supports HHSC’s mission to connect Texans to essential services by delivering advanced analytics, ensuring data quality, and providing operational decision support to internal teams.

Data Analyst IV functions as a senior individual contributor and hybrid analyst/mentor. The role performs complex analytical work under minimal supervision, applies independent judgment, mentors and reviews the work of other analysts, and delivers clear, actionable insights to non‑technical stakeholders. These positions do not have formal supervisory authority.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

Advanced Analytics & Insight Generation (30%)


Performs advanced SQL analysis to identify trends, patterns, and performance drivers.
Develops predictive and trend analyses to support operational planning and proactive decision‑making.
Translates complex analyses into clear findings and actionable recommendations for internal stakeholders.
Creates reusable analytical methods and standardized approaches to improve efficiency and consistency.


Data Quality & Validation (25%)


Designs and executes data validation, reconciliation, and quality audits across SQL Server, Oracle, and Snowflake.
Establishes and documents data quality rules, business definitions, and acceptance criteria.
Partners with business and technical teams to resolve data quality issues and prevent recurrence.
Monitors key data quality indicators and supports continuous improvement efforts.


Operational Decision Support & Reporting (20%)


Develops and maintains Power BI semantic models, dashboards, and reports tailored to business needs.
Provides clear data narratives, briefings, and written summaries in plain language.
Implements Power Automate workflows to streamline recurring reporting and operational processes.
Supports self‑service analytics while ensuring usability, accuracy, and performance.


Data Pipelines & Performance (15%)


Designs, optimizes, and troubleshoots ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple data platforms.
Collaborates with peers on data modeling and performance tuning.
Contributes to future‑state analytics solutions, including readiness for Databricks adoption.


Mentorship & Peer Review (10%)


Mentors and reviews the work of lower‑level data analysts.
Shares best practices for SQL, data modeling, validation, visualization, and documentation.
Assists with onboarding and skill development for analysts within the team.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities (KSAs)


Skill in advanced proficiency in SQL, including complex queries, window functions, and performance tuning.
Skills in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, and dashboard development.
Skill in designing and supporting ETL/ELT data pipelines.
Skill in using Power Automate to support operational workflows.
Strong understanding of data quality, validation, reconciliation, and documentation practices.
Ability to perform predictive and trend analysis aligned with business needs.
Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to non‑technical audiences.
Demonstrated accuracy, attention to detail, data integrity, curiosity, and problem‑solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with business analysts, developers, and program staff.
Ability to exercise independent judgment and work effectively with minimal supervision.
Ability to perform predictive or trend analysis in an operational or program environment.
Knowledge of health and human services or government/public sector settings.
Knowledge in working with Snowflake and cross‑platform SQL environments (SQL Server and Oracle).
Skilled with R, Python, SPSS, and advanced Excel.


Registrations, Licensure Requirements, or Certifications


Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL‑300) – Preferred
Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP‑600) – Preferred
Microsoft Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL‑200) – Preferred
Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) – Preferred
IIBA Certification in Business Data Analytics (CBDA) – Preferred
DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) – Preferred


Initial Screening Criteria


Two (2) years of professional experience as a data analyst performing advanced SQL analysis, data transformation, advanced reporting (Power BI or Tableau), and data quality validation.
Minimum of four (4) years of relevant professional experience.

This position is 100% remote within the State of Texas.
Candidates must reside in the State of Texas by their official start date.
Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.

Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

Role Overview
The Principal Data Analyst will play a key role in executing Filevine’s data and analytics initiatives. Reporting directly to executive leadership, this individual will manage daily analytics operations, deliver corporate metrics, and produce actionable insights to support operational excellence and strategic decision-making across the organization. This position requires a balance of strong technical proficiency, business acumen, and solid communication skills.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on analytical practitioner who can design and deliver high-quality analyses while engaging confidently with executive stakeholders.

Responsibilities:


Work closely with the CEO on ad-hoc or other impromptu projects, providing rapid analytical support and insights.
Lead daily operations for the corporate analytics function, overseeing the development and delivery of executive-level dashboards, KPIs, and routine reporting.
Partner with functional leaders to identify and interpret key trends across product usage, customer health, financial performance, and organizational initiatives.
Conduct complex analyses that inform strategic priorities and operational decisions.
Build and maintain robust data pipelines and models within Domo, integrating data from Salesforce, Snowflake, HubSpot, the Filevine Platform, and other enterprise systems.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and precision across all reporting outputs.
Implement frameworks for tracking key SaaS metrics and KPIs, including ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, customer engagement, and retention.
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex data into actionable business insights.
Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Product, and Customer Success teams to align analytics outputs with organizational goals.





Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, or a related field.
4–6+ years of experience in data analytics or business intelligence, with experience leading ad-hoc projects.
Demonstrated ability to guide projects and support team development.
Expertise in SQL and hands-on experience working with large, complex data environments.
Strong proficiency with Domo or equivalent BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
Solid understanding of Salesforce data structures and data integration practices.
Familiarity with SaaS business models and key financial metrics.
Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively present insights to senior stakeholders.
High attention to detail, with a commitment to accuracy, data governance, and analytical rigor.





Work Location Expectation: This position is based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Salt Lake City or New York offices. Candidates residing in or near these metro areas are expected to work on a hybrid (2-3 days in-office/week) or fully onsite basis.

LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

The Principal Data Analyst will play a key role in executing Filevine’s data and analytics initiatives. Reporting directly to executive leadership, this individual will manage daily analytics operations, deliver corporate metrics, and produce actionable insights to support operational excellence and strategic decision-making across the organization. This position requires a balance of strong technical proficiency, business acumen, and solid communication skills.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on analytical practitioner who can design and deliver high-quality analyses while engaging confidently with executive stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with the CEO on ad-hoc or other impromptu projects, providing rapid analytical support and insights.
  • Lead daily operations for the corporate analytics function, overseeing the development and delivery of executive-level dashboards, KPIs, and routine reporting.
  • Partner with functional leaders to identify and interpret key trends across product usage, customer health, financial performance, and organizational initiatives.
  • Conduct complex analyses that inform strategic priorities and operational decisions.
  • Build and maintain robust data pipelines and models within Domo, integrating data from Salesforce, Snowflake, HubSpot, the Filevine Platform, and other enterprise systems.
  • Ensure data integrity, consistency, and precision across all reporting outputs.
  • Implement frameworks for tracking key SaaS metrics and KPIs, including ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, customer engagement, and retention.
  • Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex data into actionable business insights.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Product, and Customer Success teams to align analytics outputs with organizational goals.




Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, or a related field.
  • 4–6+ years of experience in data analytics or business intelligence, with experience leading ad-hoc projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to guide projects and support team development.
  • Expertise in SQL and hands-on experience working with large, complex data environments.
  • Strong proficiency with Domo or equivalent BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
  • Solid understanding of Salesforce data structures and data integration practices.
  • Familiarity with SaaS business models and key financial metrics.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively present insights to senior stakeholders.

Title: Data Analyst - Servicing Operations
Description:
As a Data Analyst for Rocket Loans, you'll be a strategic partner to our leadership, collecting, analyzing, and reporting on data that drives operational excellence. You'll work closely with our Senior Data Analyst leadership to support operations, call center, and servicing reporting needs ultimately enabling our team leaders to make data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency and performance. You'll use a range of tools and methodologies, including statistics, technical expertise, and modern data platforms, to generate actionable insights and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. As a storyteller, you'll collect data from various sources to guide strategic decisions and support our transition to advanced analytics platforms.

About The Role


Identify and communicate patterns in operations and call center data in response to business needs using data manipulation, statistics, and data visualization
Create and support business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, reports, and methods with a focus on operations/servicing metrics and call center activity
Use data to support and challenge business solutions with stakeholders, particularly operations and collections teams
Identify, document, and use exploratory data analysis to investigate assumptions around operational performance and team efficiency
Maintain strong relationships and alignment among operations stakeholders to meet reporting and analytical objectives
Define, gather, and validate data requirements; evaluate and ensure data quality standards are met
Develop and maintain KPIs and metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Support the team's transition to Sigma as our primary reporting and visualization platform
Stay proactive and strategic—identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting before being asked
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in operations, call center management, and data analytics


About You

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology, or a related field
3+ years of experience using SQL or other querying languages to create and analyze data sets in a business setting
Experience creating KPIs/metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools
Experience executing end-to-end data analysis projects in a business environment
Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences
Working knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory, and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
Conceptual knowledge of software programming fundamentals


Preferred Qualifications


Domain expertise in operations/call center reporting and supporting operations teams with collections and call center activity metrics
Exceptional communication skills and ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders
Proven track record in data quality management and establishing data governance practices
Strategic, proactive mindset allowing you to identify opportunities and propose solutions rather than waiting for requests
Databricks SQL experience
Sigma experience for reporting and visualization
AI utilization experience and understanding of AI applications for use cases in business analytics
AWS experience


What You’ll Get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

We have given it our best to create an experience that is best-of-breed in the personal loan industry and commit even more to continuously improving it. At Rocket Loans, you’ll build a career that helps you achieve your professional goals while helping clients get the loans they need to reach their financial goals. We’re looking for innovators and those unafraid to disrupt the status -quo. With an inclusive culture and opportunities to make a positive impact, we’re here to help you foster your career growth.

Corporate Overview



Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

The direct measurability of digital media.
Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

 

Job Category

In this role you will become an expert on optimal performance and strategy of digital marketing campaigns. You will work with fellow analysts to analyze, conjecture, and manage investigations, product fixes, and optimizations to increase our yield and support our relationships with Media Partners.

You will be required to develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions. You will be required to develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making. You will need to leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment.

You will be expected to delve into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth. You will be a locus for understanding advantages, weaknesses, and deploying creative approaches to analytical problems; you will be expected to communicate these insights in an effective and timely manner, responding to the analytical needs of the business, and delivering actionable plans for improving our business.

Responsibilities

Develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions
Develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making
Leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment
Dive into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth
You will be a locus for understanding advantages, weaknesses, and deploying creative approaches to analytical problems
Communicate these insights in an effective and timely manner, responding to the analytical needs of the business, and delivering actionable plans for improving our business.

Requirements

3+years of experience in an analytical role is required
Inquisitive mindset that is willing to challenge status quo and various stakeholders
Ability to digest disparate datasets and visualize key trends or takeaways from raw datasets
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to synthesize key takeaways and present data-proven results
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills including abnormality detection, predictive analysis, market segmentation, and competitive analysis.
Experience in using SQL with enterprise datasets is required
Experience in R or Python is required
Experience with Tableau or other related Business Intelligence Tool is required
Experience with automation in an enterprise setting is a major place

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About JLG, An Oshkosh Company

JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.

As a member of the Data Analyst team, your primary responsibilities will be to identify, collect, process, and analyze datasets to help make informed business decisions. You will also assist with data analysis assignments, projects, visualization tasks, data quality improvements, and troubleshooting of data incidents.

YOUR IMPACT


Discover, acquire, explore, prepare, assess and maintain datasets from internal data sources to support analyses and ad-hoc investigative requests for projects which are function/business unit specific
Under limited supervision, responsible for data analysis assignments, projects, visualization tasks, data quality improvements, and troubleshooting of data incidents, including resolution of root causes.
Apply skills in SQL and statistical techniques to the acquisition, enrichment, and analysis of data.
Resolve incidents, changes, problems, tasks, and demands
Applies knowledge of process, people, product, data, and systems of related business functions within at least one business unit
Define Business Problems & Opportunities
Define Relevant Dimensions & Measures
Collaborating with Data Engineers, draft and test data views to meet business needs for projects
Collaborating with Data Scientists, learn and align on basic understanding of predictive and prescriptive analytics, as well as machine learning and artificial intelligence
Provide Data to Confirm Problems & Opportunities
Draft Goals, Roles, and Sustainment Plans
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. scientists, data engineers, business operations support, consultants) on data needs for solutions which may be projects focused on a single business function within a single business unit (Limited Complexity)
Apply technical writing and verbal communication skills to assist in the change management (e.g. training instructions) and on-going management of data solutions.
Actively participate in Function/Business Unit/Digital Technology Analytics Communities of Practice
Assist business' citizen analysts in building views and in analyzing, interpreting, and communicating data insights.



Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent.
Three (3) or more years of experience in Data Analysis, Information Technology, or in a related area.
Experience and proficiency with various web-based software applications including Power Bi Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
Ability to travel 20%



Standout Qualifications


Experience in data analysis, analytics
Attention to detail, problem solving, and decision-making skills.
Analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
Experience and proficiency with various web-based software applications including Power Bi Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
Experience and proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, and/or C#



WORKING CONDITIONS

The following represents general working conditions for this office-based role. Specific conditions may vary depending on business needs and individual circumstances.


This role is primarily performed in a professional office environment with standard lighting, ventilation, and temperature-controlled settings.
Duties are largely sedentary, requiring extended periods of sitting and using a computer and telephone.
Visual acuity to operate a computer and read documents is required, along with auditory ability to participate in virtual and in-person meetings.
Occasional movement within the office environment is necessary, including walking short distances, standing, or reaching for files.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.



Pay Range

$73,200.00 - $117,800.00

The above pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target pay for the position across all U.S. locations. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including the scope and responsibilities of the role, the candidate's experience, education and skills, as well as the equity of pay among team members in similar positions. Beyond offering a competitive total rewards package, we prioritize a people-first culture and offer various opportunities to support team member growth and success.

Develop metrics to measure the success and efficiency of the migration process
Create and maintain scorecards to track progress against project goals
Participate in Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives)
Collaborate with Product Owners to define and refine data-related user stories

Bachelors degree and minimum 5 years experience
Secret Security Clerance required
Demonstrated experience working with business stakeholders to understand business process, pain points, and insights that will deliver greatest value to the mission

A bit about us:

We are a well-established public educational institution serving thousands of students throughout Southwest Michigan. Our organization combines a strong community mission with an increasing focus on technology, data governance, operational effectiveness, and evidence-based decision-making.

We are currently making a significant investment in how data is collected, governed, analyzed, and used across the organization. As part of that evolution, we have redesigned our institutional research and data structure and are building a new team designed for where the organization is headed, not simply replacing positions that existed in the past.

This transformation coincides with a multi-year cloud migration and broader effort to modernize systems, reporting, automation, and access to actionable information.


Why join us?

Newly created position with an opportunity to help shape how the data function operates.
Join a newly structured three-person team, rather than stepping into a long-established hierarchy.
Be part of a significant multi-year cloud and technology transformation.
Opportunity to build dashboards, reporting, analytics, and processes that directly influence organizational decisions.
Excellent work-life balance with flexibility and the ability to work from home one day per week.
Strong annual salary increases and a robust public-sector benefits package.
Dental and vision coverage provided by the organization.
Summer Friday scheduling and a mid-winter break.
Very low employee turnover and an organization that puts significant effort into its culture.
Opportunity to learn the higher-education environment; prior higher-education experience is preferred, not required.



Job Details

The Institutional Data Analyst will support data-informed decision-making by collecting, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting institutional information to leaders and departments throughout the organization.

This individual will develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations supporting strategic planning, operational effectiveness, compliance requirements, and student-success initiatives.

This is not an entry-level analytics position. While the organization is willing to teach someone the nuances of higher education, the successful candidate needs practical experience working with data and must be capable of stepping in and performing the core technical responsibilities.

Responsibilities:

Collect, analyze, interpret, and communicate institutional data.
Develop recurring and ad hoc reports for organizational leadership and departmental stakeholders.
Build dashboards and data visualizations that make complex information easier to understand and act upon.
Support strategic planning, operational effectiveness, and organizational decision-making.
Maintain the integrity, consistency, accuracy, and usability of data across systems.
Partner with academic, administrative, student-services, financial-aid, and other internal departments.
Support regulatory and institutional reporting requirements.
Perform ad hoc analysis in response to evolving organizational questions.
Assist with data governance and reporting improvements.
Support an environment undergoing significant technology modernization and cloud migration.
Identify opportunities to improve or automate reporting and data processes.
Manage multiple priorities and projects while meeting established deadlines.

Minimum Qualifications:

About FIU

Florida International University is a Top 50, preeminent public research university with 55,000 students from all 50 states and more than 140 countries, as well as an alumni network of more than 340,000. Home to the Wall of Wind and Institute of Environment, FIU stands at the forefront of discovery and innovation. With a focus on student success, economic mobility and community engagement, FIU is redefining what it means to be a public research university.

Job Summary

The Herbert Wertheim College of Medicine is currently seeking a Data Analyst IV to join our team of professionals.

Duties Include:


Provides support to the quantitative and qualitative data analysis of learner data to support excellence in education.
Makes recommendations regarding design and data collection methodology for clinical assessments and simulation/performance-based assessments in collaboration with key leaders for the Herbert Wertheim College of Medicine (HWCOM).
Responsible for data organization, maintenance of assessment database, statistical analysis, general interpretation and reporting of results to appropriate stakeholders.

Serves as a resource for faculty conducting medical education research regarding data issues such as appropriate collection and entry methods as well as data quality.
Collaborates with HWCOM IT to identify requirements and parameters for data delivery and specifications.

Responsible for quality control of data compilation and analysis, results interpretation, visualization and reporting for the Assessment committee, a sub-committee of the Curriculum Committee that reviews all assessments for quality, effectiveness and consistency throughout period one, two, and three.
