Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Senior SQL Data Analyst

$90,000 - $95,000 + Bonus + Benefits

Current opening

Our client:
A well-established Canadian professional services organization with a national presence and a strong reputation within its industry.

This is a highly visible role offering exposure to senior leadership and key business stakeholders across the organization. Our client is looking for a strong Senior SQL Data Analyst who can work with large, complex datasets, identify trends and business drivers, and translate analysis into clear, actionable insights for the business. This opportunity is ideal for someone who combines advanced SQL and analytical capability with polished communication skills, strong business acumen, and the confidence to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Principal tasks and responsibilities include:

Write complex SQL queries to extract, validate, analyze, and interpret large volumes of business and operational data.
Analyze revenue, pricing, productivity, profitability, utilization, and other key business performance metrics to support decision-making and performance improvement.
Identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities in the data, and provide actionable recommendations to business leaders.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting packages, dashboards, scorecards, and presentations for senior leadership.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Title: Sr. Data Analyst (Oncology)
Description:
We are seeking a Sr. Data Analyst who will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing a plan to translate data into insights. The Sr. Data Analyst will provide expertise in data analysis and illustrations to articulate and monitor programs, projects, and general business success. The Sr. Data Analyst will serve as a data consultant to the assigned area and to provide complex analysis and reporting on various outcomes.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities


Align assessment strategy with strategic objectives and goals.
Translate data into insights to be used to support positive and enhanced outcomes.
Collaborate with leadership to plan and implement assessment activities, including consultation on data collection, data analysis, reporting of assessment outcomes, and using results to improve programs and services.
Prepare an annual assessment report to summarize findings across the school/division.
Lead the design of clean, impactful, user-friendly data visualizations supporting strategic goals.
Communicate findings compellingly and visually through dashboards, reports, briefing decks, stories, scorecards, executive briefings, etc. for different audiences using software like Power BI and Tableau.
Provide insights on data patterns and trends, make strategic recommendations from analysis.
Design and build data visualizations from concept to data analysis to the final step of visualization, informed by principles of good data storytelling.
Collect and analyze various complex data and information; in collaboration with others, perform statistical analysis and summarize findings inapplicable reports or other communication mediums.
Use data visualization techniques to distill and clarify complex processes or data sets.
Conduct quality assurance and review of all data visualizations to ensure accuracy, usability, and adherence to existing branding and style guidelines.
Create and maintain a library or repository of analysis documents, slides, and links to dashboards.
Work with leadership to develop an efficient system for planning and administering surveys to minimize survey fatigue and maximize the collection of actionable data.
Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's Degree.
Five years of related experience.
Additional education may substitute for required experience, and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.

CACI is searching for a Data Analyst - Visualization Specialist to join a worldwide engineering, operations, and tech refresh contract supporting Enterprise IT (EIT) capabilities and functions for our Intelligence Community (IC) customer.

Be a part of something greater than yourself and make a lasting impact at CACI.

Performing analysis to assess quality and meaning of data
Using statistical tools to identify, analyze, and interpret patterns and trends in complex data sets
Assigning numerical value to essential business functions so that business performance can be assessed and compared over periods of time.
Analyzing local, national, and global trends that impact both the organization and the industry
Preparing reports for the management stating trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data
Working with programmers, engineers, and management heads to identify process improvement opportunities, propose system modifications, and devise data governance strategies. 
Preparing final analysis reports for the stakeholders to understand the data-analysis steps, enabling them to take important decisions based on various facts and trends. 
Seasoned technical contributor
Works independently with limited supervision
May manage projects / processes
Influences others regarding system design, solutions, and procedures


Qualifications

Must be a U.S. Citizen.
Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) with ability to obtain a polygraph.
Minimum bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as data science, statistics, mathematics, or computer science.
Demonstrated experience in collecting, acquiring, extracting, integrating, inspecting, cleaning, and modeling data.
Bachelor's Degree plus 7 years of experience (or equivalent) and a minimum of 5 years in data analysis experience.

Experience with Dashboards, visualizations

A culture of integrity.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Gain support from related stakeholders for analytic solutions.
Continuing Education - takes a proactive approach to understanding industry and organization-specific business issues. Participates in structured and self-study training courses. Continually improves technical skills and learns new data sources.

Bachelor's degree in MIS, CIS, Statistics, Analytics or related IT degree or sufficient experience
Minimum of 5 years of experience in an analytics environment
Expertise in SQL

Proven ability to effectively partner, collaborate, and communicate with technical and non-technical colleagues in various business functions at all levels
Hands-on experience constructing visual analytics
Working knowledge of an analytics data warehouse and big data platform
Familiarity with fundamentals of statistics, probability and data pipelines
Strong attention to detail
Demonstrated ability to wrangle data
Comfortable working with structured and unstructured data

Strong attention to detail

Support with generating actionable insights by analyzing customer behaviour through diagnostics, correlations, and hypothesis testing to grow the business and enhance customer experience
Clearly and accurately visualize and communicate data and analytics through reports, dashboards, and presentations to maximize strategic decisions

Proven skills, education, and/or applicable certifications in:
SQL
Visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or equivalent)
Python
R or related statistical analysis and tools
Analyzing and interpreting complex datasets to generate actionable business insights
A commitment to learn, apply, champion and enrich Aritzia's Values and Business and People Leadership principles

At Aritzia, we provide market-leading compensation packages designed to reward impact through our pay-for-performance philosophy.

Amenities — Additional amenities include a private parent’s room, shower facilities with elevated complementary conveniences, bike rooms and more.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Our Mission

To create an organization that sets the standard of excellence in the compassionate treatment of behavioral health and addiction disorders.

Who are we?

Since 2015, Nevada Behavioral Health Systems (NBH) has been providing mental health and substance abuse services to residents across Nevada. By collaborating with a diverse network of experienced behavioral healthcare providers, we have built a community-based care system that offers members personalized options tailored to their individual needs. In 2023, we rebranded as NovumHealth with the expansion of our services in Arizona, California, and Utah.

Position: Data Analyst

Location: Las Vegas, NV – Onsite (This role is not eligible for Remote or Hybrid)

Starting Salary Range: $60,000 - $70,000

The starting salary range for this role is a reasonable estimate, with a goal to pay a competitive market salary focusing near the median of our pay ranges. However, final offers for all positions will be based on several factors such as experience level, education and certification, skills, and internal pay equity.

What’s the role?

The Data Analyst is responsible for leveraging data to uncover actionable insights that drive clinical, operational, and business decisions. This role requires expertise in healthcare analytics, specifically in interpreting clinical and operational data requests, managing large claims datasets, and developing data visualizations that effectively tell a story to diverse stakeholders. Proficiency with healthcare frameworks such as HEDIS, NCQA, and value-based care metrics is critical to success in this role.

What you’ll do:


Collaborate with clinical and operational teams to translate requests into actionable queries and analytics that inform decisionmaking.
Analyze large datasets, including claims data, to uncover trends, identify risks, and generate insights related to cost, utilization, and quality.
Develop dashboards and visualizations in Power BI to present findings to both technical and nontechnical audiences, tailoring presentations to executive stakeholders when necessary.
Design and implement frameworks for tracking healthcare performance metrics, including HEDIS, NCQA, and valuebased care measures.
Perform data cleaning and validation to ensure the accuracy and reliability of datasets.
Create comprehensive reports that combine storytelling with quantitative insights to drive actionable recommendations.
Identify and communicate opportunities for process improvement or cost optimization through data analysis.
Support ad hoc requests for data analysis, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of results.
Collaborate with crossfunctional teams, including clinicians, IT, and operations, to ensure alignment of data analytics with organizational goals.
Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices in healthcare analytics.


What you’ll bring:


Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics and statistical modeling.
Familiarity with electronic medical records systems.
Advanced proficiency in Power BI for developing dashboards and visualizations.
Strong SQL skills for querying relational databases and preparing datasets for analysis.
Experience with data cleaning and working with large, complex datasets.
Indepth understanding of healthcare performance metrics, including HEDIS, NCQA, and valuebased care frameworks.
Exceptional storytelling skills to present data in a meaningful way to diverse stakeholders.
Strong critical thinking and problemsolving abilities to uncover insights and recommend solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex data findings to nontechnical audiences.


What you’ll need to start:


Bachelor’s degree Analytics, Data Analytics, Health Informatics, or a related field.
Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Health Informatics, Public Health or a related field Preferred.
3+ years of experience with healthcare analytics, with a strong focus on clinical and operational data.
Proven experience with claims data analysis, including familiarity with total cost of care and utilization metrics.
Certified Healthcare Data Analyst (CHDA) certification or similar credentials.
Must pass drug screening and background check in order to start employment with NovumHealth.


What will make you stand out:


Experience in Power BI, SQL, R, and other complex data analysis.


What do we offer?


Competitive Salary
Generous vacation policy, paid holidays, and paid sick time
Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, and Vision Insurance (Employeepaid)
Optional supplemental Insurance Coverage
Company paid access to Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
401k Retirement Savings Plan
Free Financial coaching and access to Credit Lines and Personal Loans through FinFit
Preferred Auto, Home and Renter’s insurance through Allstate
Employee Discounts through Corestream
…and so much more!


Please note: This list is not reflective of all benefits. Enrollment waiting periods or eligibility criteria may apply to certain benefits. Offerings may vary based on subsidiary entity or geographic location

Additional information:


At this time, we are unable to sponsor work visas for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the job posting location on a fulltime basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Join Kyndryl as a Data Analyst where you will unlock the power of data to drive strategic decisions and shape the future of our business. As a key member of our team, you will harness your expertise in basic statistics, business fundamentals, and communication to uncover valuable insights and transform raw data into rigorous visualizations and compelling stories.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work closely with our customers as part of a top-notch team. You will dive deep into vast IT datasets, unraveling the mysteries hidden within, and discovering trends and patterns that will revolutionize our customers' understanding of their own landscapes. Armed with your advanced analytical skills, you will draw compelling conclusions and develop data-driven insights that will directly impact their decision-making processes.

Your role goes beyond traditional data analysis. You will be a trusted advisor, utilizing your domain expertise, critical thinking, and consulting skills to unravel complex business problems and translate them into innovative solutions. Your proficiency in cutting-edge software tools and technologies will empower you to gather, explore, and prepare data – ensuring it is primed for analysis, business intelligence, and insightful visualizations.

Collaboration will be at the heart of your work. As a Data Analyst at Kyndryl, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, pooling together your collective expertise to gather, structure, organize, and clean data. Together, we will ensure the data is in its finest form, ready to deliver actionable insights.

Your unique ability to communicate and empathize with stakeholders will be invaluable. By understanding the business objectives and success criteria of each project, you will align your data analysis efforts seamlessly with our overarching goals. With your mastery of business valuation, decision-making, project scoping, and storytelling, you will transform data into meaningful narratives that drive real-world impact.

At Kyndryl, we believe that data holds immense potential, and we are committed to helping you unlock that potential. You will have access to vast repositories of data, empowering you to delve deep to determine root causes of defects and variation. By gaining a comprehensive understanding of the data and its specific purpose, you will be at the forefront of driving innovation and making a difference.

If you are ready to unleash your analytical ability, collaborate with industry experts, and shape the future of data-driven decision making, then join us as a Data Analyst at Kyndryl. Together, we will harness the power of data to redefine what is possible and create a future filled with limitless possibilities.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

This position is for a government client and we can only hire US citizens or full green card holders.

Required Skills, Experience and Circumstances:


Minimum of 5+ years of data analysis experience
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills
Communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, while maintaining a high level of attention to detail


Preferred Skills and Experience:


Degree in a quantitative discipline, such as industrial engineering, finance, or economics
Knowledge of data analysis tools and programming languages (e.g. Looker, Power BI, QuickSight, BigQuery, Azure Synapse, Python, R, or SQL)
Professional certification, e.g., ASQ Six Sigma
Cloud platform certification, e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics – Specialty, Google Cloud Looker Business Analyst, or Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate


Compensation:

The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is $77,040 to $146,640 based on a full-time schedule. Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job-related skills and experience. For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement.

There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations:

California (San Francisco Bay Area): $92,520 to $175,800

California (All Other): $84,840 to $161,160

Colorado: $77,040 to $146,640

Massachusetts: $77,040 to $161,160

New York City: $92,520 to $175,800

Washington: $84,840 to $161,160

Washington DC: $84,840 to $161,160

This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.

Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG — the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users
Write complex SQL queries to analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets
Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems


Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance
Analyzing deduction and dispute data to identify operational inefficiencies
Designing analytics that help brands forecast sales and demand
Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights


What We're Looking For

Required


4+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics roles
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong experience building dashboards and analytical reports
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong communication skills working with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience with BI tools (Omni, Looker, Mode, etc.)
Experience working with financial, retail, or operational datasets
Comfort working directly with users
Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles
Technical or quantitative degree


🌴 Perks + Benefits


Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
401(k) through Vestwell
Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

Compensation Range: $175K - $210K

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:

Essential Functions –


Design and deploy analytics and visualization solutions.
Obtain and analyze raw data from multiple disparate sources to perform core job duties and to answer questions posed by internal or external customers.
Develop reports and analytics according to requestor requirements.
Develop concise summaries of analytical exercises and clearly define recommendations and next steps
Ability to write SQL queries to analyze and extract data from database and warehouse.
Ability to create flowcharts and diagrams to illustrate how the data will be modeled, sourced, transformed, stored, and presented.
Compile and analyze data, interpret trends, fluctuations, and other changes.
Contribute to the management and design of the business intelligence and data warehouse environments, including data sources, security, and metadata.
Consult with business partners and their teams to challenge current processes by asking targeted questions and interpreting ambiguity through deepened knowledge of business function needs and reporting opportunities.
Unearth insights from large and diverse sets of data to tell compelling stories through dashboards and visualizations, guiding strategic decision-making.
Ability to self-track and manage projects and tasks in agile tools.
Continuously improve modeling data for actionable insights and processes improvement.
Participate in finding and implementing technology solutions and business processes by providing requirements documentation, use cases, subject matter expertise, and design input.


Prerequisite Qualifications –


Education/Degree Required- Bachelor's Degree at College or University is required.
Years of Experience Required- Requires minimum (2) two years of experience as a data analyst with proven experience with business intelligence, and data manipulation tools.
Knowledge/Skills Required- Analytical Skills: Data analysts work with large amounts of data: facts, figures, and number crunching. You will need to see through the data and analyze it to find conclusions.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Title: Data Analyst (HQ)
Description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.

Koniag Services Inc., a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a talented and experienced Data Analyst to support headquarters-level data analysis, performance reporting, and strategic decision support for our IT Call Center program operations in the Washington, DC area. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional with a strong command of data analytics, reporting tools, and visualization platforms, and a demonstrated ability to synthesize complex, multi-site operational data into clear and compelling insights for senior leadership and government stakeholders. They bring a strategic perspective, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-visibility headquarters environment. Ability to obtain a government security clearance may be required to support Koniag Services Inc. and our government customers. This position is located in the Washington, DC area.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.

Position Description

The Headquarters Data Analyst will serve as a central analytical resource supporting the enterprise-wide performance monitoring, reporting, and data governance functions of the IT Call Center program. This individual will work closely with the Senior Program Manager, program leadership, and site-level operations teams to aggregate, analyze, and present program-wide performance data, support strategic planning activities, and ensure that all headquarters-level reporting requirements are met with accuracy and consistency. Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:


Serve as the primary data analyst supporting headquarters-level program performance monitoring, aggregating and analyzing operational data from multiple call center sites to provide a comprehensive, enterprise-wide view of program performance.
Design, develop, and maintain advanced performance dashboards, scorecards, and analytical reports that provide senior program leadership and government stakeholders with timely, accurate, and actionable visibility into program-wide call center performance metrics.
Collect, validate, and consolidate operational data submissions from site-level operations teams, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and completeness of all data inputs prior to incorporation into headquarters-level reports and briefings.
Conduct in-depth analysis of program-wide operational data including call volumes, ticket trends, SLA compliance, first call resolution rates, escalation patterns, workforce utilization, and customer satisfaction scores, identifying cross-site trends, performance gaps, and strategic improvement opportunities.
Lead the preparation and quality assurance review of all headquarters-level customer-facing deliverables including monthly and quarterly performance reports, program scorecards, and executive briefing materials for senior government leadership.
Support the Senior Program Manager and headquarters leadership team in the development of data-driven strategic recommendations, program improvement initiatives, and resource allocation strategies informed by enterprise performance data.
Develop and maintain a program-wide operational metrics baseline and performance benchmarking framework, conducting regular comparisons across sites and against industry standards to identify best practices and areas requiring targeted improvement.
Collaborate with site-level operations analysts and program staff to ensure alignment of data definitions, reporting methodologies, and performance measurement standards across all program locations.
Support data governance activities including the development and enforcement of data quality standards, reporting templates, data dictionary maintenance, and analytical process documentation.
Assist in the management and continuous improvement of the program's data infrastructure, including ITSM platform reporting configurations, data extraction processes, and dashboard maintenance.
Prepare and present analytical findings, program performance summaries, and strategic recommendations to senior program leadership and government stakeholders in both written and verbal formats.
Respond to ad hoc data requests and analytical tasks from headquarters leadership and government stakeholders, delivering accurate, insightful, and well-presented outputs within established timelines.
Support continuous improvement initiatives at the headquarters level by identifying cross-site operational inefficiencies, analyzing root causes, and developing data-supported improvement recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities as needed, including supporting proposal efforts with program performance data, analytical capability narratives, and past performance documentation.


Required

Education and Experience:


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Administration, Information Technology, Statistics, Operations Management, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
4+ years of experience in a data analysis, business intelligence, or operations analysis role, with demonstrated experience supporting enterprise-level or multi-site reporting functions.
Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining performance dashboards, analytical reports, and data visualization products for senior leadership and executive audiences.
Experience working within a federal government contracting environment.
Experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources to produce consolidated, enterprise-level analytical outputs.


Preferred


Master's degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field.
Prior experience supporting headquarters or enterprise-level data analysis functions for a federal IT call center, service desk, or IT managed services program.
Experience working in a high-visibility, senior leadership-facing analytical role within a government contracting environment.


Required Skills And Competencies


Exceptional communication skills in English – both written and oral – with the ability to present complex data findings, analytical insights, and strategic recommendations clearly and persuasively to executive-level government stakeholders and senior program leadership.
Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to aggregate, validate, and interpret large volumes of multi-source operational data to identify enterprise-wide trends, performance patterns, and strategic improvement opportunities.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, dynamic charting, and macro development for sophisticated operational reporting and analysis.
Advanced proficiency in data visualization platforms such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools, with demonstrated experience designing executive-level dashboards and interactive, multi-site analytical reports.
Proficiency in data querying languages such as SQL for extracting, transforming, and analyzing data from relational databases and ITSM platforms.
Hands-on experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or equivalent systems, including experience extracting and analyzing platform data for enterprise reporting purposes.
Working knowledge of IT service management principles and ITIL frameworks, including SLA governance, incident management, and continuous service improvement.
Strong data governance skills with experience developing and enforcing data quality standards, reporting templates, and analytical process documentation.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint for documentation, communication, and reporting purposes.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority deliverables simultaneously, maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced headquarters environment.
Ability to obtain and maintain a government security clearance as required.


Desired Skills And Competencies


Active government security clearance (Secret or higher).
ITIL Foundation certification or higher (ITIL Intermediate or ITIL 4 Managing Professional).
Experience with advanced analytics or statistical programming languages such as Python or R for large-scale data analysis and modeling.
Lean Six Sigma White Belt, Yellow Belt, or Green Belt certification.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or demonstrated project management experience supporting analytical programs.
Experience with enterprise data warehouse platforms, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, or equivalent data integration tools.
Familiarity with federal IT governance frameworks and reporting requirements such as FITARA, FedRAMP, or NIST cybersecurity standards.
Experience supporting quality assurance (QA) programs and integrating customer satisfaction data into enterprise performance reporting frameworks.
Familiarity with workforce management platforms and call center performance analytics tools used in a multi-site operational environment.
Experience contributing to business development efforts including proposal writing, analytical capability development, and past performance documentation.
Knowledge of Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and reporting within a federal contract environment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity in all decisions related to employment, promotion, wages, benefits, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

The Industry and Security Analysis Group (ISAG) within JOID provides analytical, technical, and program support to promote, grow, and protect the U.S. industrial base. ISAG’s support spans the Department of Defense (DOD), Department of Commerce, and other agencies to deliver critical decision support to national security leaders. Our team informs policy decisions, enables execution of comprehensive strategies and monitors and reports on the effectiveness of implementation. This enables senior leaders to execute strategies for developing and sustaining a robust industrial base that meets our nation’s strategic resource objectives. From policy to practice, we are a team of economic and national security professionals providing innovative solutions for our Nation’s most pressing security challenges.

We have an immediate need for a Sr. Data Analyst to provide onsite support out of the Pentagon and/or Mark Center in Alexandria, VA.

Responsibilities

The Sr. Data Analyst will support the newly formed Assistant Secretary of War for International Armaments Cooperation. Provide a dedicated data analytics capability in converting large volumes of data from disparate sources into decision-quality products. Manage data extraction, cleansing, and normalization from Department of War data platforms and other validated sources to support analysis and visualization for senior government leaders. Sources include Project Management Resource Tools (PMRT), Foreign Military Sales Single Tracking System (STS), International Agreements Tracking System (IATS), and Advana. Assist with streamlining ASW IAC workflows via PowerBI and PowerAutomate tools.

Qualifications

Required:


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field
3+ years of experience developing automated data pipelines, processing complex government datasets, and building business intelligence dashboards
Expert proficiency with PowerBI, PowerAutomate, and Sharepoint systems
Active Secret clearance
Able to work fully onsite based on client needs


Desired


Active TS/SCI clearance
5+ years of experience


Pay Range Information

At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Title: Data Analyst - Power BI
Description:
Piper Companies is seeking a Data Analyst to join a mission‑driven Digital Transformation team focused on reshaping how patients and providers interact through innovative digital solutions. This role plays a key part in enabling data‑driven decision making by transforming complex data into actionable insights that drive operational efficiency, product performance, and meaningful business outcomes. This position is fully remote, with occasional travel for team‑building on client site.

Overview

In this role, you will partner with product, clinical, operational, and analytics stakeholders to understand business objectives, prepare and model data, and deliver reporting that clearly communicates progress toward key product goals. You will support the development of KPIs, build Power BI dashboards, and provide analytical insights that guide product and operational decisions. You will work under the supervision of the Sr. Director of Data & Analytics and collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Identify, define, and document key performance metrics for digital products, ensuring consistent and repeatable KPI definitions.
Clean, model, and prepare data from the enterprise data warehouse and other primary sources using SQL, Python/Pandas, and Databricks.
Develop, maintain, and optimize Power BI dashboards and visualizations that clearly communicate product performance to stakeholders.
Respond to ad‑hoc reporting requests by gathering and analyzing data to answer business and operational questions.
Communicate analytical findings through clear written summaries, presentations, and discussions with product, clinical, and operational teams.
Collaborate with data scientists and analytics staff to operationalize data workflows and support modeling efforts.
Partner with product teams to understand business needs, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide data‑driven recommendations.
Participate in departmental meetings, cross‑functional committees, and quality/service improvement initiatives.
Adhere to departmental policies, procedures, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
Perform additional duties as assigned.


Qualifications

Education & Training


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.


Experience


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis or a related field.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Strong data modeling and analysis skills, including experience with Databricks, Python/Pandas, and SQL.
Proficiency working with large relational databases (Microsoft SQL Server preferred).
Experience with version control tools such as GitHub or Azure DevOps.
Advanced Power BI skills, including building dashboards, visuals, and DAX measures.
Strong Excel proficiency.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights for diverse audiences.


Compensation & Benefits


Salary: $105,000 – $115,000 annually.
Work Environment: Fully remote with occasional travel for team‑building.
Comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO, holidays, and sick leave as required by law.

Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

Description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our San Francisco or Toronto offices, and to translate complex healthcare and product data into clear, actionable insights that drive strategy and business impact. You are a fit if you thrive in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, own analytical deep work end to end, and enjoy influencing decisions through rigorous, well-communicated analysis.

What you’ll do:


Work cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success to scope and implement trusted business metrics, proactively identify data integrity issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes to inform business priorities.
Communicate analysis results and outcomes clearly and tailor messaging based on the audience.
Help build and evolve our analytical foundation, including event instrumentation, metric frameworks, and scalable self-serve analytics tools.
Mentor other analysts and raise the bar for data storytelling, analytical rigor, and stakeholder influence across the organization.


What we look for:


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
5+ years of experience using SQL or similar big data querying languages.
5+ years of experience with a programming language such as Python or R.
5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques.
Strong experience working with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, including modeling and analyzing customer, pipeline, and revenue data.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex findings from data and models into compelling insights for technical and non-technical audiences.


Bonus (Nice to have):


Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or a related field.
Experience working with sales organizations and familiarity with funnel and pipeline processes.
Strong mentorship and leadership skills, with a track record of elevating scientific standards and developing junior talent across teams.


Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:


Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
Paid parental leave.
A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.


(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page.

Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.

Partner with subject matter experts to understand root cause patterns within data

Troubleshooting and audit trail development

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst – Mortgage Analytics




We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to join a mortgage analytics team supporting business performance, risk monitoring, reporting, and data-driven decision-making. This is a hands-on role for an analyst who can step in, quickly learn new data environments, and begin delivering meaningful insights from complex datasets.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and a background in mortgage, lending, financial services, or a related industry. Experience with dashboard development and visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI is also highly valued.




What You'll Do

Analyze large and complex mortgage, lending, financial, and operational datasets to identify trends, performance drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Extract, organize, clean, validate, and transform data from multiple sources.
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical tools for business and senior management audiences.
Take ownership of existing dashboards and reporting solutions, making enhancements and changes as business needs evolve.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable business insights and recommendations.
Support portfolio performance monitoring, risk analysis, forecasting, and other strategic analytical initiatives.
Prepare analysis and reporting for senior management and external stakeholders, including regulatory-related reporting.
Conduct ad hoc and exploratory analysis to answer evolving business questions.
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, automation, and analytical processes.
Collaborate with business, risk, finance, data, and operations teams to understand requirements and deliver effective analytical solutions.




What You'll Bring

4+ years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, financial analysis, or a related analytical field.
Strong/advanced SQL skills are required, including experience querying, transforming, validating, and analyzing large datasets.
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports using Tableau, Power BI, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with Python, SAS, R, or another statistical/analytical programming language is a plus.
Experience in mortgage, lending, banking, financial services, or another credit-related environment is strongly preferred.
Experience with mortgage or loan performance data is particularly valuable; experience with other financial products, such as credit cards, may also be relevant.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to work with complex data and turn analysis into clear business insights.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and manage multiple priorities.
Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field preferred.




What You'll Bring to the Team

This is an opportunity to join an established analytics team where you will have meaningful ownership of reporting, dashboards, and analytical deliverables. You will work closely with experienced analysts and business stakeholders while gaining a deeper understanding of mortgage and lending data.




The successful candidate will be someone who enjoys working hands-on with data, is comfortable asking questions and investigating problems, and can move from raw data → analysis → insights → business recommendations.




If you are an experienced data analyst with strong SQL skills and a background in mortgage, lending, or financial services, we'd like to hear from you.
