Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

Konrad is a next-generation digital consultancy. We are dedicated to solving complex business problems for our global clients with creative and forward-thinking solutions. Our employees enjoy a culture built on innovation and a commitment to creating best-in-class digital products in use by hundreds of millions of consumers around the world. We hire exceptionally smart, analytical, and hard-working people who are lifelong learners.

About The Role

As a Senior Data Analyst, you are an experienced analytics professional who leads analytical initiatives and partners directly with stakeholders to shape data-informed strategy. You drive the design and delivery of analytics and reporting solutions that enable clients to understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident business decisions.

You work closely with consultants, data engineers, developers, designers and clients across multiple engagements. You own analytical problem-solving from discovery to delivery, mentor junior analysts, and help establish best practices across data modeling, experimentation, and reporting.

You are curious, pragmatic, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You translate complex business problems into structured analysis, proactively surface insights, and influence decisions through clear communication and thoughtful storytelling.

What You’ll Do


Partner with client and internal stakeholders to define business questions, success metrics, and measurement strategies
Lead analytical projects end-to-end including discovery, data validation, analysis, and presentation of recommendations
Design and implement scalable dashboards and reporting frameworks for executive and operational decision-making
Develop and maintain metric definitions, documentation, and analytics standards across engagements
Perform deep-dive analyses to identify drivers, opportunities, and risks across product and business performance
Design and evaluate A/B tests and experimentation strategies, including statistical interpretation and recommendations
Collaborate with data engineers to design data models and ensure reliable, high-quality reporting layers
Mentor junior analysts and review analytical work to ensure quality and rigor
Communicate insights through clear narratives, visualizations, and executive-level presentations
Identify and implement improvements to analytics workflows, governance, and data quality processes


Qualifications


Minimum 4+ years of experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, product analytics, or consulting analytics role
Strong SQL expertise and experience querying cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery)
Proficiency in Python, R, or similar language for data analysis and automation
Advanced experience with Business Intelligence and visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Strong understanding of data modeling, dimensional modeling, and analytics architecture concepts
Experience defining KPIs, measurement frameworks, and decision metrics
Hands-on experience designing and analyzing experiments (A/B testing, causal inference, statistical interpretation)
Proven ability to independently structure ambiguous problems and deliver actionable insights
Experience working directly with stakeholders and presenting to leadership audiences
Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to influence decisions Experience mentoring analysts or reviewing analytical work
Familiarity with data governance, privacy, and security best practices


Perks and Benefits


Comprehensive Health & Wellness Benefits Package
Retirement Planning
Parental Leave Program
Flexible Working Hours
Work from Home Flexibility
Service Recognition Programs
Socials, Outings & Retreats
Culture of Learning & Development


Bonus Points

Have you taken any courses at BrainStation? A lot of our design and development best practices and processes are taught during our courses, make sure to highlight this experience in your cover letter if you have!

Konrad is committed to maintaining a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status will receive consideration for employment. If you have any accessibility requirements or concerns regarding the hiring process or employment with us, please notify us so we can provide suitable accommodation.

The estimated compensation for this position is $105,000 to $115,000. This is an estimate and a compensation offer will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities and alignment with market data.

While we sincerely appreciate all applications, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description & Responsibilities

Persistent Systems is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team in our New York City headquarters. The Data Analyst will transform complex operational, financial, customer, product, and program data into accurate, timely, and actionable insights. This role will build trusted datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and analyses that help leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, manage risk, and make evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined problem solver and an effective "data translator" who can move comfortably between business questions and technical details. They combine strong SQL, data preparation, visualization, statistical reasoning, and stakeholder communication skills with a sharp eye for data quality and user experience.

Position Responsibilities


Own analytical work from requirements discovery and source-data assessment through transformation, modeling, validation, visualization, delivery, and ongoing support
Partner with leaders and subject-matter experts across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Product, and other functions to define key performance indicators (KPIs), reporting logic, and success measures
Develop reliable, reusable analytics assets and clear documentation so that metrics, assumptions, transformations, and data lineage can be understood and maintained
Apply statistical and analytical methods appropriate to the business question, communicate uncertainty and limitations, and distinguish correlation from evidence of causation
Promote secure, governed, accessible, and responsible use of data while improving self-service analytics across the organization
Design, build, and maintain intuitive dashboards, scorecards, semantic models, and recurring reports using Power BI as the primary platform and Tableau where appropriate
Write, review, and optimize complex SQL queries across relational databases, cloud warehouses, and Lakehouse platforms; reconcile results to source systems and explain query logic
Clean, profile, map, join, and transform structured and semi-structured data using Power Query, Python/pandas, spreadsheets, and related tools; design fact and dimension models using star-schema principles
Build or contribute to repeatable extraction, transformation, and loading workflows using frameworks and platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, and Databricks; monitor failures and document lineage
Analyze historical and current data to identify trends, drivers, anomalies, risks, and opportunities; perform segmentation, variance analysis, forecasting, cohort analysis, and experiment analysis when relevant
Create validation rules, reconciliations, exception reporting, and quality checks; investigate discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate durable fixes with data owners and engineering teams
Translate open-ended questions into measurable definitions, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and analytics plans; establish consistent KPI definitions and a shared business glossary
Reduce manual reporting through scheduled refreshes, parameterized workflows, Power Automate, reusable templates, and governed self-service datasets
Present concise findings and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences, using accessible visual design and clear narrative rather than relying on charts alone
Support embedded or custom analytics experiences using JavaScript visualization libraries and component-based charting tools such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, Chart.js, and shadcn/ui chart components
Explore responsible uses of Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and generative AI frameworks to accelerate discovery, natural-language analytics, documentation, and workflow assistance while validating outputs against trusted data


Job Qualifications & Experience

Minimum Qualifications


2–5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related role
Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, finance, computer science, information systems, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
Advanced proficiency in SQL, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregation, query validation, and performance-aware analysis
Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modeling, interactive report design, refresh strategies, workspace management, and row-level security; comparable Tableau depth is also valued
Advanced spreadsheet skills and practical experience reconciling, cleaning, and validating data from multiple sources
Working knowledge of dimensional data modeling, KPI design, data dictionaries, ETL/ELT concepts, and source-to-target mapping
Experience using Python with pandas and/or R for data manipulation, exploratory analysis, or statistical work
Understanding of descriptive statistics, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and common analytical pitfalls
Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, manage multiple priorities, communicate findings clearly, and influence decisions with evidence
Must have a United States Security Clearance or be able to obtain a United States Security Clearance


Relevant Certifications Or Credentials, Such As


Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)
Tableau Certified Data Analyst
Tableau Desktop Specialist certification
Experience operating in a regulated, security-sensitive, government, or defense-adjacent environment


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with ETL/ELT frameworks and orchestration platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, Databricks, or comparable tools
Experience building solutions with Power Platform, Power Apps, and Power Automate, including governed connections to enterprise data
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry for secure AI-assisted analytics, agent experiences, or workflow augmentation
Familiarity with generative AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex and the ability to identify appropriate, verifiable analytics use cases
Experience with JavaScript visualization libraries such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, or Chart.js, including shadcn/ui chart components built on Recharts
Experience with cloud data warehouses or Lakehouse platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift
Experience with Git, analytics testing, version-controlled SQL or semantic models, CI/CD, and collaborative development practices
Experience with data catalogs, lineage, access controls, sensitivity labels, or governance platforms such as Microsoft Purview
Experience designing experiments, performing A/B test analysis, building forecasts, or applying regression and other classical statistical methods


The total compensation for this role can vary from $133,000 to $166,000 a year based on individual qualifications. Eligibility for yearly discretionary bonus. Persistent Systems, LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; paid time off (sick time and vacation time); flexible spending accounts; 401(k) plan with company match; fitness membership reimbursement; tuition assistance; mental health benefits; and pet discounts.

Company Overview

Headquartered in New York City since 2007, Persistent Systems, LLC is a global communications technology company which develops, manufactures, and integrates a patented and secure Mobile Ad Hoc Networking (MANET) system: Wave Relay®. The company’s industry leading R&D team has designed wireless networking protocols to support their cutting-edge Wave Relay® system and technology. Wave Relay® is capable of running data, video, voice and other applications under the most difficult and unpredictable conditions. Their suite of products is field proven and utilized in Commercial, Military, Government, Industrial, Agriculture, Robotics, and Unmanned System markets.

How analytics supports pricing, transportation, customer service, and business strategy

Excellent benefits including:

Strong data modeling and analysis skills, including experience with Databricks, Python/Pandas, and SQL.

Experience with version control tools such as GitHub or Azure DevOps.
Advanced Power BI skills, including building dashboards, visuals, and DAX measures.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Job Summary

The Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) is seeking experienced candidates for a Data Analyst IV - Advanced Analytics & Reporting position within Access & Eligibility Services (AES), Data Management & Reporting team. The position supports HHSC’s mission to connect Texans to essential services by delivering advanced analytics, ensuring data quality, and providing operational decision support to internal teams.

Data Analyst IV functions as a senior individual contributor and hybrid analyst/mentor. The role performs complex analytical work under minimal supervision, applies independent judgment, mentors and reviews the work of other analysts, and delivers clear, actionable insights to non‑technical stakeholders. These positions do not have formal supervisory authority.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

Advanced Analytics & Insight Generation (30%)


Performs advanced SQL analysis to identify trends, patterns, and performance drivers.
Develops predictive and trend analyses to support operational planning and proactive decision‑making.
Translates complex analyses into clear findings and actionable recommendations for internal stakeholders.
Creates reusable analytical methods and standardized approaches to improve efficiency and consistency.


Data Quality & Validation (25%)


Designs and executes data validation, reconciliation, and quality audits across SQL Server, Oracle, and Snowflake.
Establishes and documents data quality rules, business definitions, and acceptance criteria.
Partners with business and technical teams to resolve data quality issues and prevent recurrence.
Monitors key data quality indicators and supports continuous improvement efforts.


Operational Decision Support & Reporting (20%)


Develops and maintains Power BI semantic models, dashboards, and reports tailored to business needs.
Provides clear data narratives, briefings, and written summaries in plain language.
Implements Power Automate workflows to streamline recurring reporting and operational processes.
Supports self‑service analytics while ensuring usability, accuracy, and performance.


Data Pipelines & Performance (15%)


Designs, optimizes, and troubleshoots ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple data platforms.
Collaborates with peers on data modeling and performance tuning.
Contributes to future‑state analytics solutions, including readiness for Databricks adoption.


Mentorship & Peer Review (10%)


Mentors and reviews the work of lower‑level data analysts.
Shares best practices for SQL, data modeling, validation, visualization, and documentation.
Assists with onboarding and skill development for analysts within the team.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities (KSAs)


Skill in advanced proficiency in SQL, including complex queries, window functions, and performance tuning.
Skills in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, and dashboard development.
Skill in designing and supporting ETL/ELT data pipelines.
Skill in using Power Automate to support operational workflows.
Strong understanding of data quality, validation, reconciliation, and documentation practices.
Ability to perform predictive and trend analysis aligned with business needs.
Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to non‑technical audiences.
Demonstrated accuracy, attention to detail, data integrity, curiosity, and problem‑solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with business analysts, developers, and program staff.
Ability to exercise independent judgment and work effectively with minimal supervision.
Ability to perform predictive or trend analysis in an operational or program environment.
Knowledge of health and human services or government/public sector settings.
Knowledge in working with Snowflake and cross‑platform SQL environments (SQL Server and Oracle).
Skilled with R, Python, SPSS, and advanced Excel.


Registrations, Licensure Requirements, or Certifications


Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL‑300) – Preferred
Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP‑600) – Preferred
Microsoft Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL‑200) – Preferred
Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) – Preferred
IIBA Certification in Business Data Analytics (CBDA) – Preferred
DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) – Preferred


Initial Screening Criteria


Two (2) years of professional experience as a data analyst performing advanced SQL analysis, data transformation, advanced reporting (Power BI or Tableau), and data quality validation.
Minimum of four (4) years of relevant professional experience.


Additional Information


This position is 100% remote within the State of Texas.
Candidates must reside in the State of Texas by their official start date.
Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
Employees must maintain reliable internet connectivity and webcam capability during work hours.
Selected applicants must pass a background check and other required due diligence.

Title: Principal Data Analyst
Description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.

Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

Role Overview
The Principal Data Analyst will play a key role in executing Filevine’s data and analytics initiatives. Reporting directly to executive leadership, this individual will manage daily analytics operations, deliver corporate metrics, and produce actionable insights to support operational excellence and strategic decision-making across the organization. This position requires a balance of strong technical proficiency, business acumen, and solid communication skills.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on analytical practitioner who can design and deliver high-quality analyses while engaging confidently with executive stakeholders.

Responsibilities:


Work closely with the CEO on ad-hoc or other impromptu projects, providing rapid analytical support and insights.
Lead daily operations for the corporate analytics function, overseeing the development and delivery of executive-level dashboards, KPIs, and routine reporting.
Partner with functional leaders to identify and interpret key trends across product usage, customer health, financial performance, and organizational initiatives.
Conduct complex analyses that inform strategic priorities and operational decisions.
Build and maintain robust data pipelines and models within Domo, integrating data from Salesforce, Snowflake, HubSpot, the Filevine Platform, and other enterprise systems.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and precision across all reporting outputs.
Implement frameworks for tracking key SaaS metrics and KPIs, including ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, customer engagement, and retention.
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex data into actionable business insights.
Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Product, and Customer Success teams to align analytics outputs with organizational goals.





Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, or a related field.
4–6+ years of experience in data analytics or business intelligence, with experience leading ad-hoc projects.
Demonstrated ability to guide projects and support team development.
Expertise in SQL and hands-on experience working with large, complex data environments.
Strong proficiency with Domo or equivalent BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
Solid understanding of Salesforce data structures and data integration practices.
Familiarity with SaaS business models and key financial metrics.
Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively present insights to senior stakeholders.
High attention to detail, with a commitment to accuracy, data governance, and analytical rigor.





Work Location Expectation: This position is based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Salt Lake City or New York offices. Candidates residing in or near these metro areas are expected to work on a hybrid (2-3 days in-office/week) or fully onsite basis.

Cool Company Benefits:


A dynamic, rapidly growing company, focused on helping organizations thrive
Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (for full-time employees)
Competitive & Fair Pay
Maternity & paternity leave (for full-time employees)
Short & long-term disability
Opportunity to learn from a dedicated leadership team
Top-of-the-line company swag

The Data Analyst IV position helps Provider Finance use data to make informed decisions. You’ll write data queries, review data quality, protect confidential information and work with internal and external partners to understand their data needs. Collects, queries, cleans, prunes, and analyzes Provider Finance data using standard statistical tools, applications, methods, and techniques. 20%

Statistics and the analysis of data sets.

Data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.

Using computers and applicable software.

Conducting data searches and evaluating and translating large amounts of data.

Critical thinking, problem analysis, and devising effective solutions.

Prepare reports and maintain accuracy and attention to detail.

Communicate effectively.

Required

Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with a bachelor's degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, data science, computer science, information systems, finance, or a related field.

Experience with Provider Finance, Medicaid, health care finance, reimbursement, or public-sector programs.

À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.

About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.




What We Offer

** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
A MacBook computer on your first day.
3 weeks vacation.
5 personal days to use at your discretion.
A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.




About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.




Key Responsibilities

Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
Special projects, and other duties as required.




Candidate Qualifications

Strong problem solving skills.
2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
Understanding of statistical principles.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Fully bilingual in English and French.
Ability to coordinate across teams.




Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.


Ce que nous offrons

  • ** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
  • Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
  • Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
  • Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
  • Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
  • Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
  • 3 semaines de vacances par année.
  • 5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
  • Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
  • Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
  • Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
  • La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.


Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.


Responsabilités

  • Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
  • Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
  • Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
  • Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
  • Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
  • Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.


Exigences

  • D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
  • 2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
  • Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
  • Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
  • Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
  • Bilinguisme français et anglais.
  • Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.


La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.

About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.


What We Offer

  • ** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
  • 100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
  • Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
  • Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
  • Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
  • A MacBook computer on your first day.
  • 3 weeks vacation.
  • 5 personal days to use at your discretion.
  • A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
  • The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
  • A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.


About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
  • Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
  • Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
  • Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
  • Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
  • Special projects, and other duties as required.


Candidate Qualifications

  • Strong problem solving skills.
  • 2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
  • Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
  • Understanding of statistical principles.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Fully bilingual in English and French.
  • Ability to coordinate across teams.


Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

Acquire data from various internal and external data sources
Create reports for internal teams/external clients

Derive and communicate data insights

Ability to work extended hours as needed

Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

The direct measurability of digital media.
Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

 

Job Category

In this role you will become an expert on optimal performance and strategy of digital marketing campaigns. You will work with fellow analysts to analyze, conjecture, and manage investigations, product fixes, and optimizations to increase our yield and support our relationships with Media Partners.

You will be required to develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions. You will be required to develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making. You will need to leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment.

You will be expected to delve into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth. You will be a locus for understanding advantages, weaknesses, and deploying creative approaches to analytical problems; you will be expected to communicate these insights in an effective and timely manner, responding to the analytical needs of the business, and delivering actionable plans for improving our business.

Develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions
Develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making
Leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment
Dive into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth
You will be a locus for understanding advantages, weaknesses, and deploying creative approaches to analytical problems
Communicate these insights in an effective and timely manner, responding to the analytical needs of the business, and delivering actionable plans for improving our business.

Requirements

3+years of experience in an analytical role is required
Inquisitive mindset that is willing to challenge status quo and various stakeholders
Ability to digest disparate datasets and visualize key trends or takeaways from raw datasets
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to synthesize key takeaways and present data-proven results
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills including abnormality detection, predictive analysis, market segmentation, and competitive analysis.
Experience in using SQL with enterprise datasets is required
Experience in R or Python is required
Experience with Tableau or other related Business Intelligence Tool is required
Experience with automation in an enterprise setting is a major place

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About JLG, An Oshkosh Company

JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.

As a member of the Data Analyst team, your primary responsibilities will be to identify, collect, process, and analyze datasets to help make informed business decisions. You will also assist with data analysis assignments, projects, visualization tasks, data quality improvements, and troubleshooting of data incidents.

YOUR IMPACT


Discover, acquire, explore, prepare, assess and maintain datasets from internal data sources to support analyses and ad-hoc investigative requests for projects which are function/business unit specific
Under limited supervision, responsible for data analysis assignments, projects, visualization tasks, data quality improvements, and troubleshooting of data incidents, including resolution of root causes.
Apply skills in SQL and statistical techniques to the acquisition, enrichment, and analysis of data.
Resolve incidents, changes, problems, tasks, and demands
Applies knowledge of process, people, product, data, and systems of related business functions within at least one business unit
Define Business Problems & Opportunities
Define Relevant Dimensions & Measures
Collaborating with Data Engineers, draft and test data views to meet business needs for projects
Collaborating with Data Scientists, learn and align on basic understanding of predictive and prescriptive analytics, as well as machine learning and artificial intelligence
Provide Data to Confirm Problems & Opportunities
Draft Goals, Roles, and Sustainment Plans
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. scientists, data engineers, business operations support, consultants) on data needs for solutions which may be projects focused on a single business function within a single business unit (Limited Complexity)
Apply technical writing and verbal communication skills to assist in the change management (e.g. training instructions) and on-going management of data solutions.
Actively participate in Function/Business Unit/Digital Technology Analytics Communities of Practice
Assist business' citizen analysts in building views and in analyzing, interpreting, and communicating data insights.



Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent.
Three (3) or more years of experience in Data Analysis, Information Technology, or in a related area.
Experience and proficiency with various web-based software applications including Power Bi Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
Ability to travel 20%



Standout Qualifications


Experience in data analysis, analytics
Attention to detail, problem solving, and decision-making skills.
Analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
Experience and proficiency with various web-based software applications including Power Bi Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
Experience and proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, and/or C#



WORKING CONDITIONS

The following represents general working conditions for this office-based role. Specific conditions may vary depending on business needs and individual circumstances.


This role is primarily performed in a professional office environment with standard lighting, ventilation, and temperature-controlled settings.
Duties are largely sedentary, requiring extended periods of sitting and using a computer and telephone.
Visual acuity to operate a computer and read documents is required, along with auditory ability to participate in virtual and in-person meetings.
Occasional movement within the office environment is necessary, including walking short distances, standing, or reaching for files.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.



Pay Range

$73,200.00 - $117,800.00

The above pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target pay for the position across all U.S. locations. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including the scope and responsibilities of the role, the candidate's experience, education and skills, as well as the equity of pay among team members in similar positions. Beyond offering a competitive total rewards package, we prioritize a people-first culture and offer various opportunities to support team member growth and success.

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Position Highlights

As a Data Analyst II within the Enterprise Data & Analytics team, you will play a key role in advancing the university's data-informed culture by supporting strategic and operational analytics initiatives. In this position, you will work across the full data lifecycle, including data acquisition, validation, transformation, analysis, reporting, and visualization to deliver actionable insights for campus partners.

Partnering with stakeholders across the university, you will translate business needs into meaningful data products, dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions that support institutional effectiveness and strategic decision-making. This role is ideal for a curious, collaborative professional who is passionate about leveraging data to solve complex problems, uncover opportunities, and tell compelling stories through analytics.

This position offers a hybrid work arrangement, with weekly on-campus presence required.

Enterprise Data & Analytics

The Enterprise Data & Analytics team is dedicated to connecting people, data, and technology to deliver trusted insights that empower informed decision-making across the university. Through modern data management, analytics, reporting, and governance practices, the team supports institutional priorities and advances the university's strategic goals.

Working collaboratively with partners across campus, the department develops and maintains data solutions that enhance transparency, improve operational effectiveness, and enable evidence-based planning and decision-making. The team is committed to fostering a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and responsible data stewardship in support of the university's mission.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities


Identifies and assesses requirements to develop data files and reports using query tools
Monitors and coordinates mass data uploads and exports. Maintains databases for tracking information. Consolidates data from multiple sources, interprets data, and generates ongoing reports
Troubleshoots processing errors and makes changes /corrections independently. Assists in developing new processes to respond to issues that deviate from standard operating procedures
Supports, designs, develops, and/or maintains studies, presentations, analytics, reports, and dashboards that support institutional goals, planning, and strategic decision making
Aggregates, manipulates, and analyzes large data structures. Summarizes and communicates information using a variety of graphical and tabular formats and media
Creates and maintains data files in accordance with RIT information security standards and data management best practices
Other duties as assigned


Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities


Knowledge of data visualization tools and best practices for creating dashboards and interactive reports
Knowledge of database systems and query languages for data manipulation and retrieval
Skill in analyzing and interpreting large, complex datasets to generate actionable insights
Skill in consulting with stakeholders to define data requirements and deliver tailored analytics solutions
Ability to collect, organize, analyze and disseminate information with attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to communicate findings effectively through well-structured visuals and narratives tailored to target audiences


Minimum Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in related field
3 years of related experience
Equivalent combination of experience & education may be considered


Job Level Overview

Specialized Contributor Level 2 - A fully functional role requiring established knowledge of the profession or field of work. Responsible for completing substantive assignments and projects. Problems are varied and non-routine, and resolution requires exercising judgment, analysis, advisement, creativity, and understanding broader sets of issues. May provide assistance to entry level staff.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

Partnership Net is revolutionizing the €90B sponsorship industry with its innovative AI-powered Agent-as-a-Service platform. By transforming sponsorships into a transparent, data-driven, and measurable process, we empower brands and rights holders to optimize ROI, maximize value, and discover new opportunities. Our solutions enable organizations to shift from intuition-based decisions to insights derived from data analytics, driving effective partnerships in a continually evolving market. At Partnership Net, we are committed to setting new standards and delivering actionable intelligence for our clients.




Role Description

This is a full-time hybrid role for a Data Analyst, located in the Greater Aveiro Area with some flexibility to work from home. As a Data Analyst with Partnership Net, you will analyze, interpret, and present data to support strategic business decisions. Core responsibilities will include collecting and preparing data, creating and refining data models, applying the highest quality standards, developing actionable insights, and effectively communicating findings to stakeholders. You will play a key role in transforming data into valuable business solutions to drive our company’s mission forward.




Qualifications

Proficiency in Analytical Skills, Data Analytics, and Statistics to analyze data and uncover insights.
Expertise in Data Modeling to design and implement effective database models for business needs.
Strong Communication skills to present data insights clearly to stakeholders and collaborate effectively with team members.
Proficient in using analytical tools and platforms such as SQL, Python, or R.
Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Experience implementing the highest quality standards and automation procedures.
Detail oriented with strong values working and collaborating towards the best result.
Ability to work in a hybrid environment, balancing in-office and remote work as needed.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
Familiarity with the sponsorship or marketing industry is a plus.




Benefits

28 paid vacation days per year + birthday off
Public transport costs reimbursement
Health insurance
Monthly subscription service budget
10 min train journey from Aveiro to the office
Multinational young team environment
Hybrid working mode ﻿

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst – Leading Client




Our client is a rapidly growing organisation undergoing an exciting period of transformation, with data becoming increasingly central to how the business operates and makes decisions. They are investing in their data and BI capabilities and are looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst to help build a trusted, scalable reporting environment.




The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to take ownership of the development and continuous improvement of Power BI reporting across the business. You’ll work closely with senior stakeholders and business teams to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights, while helping establish consistent data models, KPIs, and reporting standards.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across the full analytics lifecycle — from sourcing and modelling data through to building dashboards, developing advanced DAX and Power Query logic, and presenting insights to decision-makers.




Key Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain high-quality Power BI dashboards across multiple areas of the business.
Own the end-to-end reporting process, from understanding business requirements through to data modelling, development, testing, and deployment.
Develop robust and reusable semantic data models using strong data modelling principles.
Use Power Query and DAX to transform data and create advanced business metrics and reporting logic.
Write SQL queries to source, analyse, and combine data from multiple systems.
Define and standardise KPIs with business stakeholders to create a consistent view of performance.
Replace fragmented spreadsheets and legacy reporting with scalable, self-service BI solutions.
Analyse data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and areas for business improvement.
Implement appropriate reporting permissions and data access controls.
Work with stakeholders to improve data quality, reporting adoption, and self-service analytics.
Provide guidance, documentation, and training to help business users get greater value from data.




About You:

4+ years’ experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a similar role.
Strong hands-on experience building Power BI dashboards end-to-end.
Advanced Power Query and DAX skills, including complex transformations and custom measures.
Strong understanding of data modelling, including relationships, hierarchies, and star schema.
Solid SQL skills with experience working across multiple data sources.
Proven ability to translate business questions into effective data and reporting solutions.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and non-technical business users.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on data quality and accuracy.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex data clearly.
Self-motivated, organised, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.




Nice to Have:

Power BI certification.
Experience with Microsoft data and automation tools.
Experience implementing data governance, security, and GDPR-compliant reporting.
Exposure to broader data engineering or cloud data environments.
Experience developing self-service analytics capabilities.




Why Join?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation where data is becoming a key driver of business performance. You’ll have significant ownership over the development of the BI environment, work closely with senior stakeholders, and play a key role in establishing a more scalable and data-driven organisation.




Location: Dublin (Hybrid)

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Description:
CENISIS recrute un Data Analyst Experienced F/H, en CDI, à Lille, pour intégrer une équipe data e-commerce et contribuer à la valorisation des données ainsi qu’au développement de cas d’usage IA.




Tes missions :




En tant que Data Analyst Experienced F/H, tu interviendras sur des sujets data et BI à fort enjeu business, notamment autour du pilotage e-commerce et de l’évolution des outils de reporting.

Tes principales responsabilités :




Maintenir et faire évoluer le dashboard référent e-commerce (architecture complexe sous Power BI).
Gérer les évolutions : modification de tables, ajout de champs et enrichissement des contenus.
Assurer la fiabilité et la qualité des données utilisées dans les reportings.
Travailler sur des problématiques data via SQL et Python
Contribuer à des projets IA (analyse, expérimentation, cas d’usage).
Collaborer avec les équipes métiers e-commerce pour comprendre les besoins et proposer des solutions adaptées.




Ton profil :




Formation Bac+5 (data, informatique, ingénierie ou équivalent).
Expérience confirmée en tant que Data Analyst, idéalement en environnement e-commerce.
Très bonne maîtrise de Power BI (niveau expert requis).
Solides compétences en SQL et Python.
Connaissance des environnements GCP.
Expérience ou forte appétence pour les sujets IA (projets concrets appréciés).




Ton savoir-être :




Rigueur et sens du détail.
Capacité à travailler sur des architectures complexes.
Esprit analytique et orientation résultats.
Bon relationnel pour interagir avec les équipes métiers.
Autonomie et proactivité.




Alors tu es partant(e) pour relever le défi ?




N’hésite pas à postuler, ce serait le début d’une superbe aventure ensemble !




À compétences égales, tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.




En rejoignant Cenisis, vous bénéficiez notamment :




Prise en charge à 100 % des transports en commun ou indemnités kilométriques vélo.
Charte télétravail co-signée par la direction.
Prime de performance.




Et évidemment, les avantages classiques :




Tickets restaurant.
Mutuelle avantageuse.




Le processus de recrutement :




Chez Cenisis, le processus de recrutement s’adapte au contexte des missions et peut être accéléré en fonction des besoins :




Première rencontre avec Camille, Talent Acquisition.
Deuxième échange avec ton futur Manager.
Troisième échange avec Gilles, Head of Cenisis Academy et/ou Cédric, CEO.

Title: Data Analyst – Power BI Reporting
HTML:
Dale Consulting ricerca una figura di Data Analyst – Power BI Reporting per un importante cliente internazionale operante nei settori Banking & Insurance, da inserire in un team dedicato all'analisi dei dati e allo sviluppo di soluzioni di reporting a supporto del business.


| CHI SIAMO

Dale Group, società di Consulenza Informatica specializzata nei settori Banking, Insurance e Financial Services, offre servizi ai principali player internazionali del mercato IT.

Società dedita all'eccellenza e all'impegno costante nel supportare le sfide dei propri clienti, fornisce soluzioni personalizzate contribuendo alla realizzazione e alla gestione di prodotti, servizi e strumenti ad alto valore strategico.


| DI COSA TI OCCUPERAI

Entrerai a far parte di un contesto strutturato e altamente dinamico, contribuendo allo sviluppo di dashboard e reportistica avanzata per supportare i processi decisionali e il monitoraggio delle performance aziendali.

Lavorerai a stretto contatto con stakeholder di business e team tecnici per raccogliere i requisiti, analizzare i dati e realizzare soluzioni di reporting efficaci e orientate alle esigenze del cliente.


In particolare ti occuperai di:

  • Raccogliere e analizzare i requisiti di business relativi alla reportistica;
  • Progettare, sviluppare e manutenere dashboard e report interattivi tramite Power BI;
  • Analizzare grandi volumi di dati provenienti da differenti fonti informative;
  • Definire KPI e metriche a supporto delle esigenze di business;
  • Garantire la qualità, la coerenza e l'affidabilità dei dati rappresentati nei report;
  • Collaborare con i team IT e con gli stakeholder di business per l'evoluzione delle soluzioni di reporting;
  • Supportare l'ottimizzazione dei processi di analisi e visualizzazione del dato.


| COSA RICHIEDIAMO

  • Laurea in discipline Economiche o affini;
  • Almeno 4 anni di esperienza come Data Analyst o BI Analyst;
  • Ottima conoscenza di Microsoft Power BI per lo sviluppo di dashboard e reportistica avanzata;
  • Esperienza nella modellazione dei dati e nella definizione di KPI;
  • Buona conoscenza di SQL per interrogazione e analisi dei dati;
  • Esperienza maturata in contesti Banking e/o Insurance;
  • Capacità di interfacciarsi con stakeholder di business e tradurre le esigenze funzionali in soluzioni di reporting;
  • Ottime capacità analitiche, organizzative e di problem solving.


| COSA OFFRIAMO?

  • Inserimento su progetti strategici presso primari clienti dei settori Banking e Insurance;
  • Ambiente strutturato e orientato all'innovazione;
  • Opportunità di crescita professionale e sviluppo di competenze su progetti ad alto valore aggiunto.


Sede di riferimento operativa: Milano

Modalità di lavoro: ibrida (3+2)

Contratto: tempo indeterminato.

RAL: €30.000 – €35.000


L’offerta si rivolge a candidati ambosessi, nel rispetto del Codice delle pari opportunità D.Lgs. 11 aprile 2006, N. 198 e ss.mm.ii.

Title: Data Analyst Senior H/F
Description:
Qui sommes-nous ?



Rejoindre NEXTON, c'est intégrer une entreprise où convergent l'esprit d'un cabinet de conseil, la créativité d'une Factory et la dynamique d'une ESN ! Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale.



Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées.









Description du poste



NEXTON recrute un Data Analyst Senior H/F, en CDI, à Bordeaux !



Ton futur environnement de travail :



Tu intègres l'équipe en tant que Data Analyst pour l'un de nos grands comptes clients. Ton rôle sera d'accompagner les directions métiers dans la valorisation de leur patrimoine data. Tu interviendras sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, de la phase d'exploration à l'exposition des résultats.



Tes missions :



Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des cas d'usage concrets par le croisement de sources de données complexes (ciblage marketing, analyses descriptives ou modèles prédictifs).


Développer, optimiser et assurer la maintenance de solutions de données réutilisables, garantissant ainsi l'agilité et l'efficacité des analyses à long terme.

Transformer des données brutes en insights actionnables via la création et la publication de dashboards clairs et percutants.



Garantir la qualité des livrables en respectant rigoureusement les normes techniques et les bonnes pratiques définies au sein de l'équipe Data.



Jouer un rôle d'ambassadeur de la donnée en accompagnant les équipes métiers dans la compréhension des résultats et le développement de leur culture "Data Driven".









Qualifications



De formation supérieure (BAC+5), tu possèdes au minimum 6 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst dans un environnement Agile/SCRUM.



Tu justifies d'une expérience solide dans le domaine de la Data (manipulation de bases de données, SQL, outils d'analyse).



Tu as une appétence pour l'utilisation de Snowflake.



Pédagogue et rigoureux, tu traduis des concepts techniques en solutions concrètes pour des interlocuteurs non-experts.



Tu maitrises les statistiques et les visualisations de données.





Informations supplémentaires



Pourquoi choisir NEXTON ?



Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année :



▶ Des communautés dynamiques pour t'accompagner dans ton parcours.



▶ Des Meet Up pour développer tes compétences.



▶ Des formations pour te réinventer et progresser.



▶ Des événements sportifs et festifs pour t'épanouir.



▶ Un forfait mobilité durable pour faciliter ton quotidien et encourager la mobilité douce.



▶ Un téléphone de dernière génération pour rester connecté.



Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Rencontrons-nous !
