Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Do you see the benefits of gaining variety and experience from different customers and industries but developing with one and the same employer? As an employee at ESSIQ, you get the best of both worlds.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst with a strong technical foundation in data engineering to join our team. In this role, you’ll manage multiple data and reporting solutions across different technologies.

You’ll work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams — acting as the key bridge between business needs and data-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insights:

Analyze large datasets to identify patterns, trends, and insights that drive informed decision-making.

Visualization & Reporting:

Design and develop dashboards and reports in Power BI to communicate insights effectively.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Work with Data Engineers and Data Scientists to turn business requirements into actionable data models and analytics solutions.

Required Skills & Experience


Strong proficiency in SQL and Power BI
Proven experience in Business Intelligence or Advanced Analytics projects
Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills
Experience in requirement gathering, process understanding, and solution design


Soft Skills & Working Style


Strong interpersonal and cross-cultural communication skills
Comfortable collaborating across international teams and time zones
Adaptable, proactive, and eager to learn new technologies and methodologies
Skilled in virtual collaboration tools for effective teamwork in global settings


About Essiq

ESSIQ is the technology consultancy where everything starts with the individual. We offer you the opportunity to shape your own career, a modern salary policy and flexible solutions! ESSIQ was founded in 2005 and has since grown with over 130 employees and three offices that you can find in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö. With us, you have the opportunity to work on site with the client, in-house and in satellite. Your interests and driving forces lead the way and our goal is to make the perfect match between individual and mission.

ESSIQ is a social company. We put a lot of resources into community and we have a wide range of professional and social activities. Our communication platform is imbued with openness and promotes networking and skill exchange as well as leisure activities and relationship building.

APPLICATION

Selection and interviews will take place continuously, so send your application today! Please respect that we do not accept any applications by email.

Questions about the role? Contact: Fredrik Persson, fredrik.persson@essiq.se

Do you want to know more about ESSIQ?

Visit http://essiq.se and follow us on our social media!

Title: Senior Data Analist Kruidvat
Description:
Dit ga je doen

In de rol van Senior Data Analist bij AS Watson ben je onderdeel van het Decision Analytics‑team binnen Data, Insights & Analytics voor onze merken Kruidvat en Trekpleister. Samen met andere collega's uit het analytics team (Data Engineer, Data Scientist) werk je aan uiteenlopende projecten en analyses die meerdere businessdomeinen raken, van commercie tot HR en supply chain tot winkels.

Als grootste Health en Beauty retailer in de Benelux hebben we een schat aan data die we kunnen gebruiken. Elke week worden we bezocht door 4 MILJOEN klanten in onze ruim 1500 winkels én webshops. Zowel in de Benelux als internationaal hebben we de focus op data analytics. Dit zie je onder andere terug in de centrale rol van onze afdeling en investeringen in moderne data en Cloud technologieën. Met jouw analytische blik vertaal je als Senior Data Analist complexe vraagstukken naar heldere inzichten en data‑producten die het datagedreven werken in onze online en offlineorganisatie versterken, of het nu gaat om klantgedrag, voorraadstromen, winkelperformance of operationele efficiëntie. Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data en wil je met jouw analyses echte impact maken in een grote retailorganisatie?

Wat ga je doen als Data Analist bij AS Watson?


Je ondersteunt verschillende business- en klantteams met analyses en dataproducten die processen, klantreizen en operationele performance verbeteren.
Je vertaalt de (interne) klantvragen naar technische requirements of een helder analysevraagstuk.
Je voert zelfstandig (ad hoc) statistische analyses uit en brengt complexe inzichten terug tot heldere, begrijpelijke kernpunten.
Je doet concrete, praktische aanbevelingen aan stakeholders en ondersteunt teams actief bij datagedreven besluitvorming.
Je stimuleert en borgt de adoptie van nieuwe dataproducten binnen de organisatie.


Dit krijg je ervoor terug


Een snelle omgeving waarin je veel kunt leren. En werkplezier door verantwoordelijkheid, vrijheid en de ruimte om jezelf te ontplooien. 
Best belangrijk: een goed salaris! Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring start je tussen de € 4.580,- en € 6.500,- bruto per maand bij een 40-urige werkweek. Plus personeelskorting bij Kruidvat, Trekpleister en ICI PARIS XL! 
24 vakantiedagen en een aantrekkelijke ATV-regeling met 19,5 dagen op fulltime basis. Liever meer vrije tijd of extra geld? Koop of verkoop vakantiedagen of laat je ATV (deels) uitbetalen.
Volop ontwikkelings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden met onze eigen AS Watson Academy. Bij AS Watson sta je nooit stil.
Goede thuiswerkmogelijkheden. Hybride werken is bij ons heel gewoon en gaat altijd in goed overleg.


Dit ben jij


Je brengt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Data Analist of BI Consultant mee en beweegt je moeiteloos tussen verschillende businessdomeinen; je combineert analytische vaardigheden met een pragmatische, oplossingsgerichte aanpak om het datagedreven werken verder te versterken.
Je bent bedreven in het opstellen van meetplannen, het definiëren en het visualiseren van de juiste KPI’s en het is een pre als je zelf dashboards kan ontwerpen (Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio of vergelijkbaar).
Je beheerst SQL uitstekend, kunt goed uit de voeten met statistische analyses en voelt je thuis in cloud‑based (analytics) platforms zoals Databricks, Google Cloud Console of Microsoft Azure. Kennis van Python is een pre.
Je bent van nature nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data en naar de onderliggende dynamiek van verschillende businessdomeinen (commercie, supply chain, operatie, HR, finance, enz.)
Je bent in staat om de inzichten van je analyses op een heldere en simpele manier over te brengen aan collega's. Wel zo handig als je in crossfunctionele teams werkt.


Wie jij bent, maakt ons buitengewoon! Waar wacht je nog op? Solliciteer snel en laat van je horen!

Bureaus leg de telefoon maar weer neer: wij werven zelf voor deze vacature.

Samen met andere collega's uit het analytics team (Data Engineer, Data Scientist) werk je aan uiteenlopende projecten en analyses die meerdere businessdomeinen raken, van commercie tot HR en supply chain tot winkels.

Als grootste Health en Beauty retailer in de Benelux hebben we een schat aan data die we kunnen gebruiken. Elke week worden we bezocht door 4 MILJOEN klanten in onze ruim 1500 winkels én webshops. Zowel in de Benelux als internationaal hebben we de focus op data analytics. Dit zie je onder andere terug in de centrale rol van onze afdeling en investeringen in moderne data en Cloud technologieën. Met jouw analytische blik vertaal je als Senior Data Analist complexe vraagstukken naar heldere inzichten en data‑producten die het datagedreven werken in onze online en offlineorganisatie versterken, of het nu gaat om klantgedrag, voorraadstromen, winkelperformance of operationele efficiëntie. Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data en wil je met jouw analyses echte impact maken in een grote retailorganisatie?

Wat ga je doen als Data Analist bij AS Watson?

  • Je ondersteunt verschillende business- en klantteams met analyses en dataproducten die processen, klantreizen en operationele performance verbeteren.
  • Je vertaalt de (interne) klantvragen naar technische requirements of een helder analysevraagstuk.
  • Je voert zelfstandig (ad hoc) statistische analyses uit en brengt complexe inzichten terug tot heldere, begrijpelijke kernpunten.
  • Je doet concrete, praktische aanbevelingen aan stakeholders en ondersteunt teams actief bij datagedreven besluitvorming.
  • Je stimuleert en borgt de adoptie van nieuwe dataproducten binnen de organisatie.

Dit krijg je ervoor terug

  • Een snelle omgeving waarin je veel kunt leren. En werkplezier door verantwoordelijkheid, vrijheid en de ruimte om jezelf te ontplooien. 
  • Best belangrijk: een goed salaris! Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring start je tussen de € 4.580,- en € 6.500,- bruto per maand bij een 40-urige werkweek. Plus personeelskorting bij Kruidvat, Trekpleister en ICI PARIS XL! 
  • 24 vakantiedagen en een aantrekkelijke ATV-regeling met 19,5 dagen op fulltime basis. Liever meer vrije tijd of extra geld? Koop of verkoop vakantiedagen of laat je ATV (deels) uitbetalen.
  • Volop ontwikkelings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden met onze eigen AS Watson Academy. Bij AS Watson sta je nooit stil.
  • Goede thuiswerkmogelijkheden. Hybride werken is bij ons heel gewoon en gaat altijd in goed overleg.

Dit ben jij

  • Je brengt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Data Analist of BI Consultant mee en beweegt je moeiteloos tussen verschillende businessdomeinen; je combineert analytische vaardigheden met een pragmatische, oplossingsgerichte aanpak om het datagedreven werken verder te versterken.
  • Je bent bedreven in het opstellen van meetplannen, het definiëren en het visualiseren van de juiste KPI’s en het is een pre als je zelf dashboards kan ontwerpen (Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio of vergelijkbaar).
  • Je beheerst SQL uitstekend, kunt goed uit de voeten met statistische analyses en voelt je thuis in cloud‑based (analytics) platforms zoals Databricks, Google Cloud Console of Microsoft Azure. Kennis van Python is een pre.
  • Je bent van nature nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data en naar de onderliggende dynamiek van verschillende businessdomeinen (commercie, supply chain, operatie, HR, finance, enz.)
  • Je bent in staat om de inzichten van je analyses op een heldere en simpele manier over te brengen aan collega's. Wel zo handig als je in crossfunctionele teams werkt.

Wie jij bent, maakt ons buitengewoon! Waar wacht je nog op? Solliciteer snel en laat van je horen!

Optimisation de l'écosystème de reporting :

Développement d'outils analytiques :

Concevoir et mettre en place des outils de reporting stratégiques, tels qu'un Revenue Performance Dashboard, pour offrir une vision claire et consolidée de la performance financière.




Analyse avancée assistée par l'IA :

Mener des analyses complexes et des raisonnements "au cas d'usage" en exploitant des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle. Utiliser l'IA comme un levier pour explorer les données et formuler des hypothèses d'action.




🧩 Stack technique :

Langages : Python, SQL
Bases de données : BigQuery
Outils de Business Intelligence & Visualisation : Looker, Tableau
Formats de données : CSV, JSON, Avro
Outils de gestion projet : Jira, Confluence

8 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst.
Diplômé d'un master ou d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en Data Analyse, intelligence artificielle ou data science.
Aisance relationnelle, esprit collaboratif et appétence pour l'amélioration continue.

✔️Une structure à taille humaine : Favorisant l'échange, l'autonomie et l'innovation, où votre impact est direct et visible.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile industry. The team plays a key role in Voodoo’s long-term strategy by accelerating product diversification and providing a state of the art growth-engine to distribute and scale our games.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who thrives on transforming data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decisions, and collaborating closely with stakeholders to fuel growth. By joining this team, you will directly shape Voodoo’s marketing and monetization strategies, helping our apps reach and engage hundreds of millions of users worldwide.

Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team.

The objective of this team is to accelerate the growth of the company by serving as the on-demand prediction provider for all Voodoo BUs. This involves addressing critical needs such as predicting campaign LTV for User Acquisition optimization, determining optimal monetization offers for millions of players or constructing confidence intervals for time series data prediction.

We want to onboard a passionate data analyst with significant experience in a similar environment to allow us to go one step further. This is an opportunity to have a strategic and critical impact on Voodoo’s success.

This position is hybrid and requires 3 days per week in the office based in Paris.


Design, build and monitor data models & dashboards to track business metrics
Work with cross-functional teams to identify key business needs and solve them using adequate statistical models
Thoroughly document your results and offer onboarding and continuous training to help teams effectively utilize data and insights.
Establish data quality processes to ensure the reliability and accuracy of our machine learning models.
Promote data literacy within the organization and serve as the primary point of contact for all data-related inquiries and support.
Demonstrate excellent communication skills to efficiently manage senior stakeholders within a fast-paced scale-up environment.
Work closely with the central data team to source additional data and enhance data management practices


Profile


At least 4 years' experience in Data Analysis
Proficient with SQL and/or Python, with a proven experience working with large and complex data sets.
Autonomous person with a strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.
Experience with statistical modeling & predictive analytics
Excellent verbal & written communication abilities
Experience building dashboards with Tableau.
Experience in gaming industry or mobile marketing is a plus
Any personal or professional experience with machine learning will be valued


Our Stack

SQL; Python; DBT; AWS; Tableau

Benefits


Competitive salary based on experience
Swile Lunch voucher
Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
Wellness activities in our Paris office
Remote Fridays

Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile industry. The team plays a key role in Voodoo’s long-term strategy by accelerating product diversification and providing a state of the art growth-engine to distribute and scale our games.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who thrives on transforming data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decisions, and collaborating closely with stakeholders to fuel growth. By joining this team, you will directly shape Voodoo’s marketing and monetization strategies, helping our apps reach and engage hundreds of millions of users worldwide.

Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team.

The objective of this team is to accelerate the growth of the company by serving as the on-demand prediction provider for all Voodoo BUs. This involves addressing critical needs such as predicting campaign LTV for User Acquisition optimization, determining optimal monetization offers for millions of players or constructing confidence intervals for time series data prediction.

We want to onboard a passionate data analyst with significant experience in a similar environment to allow us to go one step further. This is an opportunity to have a strategic and critical impact on Voodoo’s success.

This position is hybrid and requires 3 days per week in the office based in Paris.

  • Design, build and monitor data models & dashboards to track business metrics
  • Work with cross-functional teams to identify key business needs and solve them using adequate statistical models
  • Thoroughly document your results and offer onboarding and continuous training to help teams effectively utilize data and insights.
  • Establish data quality processes to ensure the reliability and accuracy of our machine learning models.
  • Promote data literacy within the organization and serve as the primary point of contact for all data-related inquiries and support.
  • Demonstrate excellent communication skills to efficiently manage senior stakeholders within a fast-paced scale-up environment.
  • Work closely with the central data team to source additional data and enhance data management practices

Profile

  • At least 4 years' experience in Data Analysis
  • Proficient with SQL and/or Python, with a proven experience working with large and complex data sets.
  • Autonomous person with a strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Experience with statistical modeling & predictive analytics
  • Excellent verbal & written communication abilities
  • Experience building dashboards with Tableau.
  • Experience in gaming industry or mobile marketing is a plus
  • Any personal or professional experience with machine learning will be valued

Our Stack

SQL; Python; DBT; AWS; Tableau

Benefits

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About This Vacancy

You will work with diverse datasets to identify trends, monitor performance, and deliver actionable recommendations that help stakeholders achieve their objectives.

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect, analyze, and visualize data, translating complex information into clear and impactful reports and dashboards.


Define data requirements, reporting needs, and analytical approaches based on business objectives and project requirements.
Perform data extraction, exploration, and analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that support data-driven decision making.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, KPIs, and analytical tools to monitor business performance and support operational and strategic initiatives.
Conduct data quality checks, validate analytical outputs, troubleshoot data issues, and produce clear documentation to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting and analysis.


What We Expect From You


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
Previous experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or related analytical roles.
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python and Microsoft Excel for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
Hands-on experience with Business Intelligence and data visualization tools, such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, or similar platforms.
Proven experience in data analysis, KPI definition and monitoring, dashboard development, performance reporting, and business insights generation.
Experience working with large and complex datasets, ensuring data quality, consistency, and accuracy.
Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques and data modeling concepts is considered a plus.
Familiarity with data warehousing, ETL processes, and cloud-based analytics platforms is considered a plus.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
Good oral and written communication skills, both in Italian and English


What You Can Expect From Us

The position offers a permanent employment contract, and the base gross annual salary (Gross Annual Salary – RAL) will be no less than €30,000, in line with the National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL) for Commerce – Tertiary, Distribution and Services.

TMC is committed to offering a competitive compensation package. At the end of the recruitment process, after assessing the candidate's experience, skills, and qualifications, the company may offer a final gross annual salary higher than the amount stated above.

In line with our business model, the final compensation package also includes a project profit-sharing component, an individual annual learning and development budget of €4,000 net, and an annual welfare allowance. Further details will be provided during the recruitment process, in accordance with the company's applicable policies.

TMC is an international high-tech consultancy company that brings expertise to its clients in order to support them with the realization of their technological challenges. As such, TMC is operating as an expert center at the disposition of its clients and we help them to be more competitive in an ever more global and faster-changing technological world. At TMC we believe that people are the driving force behind technological innovation. That is why we want to create the best possible conditions for tech talents to thrive in. We offer you a challenging and stimulating work environment in which you can be the director of your own career. As an Employeneur you are part of our TMC family. Next to our outstanding technical expertise, fun and engagement are meaningful parts of our culture.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join the Future of Data & Analytics at The Ardonagh Group

The Ardonagh Analytics Lab is an exciting new operation established by The Ardonagh Group in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath. As a centre of excellence for data and analytics, the Lab delivers data-driven insights that support colleagues and clients across the globe.

With more than 12,000 colleagues operating across a diverse portfolio of insurance products and related services, Ardonagh is committed to using data to transform decision-making, enhance client outcomes, and build a deeper understanding of risk.

Our mission is simple: use data, analytics, and innovation to achieve better outcomes for every participant in the value chain. We explore vast and complex datasets, uncover hidden opportunities, model future scenarios, and help clients and insurer partners prepare for the unknown.

We're now looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our growing Analytics Team and play a pivotal role in turning data into meaningful business insight.

The Opportunity

As a key member of the Data Analytics Team, you will work across a variety of datasets to both respond to business requests and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance across the Group.

You will bridge the gap between our Data Engineering and Data Visualisation teams, ensuring that data is transformed into valuable insights that drive decision-making, operational efficiency, and commercial success.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an analytically curious professional who enjoys solving complex business problems and influencing strategic decisions through data.

What You'll Be Doing


Translate complex data into actionable insights that inform decision-making, solve business challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and efficiency.
Partner closely with Data Engineering and Data Visualisation teams to understand available data sources and maximise their business value.
Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities within large datasets and provide recommendations that support strategic business decisions.
Enhance automated reporting and dashboards through proactive analysis, meaningful commentary, and actionable recommendations.
Support the development and implementation of robust data governance, management, and reporting processes across the Group.
Explore and apply AI and machine learning techniques where appropriate to drive innovation and enhance business insight.
Contribute to the continued development of a world-class analytics function within the Ardonagh Analytics Lab.


What We're Looking For

Essential Experience & Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years' experience in data analysis and reporting.
Strong SQL expertise, including data querying, mining, manipulation, and segmentation.
Advanced quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex datasets.
At least 2 years' experience using statistical programming languages such as Python or R.
Solid understanding of database concepts, structures, and data modelling.
Strong knowledge of Business Intelligence principles and analytical best practices.
Experience with one or more BI tools, including Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.


Desirable Experience


Experience within financial services.
Previous exposure to General Insurance is highly advantageous.
Knowledge of predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-based analytical techniques.


About You

We're looking for someone who:


Is an experienced analytics professional capable of working independently and taking ownership of outcomes.
Brings a proactive, solutions-focused mindset and thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Has a genuine passion for transforming data into business value.
Quickly builds an understanding of business operations and technical environments.
Is a strong relationship builder who can confidently engage with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
Combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication and influencing skills.


Why Join Us?

At the Ardonagh Analytics Lab, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging, high-impact projects that influence decision-making across a global organisation. You'll join a collaborative team passionate about innovation, continuous learning, and unlocking the power of data to shape the future of insurance.

If you're excited by the opportunity to turn complex data into meaningful business outcomes and want to be part of a growing analytics centre of excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of data-driven decision-making at The Ardonagh Group.

The Company

In an industry that never stands still, neither do we. The Ardonagh Group was founded in 2017 and has grown to become the UK’s largest independent insurance distribution platform and a top 20 broker globally.

Our best-in-class entrepreneurial and specialist brands span a network of 150+ locations worldwide and have a combined workforce of more than c.12,000 people. Across our portfolio, we offer a highly diversified range of insurance-related products and services across the full insurance value chain in the UK, Ireland and broader international markets.

From complex multinational corporations to individuals purchasing personal insurance policies, our understanding of the communities we serve, together with our scale and breadth, allows us to deliver a broad range of product and risk solutions to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving market.

If you approach life with a sense of adventure you might just find what you need at Ardonagh to bring your ambition to life.

Find out more about Ardonagh’s world of opportunity on LinkedIn or visit www.ardonagh.com.

Description:
Charging your car should feel as natural as charging your phone. That's the future we're building: a network of EV chargers where life happens. We don't just install chargers. We accelerate sustainable mobility. We obsess over partnerships. We grow relentlessly: our network, our partners, ourselves.

If you're here, you're probably not looking for "just a job." Neither are we. 😎 We're driven by impact, and always looking for people who thrive on turning bold ideas into reality. If that sounds like you, you'll feel at home here. We're looking for people who see challenges as puzzles, not problems, thrive in fast-growing, high-energy environments, and want to shape the future of mobility, not just watch it unfold. At Powerdot, you'll get freedom, ownership, and responsibility. The space to experiment. The chance to scale your ideas. And a team that's always pushing the edge of what's possible.

🚀 About This Role

As our Data Analyst, you'll be part of the Central Data team at Powerdot and will play a key role in the current phase of accelerated growth. Your mission is to transform raw data into clear, actionable insights that power smarter decisions across the business — ensuring every team has the visibility they need to move fast and move well. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

How You'll Shape Our Story:

Your day-to-day will include

Gathering and transforming data from a variety of sources — including internal databases, external APIs, and surveys, ensuring data is ready for analysis.
Analyzing data using statistical techniques — identifying trends, patterns, and insights that drive smarter business decisions.
Developing data visualizations — creating clear, compelling dashboards and reports that communicate findings to stakeholders in a concise and actionable way.
Partnering with stakeholders — understanding their needs and developing data-driven solutions that address real business questions.
Championing data quality — maintaining and supporting a culture of strong data quality across teams and workflows.
Staying ahead of analytics trends — keeping up-to-date on the latest tools, techniques, and best practices in data analytics.
Mentoring colleagues — coaching co-workers on analytics best practices and helping elevate the team's overall data capability.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:

Up to 4 years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you know how to break down complex questions and find the signal in the noise.
Technical proficiency — familiar with SQL, Python, and at least one data visualization tool such as Tableau, Metabase, or Power BI.
Eagerness to learn and develop — you thrive in a fast-moving environment and proactively grow your skills.
Great communication skills — you can translate technical findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and complexity — you navigate unstructured problems with ease and bring clarity to chaos.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team — you're self-driven but collaborative when it counts.

The Kind of Energy We're Looking For:

We're not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We're into people who make things happen.

You lead and listen. Whether you're steering the ship or rowing alongside the crew, you bring others with you and keep communication wide open.
You own your stuff. You don't wait for instructions: you see an opportunity, grab it, and make it better than anyone expected.
You've got a green heartbeat. Sustainability isn't just cool, it's core. You care about doing work that leaves the world a little better than you found it.
You balance hustle with humanity. You love the buzz of in-person teamwork, but you also know when to recharge (pun totally intended 🔋).
You grow on purpose. You're hungry to learn, to stretch, and to build something meaningful, not just rack up LinkedIn bullet points.

How you'll be Powered up?

🏥 Private health insurance coverage
💪🏼 Gym membership to help you stay active
⏰ Flexible working hours: you own your time
🌍 Annual offsite where we celebrate the year's achievements and spend quality time together (this year we went to Algarve, Portugal!)
🤝🏼 Regular team-building events with your local teammates
📚 English Training — as English is our language used to connect with all markets and teams
🍩 Free office snacks and unlimited coffee & Meal allowance for every worked day
⚡️ Special discounts for charging your electric vehicle

Our Promise To You

The best solutions come from different voices. We're building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity aren't policies — they're lived every day. At Powerdot, everyone has the space to speak up, challenge the status quo, and make a difference. Your voice powers the future — literally.

Description:
CDI


SIBYLONE, société de conseil spécialisée dans les systèmes d’information de synthèse et de pilotage, aide ses clients à tirer toute la valeur de leur patrimoine de données, levier stratégique majeur de développement et de rentabilité.

Notre ambition : rendre les différents acteurs de l’entreprise autonomes dans l’exploitation des données, libérer les usages Métier, pour qu’ils soient en mesure de relever les défis de performance, de couverture de risque, de financement, de conquête client, de RSE… qui s’imposent à eux.

Spécialistes reconnus, nos consultants s’appuient pour cela sur une connaissance approfondie de l’activité business de nos clients, en lien avec nos trois piliers que sont le Métier, la Data et le Projet.

SIBYLONE emploie environ 200 salariés et réalise un chiffre d’affaires de 30 millions d’euros en fournissant des services de haute qualité à de grandes entreprises.

SIBYLONE est une Filiale du Groupe Smart 4 Engineering : Créé en 2020, le groupe compte aujourd’hui 12 marques en France, en Italie, en Espagne et au Portugal dans le domaine de l’ingénierie et de l’IT. Avec près de 3 500 ingénieurs et consultants hautement qualifiés, nous offrons des services dans des domaines porteurs comme le Digital, la Data, l’Intelligence Artificielle, la Cybersécurité, le Cloud et le Software.

Avec nos 3,000 ingénieurs / consultants hautement qualifiés, le Groupe offre ses services dans les domaines très porteurs du Digital, de la Data, de l’Intelligence Artificielle, de la Cybersécurité, du Cloud et des Logiciels.

Contexte

Vous interviendrez en tant que Data Analyst Power BI dans le cadre d’un programme de transformation digitale de la Direction Financière. Notre client grand groupe du secteur bancaire souhaite renforcer son équipe Data pour optimiser le pilotage de la performance financière.

L’objectif est de moderniser les outils de reporting, fiabiliser les données et accompagner les métiers dans une meilleure exploitation des indicateurs clés (KPI). Vous interviendrez au sein d’une équipe dynamique, en lien direct avec les contrôleurs de gestion, les responsables financiers et les équipes IT/Data.

Vos missions

En tant que Data Analyst Power BI, vous interviendrez en proximité avec la Direction Financière pour :


Comprendre les enjeux métiers et l’environnement fonctionnel Finance
Prendre en main et faire évoluer les dashboards existants
Repenser le design et la visualisation des KPI financiers
Participer à la collecte, la transformation et la gouvernance des données
Animer des ateliers avec les sponsors pour recueillir les besoins
Automatiser les traitements et garantir la qualité des livrables
Former et accompagner les utilisateurs dans la prise en main des outils


Compétences techniques attendues


Power BI : expertise en visualisation, storytelling et modélisation
SQL : maîtrise des requêtes complexes
Azure : bonne connaissance de Synapse, SSAS
Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery) : un plus apprécié
Git : pour le versioning et le delivery
Bonne culture BI et sensibilité aux évolutions technologiques


Pourquoi pas vous ?

Profil recherché :


Diplômé d’un bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, Miage, …)
+9 ans d’expérience en tant que Data Analyst ou Consultant BI
Forte appétence pour les métiers de la Finance
Excellent relationnel, esprit d’analyse et sens du service
Autonomie, rigueur et capacité à vulgariser les sujets techniques


Les  Sibylone !

Ce Que Nous Offrons !


Une culture d’excellence : Nous exigeons le meilleur de nos collaborateurs tout en cultivant la cohésion et l’esprit d’équipe.
Moments de convivialité : Séminaires, afterworks, conférences, petits déjeuners…
Actions solidaires : Partenariat avec la start-up spécialisée en RSE Vendredi pour permettre à nos collaborateurs de réaliser des missions auprès d’associations.
Formation continue : Une offre de formation innovante adaptée à nos métiers et expertises (Data, Métier, Projet)
Télétravail : Accord de télétravail en vigueur pour une meilleure flexibilité.


Prêt à Relever le Défi ?

Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette description et souhaitez travailler dans un environnement stimulant et dynamique ? Vous souhaitez rejoindre une société ambitieuse ?

Postulez dès maintenant et rejoignez l’aventure Sibylone !

Poste ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Title: Data Analyst H/F
Description:
Descriptif du poste

Dans le cadre de projets de transformation data, nous recherchons un·e Data Analyst capable de transformer les données en informations actionnables pour les équipes métiers et les équipes de pilotage.

Vous interviendrez sur des missions longues, au sein d’environnements structurés, pour analyser, fiabiliser et valoriser les données. Vous contribuerez à la production d’indicateurs, de reportings et de tableaux de bord destinés à accompagner la prise de décision et l’amélioration des parcours, outils et processus internes.

Vos missions


Recueillir, comprendre et challenger les besoins des équipes métiers.
Extraire, nettoyer, contrôler et analyser les données issues de différentes sources.
Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et reportings décisionnels.
Définir et suivre les KPI nécessaires au pilotage de l’activité.
Produire des analyses ad hoc afin d’identifier des tendances, anomalies, opportunités ou axes d’amélioration.
Participer à la fiabilisation et à la documentation des données et des indicateurs.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data Engineering, BI, produit et métier.
Restituer les résultats de manière claire, synthétique et adaptée à des interlocuteurs variés.
Contribuer à la diffusion d’une culture data au sein des équipes.


Profil recherché


Formation supérieure en data, statistiques, informatique, école d’ingénieur ou équivalent.
Expérience significative en analyse de données, BI ou pilotage de la performance.
Très bonne maîtrise de SQL et des outils de visualisation de données.
Maîtrise de Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense ou d’un outil équivalent.
Connaissance de Python ou R pour l’analyse et la préparation des données.
Capacité à comprendre les enjeux métier et à les traduire en indicateurs pertinents.
Rigueur, esprit analytique, autonomie et excellentes capacités de communication.
Maîtrise du français ; un anglais professionnel est apprécié.


Les plus


Connaissance de Dataiku pour la préparation, l’analyse ou l’industrialisation des traitements data.
Connaissance de Talend ou d’un outil ETL équivalent.
Expérience sur des données complexes et volumineuses.
Expérience auprès de grands comptes de l’assurance, des mutuelles ou de la protection sociale.
Sensibilité aux enjeux de gouvernance, de confidentialité et de conformité des données.


Déroulement des entretiens


Un premier échange avec Aurélie, à la suite duquel vous saurez tout (ou presque) d’eXalt Ouest,
Un entretien technique avec l’un de nos experts Data
Un entretien final avec le Directeur d’Agence, pour finir de vous convaincre de nous rejoindre 😊


Qui sont-ils ?

En entreprise, comme en musique, tout est une question de tempo. Depuis 2018, nous réunissons des consultant·e·s passionné·e·s, curieux·ses et ambitieux·ses, uni·e·s par une même conviction : mettre leur expertise au service des défis numériques, sectoriels et industriels de nos clients.

Notre mission ? Accélérer les transformations en combinant excellence opérationnelle, curiosité et audace. Nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs du luxe, du retail, de l’énergie, du transport, du tourisme, de la banque ou encore de l’assurance — partout où la technologie rencontre l’humain.

Nous aimons la tech quand elle connecte et libère les potentiels. Nos consultant·e·s ne se contentent pas de conseiller : ils construisent, testent, mettent en production, mesurent, ajustent et recommencent. Avec nos clients, nous faisons partie du jeu, du début à la fin.

Notre organisation repose sur une culture de la confiance, de l’apprentissage et de la collaboration. Nous avons conçu un cadre unique qui accompagne chaque eXalté·e à chaque étape de sa carrière, avec des rôles clairs, des communautés actives et des rituels qui renforcent le collectif.

Nos eXaltemps trimestriels, notre eXalt Academy et nos projets internes sont autant d’occasions d’apprendre, de partager et de grandir ensemble.

Aujourd’hui présents en France, au Canada, aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique, en Espagne, au Portugal et à Monaco, nous sommes portés par un engagement fort et une énergie contagieuse.

Parce qu’apprendre est notre discipline, agir notre obsession et réussir ensemble notre plus belle victoire.

Pulse. Make. Learn.

Trois mots qui rythment notre quotidien. Et peut-être bientôt le tien?

Raccolta requisiti e interazione diretta con gli utenti finali per la definizione delle esigenze di reporting

Esperienza di almeno 2 anni in ruoli analoghi

Conoscenza di QlikSense
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese

Conoscenza di un ulteriore tool di reporting, come Tableau
Padronanza di SQL, Spark e Python

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
My client based in Westmeath is seeking a Data Analyst to join an established and expanding data team. This is a perm role. The position will focus on using data to answer key business questions, improve performance and support better commercial and operational decisions. You'll work with a broad range of datasets and collaborate with teams across data, technology and the wider business.




The role offers plenty of scope to go beyond standard reporting, with an emphasis on investigating data, spotting patterns and providing recommendations that can make a measurable difference. You'll take ownership of analytical requirements from initial investigation through to presenting findings and recommendations.




Key responsibilities will include:

Interrogate and analyse large, complex datasets to answer business questions and uncover useful insights.
Identify patterns, emerging trends, potential risks and opportunities for performance improvement.
Develop analysis that supports commercial, operational and strategic decision-making.
Work alongside Data Engineers to understand data availability, quality and structure.
Collaborate with reporting and visualisation specialists to improve dashboards and management information.
Add context and interpretation to reporting, helping stakeholders understand what the data means and what actions should be considered.
Communicate findings in a straightforward and engaging way to stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge.
Help improve data quality, governance and analytical processes.
Investigate opportunities to introduce more advanced analytics, including machine learning and AI techniques.
Contribute ideas and best practices as the organisation continues to develop its data and analytics capabilities.




The successful candidate will have:

5+ years' professional experience working in data analysis, analytics or reporting.
A relevant third-level qualification in areas such as Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems or a similar discipline.
Strong hands-on SQL experience and confidence working with large datasets.
Experience with data extraction, transformation, manipulation and segmentation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn raw data into useful business conclusions.
2+ years' experience using Python or R for data analysis.
A solid understanding of databases, data models and data structures.
Good knowledge of Business Intelligence concepts and reporting practices.
Practical experience with at least one major BI platform such as Power BI, Tableau or Qlik.




Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following would be beneficial:

Financial services or another highly data-driven sector.
Predictive modelling or advanced analytics.
Machine learning or AI-related analytical projects.




You'll be comfortable taking ownership of your workload and working through analytical problems with limited supervision. You'll have the curiosity to dig deeper into the data rather than simply producing reports based on predefined requirements.

You'll also need strong stakeholder skills. The role involves working with people across technical and business functions, so being able to explain analytical concepts and recommendations clearly is essential.

Title: (Senior) Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Barcelona
Description:
Location: Come and join us in Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona!

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d) to collaborate with our operational squads. In this role you will be able to become an expert in our business and data analysis systems and environment to allow you to champion data-driven decisions as part of the Data Operations team.

Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Focus on analysing and presenting recommendations/process changes/new initiatives to management using insights derived from data.
Use your technical skills such as actively engaging in configuration and programming in the data environment, querying data via SQL from the data lake, automating data processes, deep dive analysis in Python and adjusting ETL tasks.
Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
Develop monitoring tools to measure performance and help the business achieve its objectives.
Create queries to answer operational and business questions across our many operational teams to support decisions.
Communicate results in a clear and impactful manner.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:


Educated to Degree Level or higher in an analytical discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science or Economics
5+ years of experience in an analytical role
You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
Curiosity about AI and its practical applications in analytics, experience using LLMs or AI-powered tools in a data context
Excellent technical skills including SQL knowledge, familiarity with visualisation tools (Metabase in particular is a plus) and python/R
Enthusiastic, outgoing and personable - you have the ability to think on your feet, work independently and also proactively with others to find solutions to issues
You understand how to engage and influence decision makers and have excellent communication skills
Driven - you are motivated to find solutions to problems and constantly go the extra mile
Strong communication and interpersonal skills as well as excellent written and spoken English


BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:


Flexible working arrangements
LinkedIn Learning
Sabbatical & special leave policies
WeRoad partnership
Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
Short term EU work policy
Mobility Credit
Health Insurance
Employee assistance program


DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

FREE NOW is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.

We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work.

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app.

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:

  • Focus on analysing and presenting recommendations/process changes/new initiatives to management using insights derived from data.
  • Use your technical skills such as actively engaging in configuration and programming in the data environment, querying data via SQL from the data lake, automating data processes, deep dive analysis in Python and adjusting ETL tasks.
  • Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
  • Develop monitoring tools to measure performance and help the business achieve its objectives.
  • Create queries to answer operational and business questions across our many operational teams to support decisions.
  • Communicate results in a clear and impactful manner.

  • Educated to Degree Level or higher in an analytical discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science or Economics
  • 5+ years of experience in an analytical role
  • You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
  • Curiosity about AI and its practical applications in analytics, experience using LLMs or AI-powered tools in a data context
  • Excellent technical skills including SQL knowledge, familiarity with visualisation tools (Metabase in particular is a plus) and python/R
  • Enthusiastic, outgoing and personable - you have the ability to think on your feet, work independently and also proactively with others to find solutions to issues
  • You understand how to engage and influence decision makers and have excellent communication skills
  • Driven - you are motivated to find solutions to problems and constantly go the extra mile
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills as well as excellent written and spoken English

BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:

  • Flexible working arrangements
  • LinkedIn Learning
  • Sabbatical & special leave policies
  • WeRoad partnership
  • Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
  • Short term EU work policy
  • Mobility Credit
  • Health Insurance
  • Employee assistance program

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

FREE NOW is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.

We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work.

ABOUT US:

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app.

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

Aisance relationnelle et esprit d’équipe

Formation supérieure type école d'ingénieur ou Master spécialisé dans l’analyse de données (informatique, statistiques)

Une première expérience dans le milieu bancaire est un plus

Analyse et Modélisation des Données :

Concevoir et développer des solutions d’analyse avancée pour répondre aux besoins métiers (optimisation des stocks, analyse des ventes, comportement client, etc.).

Exploiter des outils comme GCP (Google Cloud Platform), BigQuery, dbt et Looker pour extraire, transformer et visualiser des données massives.

Automatiser des rapports et tableaux de bord pour faciliter la prise de décision.

Participer à la veille technologique et proposer des innovations pour répondre aux enjeux du secteur de la Grande Distribution.

Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus d’analyse et de gouvernance des données.

Diplômé(e) d’un Bac +5 (école d’ingénieurs, statistique, économétrie, ou spécialisation en Data).

7 ans d’expérience minimum en tant que Data Analyst, avec une expertise avérée sur :

GCP (Google Cloud Platform) et BigQuery pour le traitement de données à grande échelle.

dbt pour la transformation et la modélisation des données.

Looker pour la visualisation et le partage des insights.

Expérience dans le secteur de la Grande Distribution (un atout majeur).

Maîtrise des outils SQL avancé, Python (Pandas, NumPy) et des bonnes pratiques en data governance.

Mobile en Île-de-France et recherchant un poste en CDI.

Rigoureux(se), analytique et orienté(e) solution, vous aimez relever des défis techniques et travailler sur des projets concrets à fort impact.

Title: Experienced Data Analyst (Ad-network)
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Voodoo Ad-Network is an autonomous product of around 30 people that carries the ambitious mission of providing ad network services. One goal is to leverage Voodoo’s first-party data to improve Voodoo’s monetisation. Moreover, the product is growing through new ventures like opening up to external inventory, reaching the external-advertisers market and social-network monetisation through BeReal’s recent acquisition. Thanks to promising results, our ambition is now to scale up the team to support growth.

The Ad Experience team owns the end-to-end quality of the ads delivered by our network, from ad rendering to data collection. It has a strong focus on viewability, tracker integrity and the diagnostic signals that feed our Machine Learning models. It’s composed of mostly senior Software Engineers, Mobile Developers, QA Engineers and Full Stack Engineers who iterate together to detect issues quickly, improve the user-side ad experience and protect the quality of the data flowing back into the product.

Role

We’re looking for an Experienced Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you will:


Work on end-to-end data projects with the Ad Experience squad to improve ad delivery quality, reduce ad-load and rendering failures, and maintain a high data quality.
Monitor SDK diagnostic events and build alerting, anomaly detection and root-cause analyses on top of the Ad Experience datasets.
Build data collection and transformation pipelines, and actionable dashboards.
Analyze large, complex data sets with billions of events representing the behaviour of mobile game players and of our ad network to investigate ad-quality regressions, attribution discrepancies and SDK rollouts.
Design solutions from scratch, iterate quickly, create POCs, and deploy to production rapidly.
Occasionally leverage Python skills and Statistics skills to support A/B tests on ad-experience changes


Profile


You possess substantial experience in analytical roles, ideally within a web or mobile company or the tech or ad tech industry.
You are highly skilled in SQL and have a proven track record of building production-ready pipelines that handle large and complex data sets.
You have solid experience in ETL development.
You have solid experience with DBT.
You have practical experience with Tableau or another standard dashboard platform, and can create dashboards that are shared company-wide, facilitating data-driven decision-making across departments.
Advanced knowledge of statistical tools and models will be considered a significant advantage.
Development skills, particularly in Python, will be considered a significant advantage
You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and are able to balance the tradeoff between time-consuming development and rapid results.
You have a solid problem solving mindset as well as a great track record demonstrating ownership and ability to come up with innovative ideas.
A BA/B.Sc degree in Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economy, or other quantitative fields is mandatory for this role.


Our Stack


DBT; Tableau; SQL; Athena; Spark; Python


Benefits


Competitive salary based on experience
Swile Lunch voucher
Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
Wellness activities in our Paris office
Remote Fridays

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Acasus:




“Impact for citizens.”




Acasus helps governments help people.




We are a consultancy delivering transformational reforms in health and education. We have built a reputation in dynamic, and often challenging, countries and contexts.




Acasus undertakes high-profile projects in an expanding group of countries, including: Pakistan, Chad, the DRC, Mozambique, Somalia, Afghanistan, Ethiopia and Nigeria. From increasing vaccine delivery, to providing greater education access for children, our consultants are helping millions of people access better services.




Apply to join us if you want the opportunity to do the same.




How will you make an impact?




You will use the latest data management technologies to improve health and education services for citizens in a number of low- and middle-income countries, including the DRC, Ethiopia, Afghanistan, Pakistan, Mozambique, Somalia, Chad, and others.




Tasks and responsibilities:

Work closely with local Associates to create regular analysis and data visualisations for all project stakeholders, including government officials
Understand general and country-specific project requirements
Deliver dashboards and data processing flows
Develop data processing flows that can be used as standards for multiple projects
Work on multiple projects simultaneously
Educate and support other associates and Data Analysts
Collaborate with other functional areas, such as Operations and Engineering




We are looking for:

2+ years of experience in data analysis
Advanced Tableau data visualisation skills, including dashboard design practices
Advanced analytical skills
Ability to present insights to senior stakeholders and decision makers
Advanced SQL skills
Experience with building and maintaining ETL flows is a plus
Experience with unstructured data (e.g. JSON files) is beneficial
Experience with geographic information system (GIS) analysis
Experience with Python or other programming languages is advantageous
Able to work individually and as part of a team
Excellent communication skills
Proficiency in written and spoken English




What's in it for you?

A competitive compensation package
Private Health Insurance
Cafeteria
Year-end bonus based on company and individual performance
High degrees of responsibility and autonomy
Opportunity to learn and grow in an enthusiastic and supportive environment
See your work have a tangible impact on health and education services every day




Our team is diverse in nationality, gender, race, religion, ethnicity, class, age, education and sexuality. Consequently, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.




Tune into the Acasus Podcast to explore our vital work in Africa and Asia. Here you can learn about the work of our team and listen to stories about the challenges that matter most.

Acasus undertakes high-profile projects in an expanding group of countries, including: Pakistan, Chad, the DRC, Mozambique, Somalia, Afghanistan, Ethiopia and Nigeria. From increasing vaccine delivery, to providing greater education access for children, our consultants are helping millions of people access better services.


Apply to join us if you want the opportunity to do the same.


How will you make an impact?


You will use the latest data management technologies to improve health and education services for citizens in a number of low- and middle-income countries, including the DRC, Ethiopia, Afghanistan, Pakistan, Mozambique, Somalia, Chad, and others.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Work closely with local Associates to create regular analysis and data visualisations for all project stakeholders, including government officials
  • Understand general and country-specific project requirements
  • Deliver dashboards and data processing flows
  • Develop data processing flows that can be used as standards for multiple projects
  • Work on multiple projects simultaneously
  • Educate and support other associates and Data Analysts
  • Collaborate with other functional areas, such as Operations and Engineering


We are looking for:

  • 2+ years of experience in data analysis
  • Advanced Tableau data visualisation skills, including dashboard design practices
  • Advanced analytical skills
  • Ability to present insights to senior stakeholders and decision makers
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Experience with building and maintaining ETL flows is a plus
  • Experience with unstructured data (e.g. JSON files) is beneficial
  • Experience with geographic information system (GIS) analysis
  • Experience with Python or other programming languages is advantageous
  • Able to work individually and as part of a team
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English


What's in it for you?

  • A competitive compensation package
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Cafeteria
  • Year-end bonus based on company and individual performance
  • High degrees of responsibility and autonomy
  • Opportunity to learn and grow in an enthusiastic and supportive environment
  • See your work have a tangible impact on health and education services every day


Our team is diverse in nationality, gender, race, religion, ethnicity, class, age, education and sexuality. Consequently, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.


Tune into the Acasus Podcast to explore our vital work in Africa and Asia. Here you can learn about the work of our team and listen to stories about the challenges that matter most.

Title: Data Analyst H/F
Description:
Le Poste

En tant que Data Analyst rattaché(e) au Pôle Pilotage commercial de la Direction de la Distribution, vous contribuez à la fiabilisation, la sécurisation et le traitement des données en assurant la consolidation des objectifs commerciaux.

Vous participez également à la production d'analyses et à la valorisation des données au travers d'outils de reporting et de visualisation destinés à accompagner le pilotage de l'activité.

Vos Missions Principales

Vous participez à la consolidation et à la mise à disposition des objectifs commerciaux afin de garantir un pilotage fiable de l’activité :


Vous consolidez les données relatives aux objectifs commerciaux et assurez leur déclinaison à l’ensemble des niveaux de l’organisation (territoires, directions, entités, équipes, collaborateurs).
Vous contrôlez la cohérence et la fiabilité des données utilisées dans le cadre des campagnes annuelles de fixation des objectifs.
Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers afin de recueillir, challenger et intégrer les évolutions nécessaires au pilotage commercial.
Vous transformez et valorisez les données issues de différentes sources (notamment Excel) afin d’alimenter les outils de reporting et les tableaux de bord Power BI.
Vous analysez les indicateurs commerciaux pour contribuer à la prise de décision et à l’amélioration de la performance.


Selon les besoins de l’équipe et les demandes entrantes, vous intervenez ponctuellement sur les requêtages et traitements de données nécessaires à la production des indicateurs (maintenance corrective, évolution et création de tableaux de bord, accompagnement des utilisateurs et traitement des anomalies).

Expérience Souhaitée


Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en Statistiques, Informatique Décisionnelle, Data ou en Contrôle de Gestion.
Votre expérience en consolidation annuelle des données dans un environnement orienté Contrôle de Gestion serait un plus à votre candidature.


Qualités personnelles :


Vous appréciez travailler avec des équipes métiers pluridisciplinaires.
Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.
Vous êtes autonome dans la conduite de vos missions et force de proposition.


Outils Informatiques


Vous maitrisez impérativement les modèles décisionnels, le langage SQL et un outil de data visualisation (idéalement Power BI).
Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils digitaux et bureautiques.
Vous serez formé(e) aux logiciels et aux processus internes d’Harmonie Mutuelle.


Nos Avantages


Accord d’intéressement
Télétravail jusqu'à 3 jours par semaine (à partir de 6 mois d'ancienneté)
22,5 jours de RTT par an
Carte déjeuner à 9,50 € (60 % pris en charge par l’employeur) et avantages CSE (enveloppes loisirs, culture, avantages vacances…)
Forfait mobilité durable : jusqu’à 400 € par an (cumulable avec le remboursement de l’abonnement aux transports en commun, dans la limite de 600 euros au total)
Contrat collectif santé et prévoyance
Plan d’épargne entreprise, plan d’épargne retraite et compte épargne temps
Formation : un parcours complet avec une plateforme d’apprentissage en ligne
2 jours d'engagement solidaire par an au profit d’associations


Le processus de recrutement :


Evaluation de votre CV par le recruteur
Entretien téléphonique avec le recruteur
Entretien avec le recruteur et avec votre futur manager
Test de personnalité suivi d’un débrief avec le recruteur


Chez Harmonie Mutuelle, votre métier contribue à une ambition collective : agir sur la santé de tous et prendre soin de chacun !


Nous sommes une entreprise mutualiste à mission et notre engagement est concret, porté par des actions de prévention, de conseil, d'accompagnement et de solidarité qui ont un vrai impact sur la vie de nos adhérents.
Nous encourageons les parcours singuliers : vous pouvez apprendre, évoluer, changer de métier ou de région grâce à la mobilité interne au sein du Groupe Vyv. L'important, c'est que votre trajectoire vous ressemble.
Nous savons que la diversité et l'inclusion sont une force, c'est pourquoi nous cultivons les différences et soutenons chaque individu. Nous luttons activement contre les discriminations et accompagnons, par exemple, nos salariés dans les moments de fragilité (maladies chroniques, aidance…). Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.
Au quotidien, vous évoluez dans un environnement de travail fondé sur la confiance, porté par un management qui valorise l'autonomie, l'écoute et le droit à l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle.
Nous faisons de l'innovation et des usages numériques un levier majeur de transformation de nos métiers au service de nos adhérents. Qu'il s'agisse de projets data et IA, de nouveaux usages digitaux ou de parcours clients repensés grâce à la tech, vous participez à notre transformation, au bénéfice de la santé de tous.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Gruppo Digital360 è il gruppo italiano che supporta imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione nella trasformazione digitale, nell’innovazione organizzativa e valorizzazione del brand e posizionamento.

Digital360 unisce rigore accademico e visione imprenditoriale, affiancando le organizzazioni e le imprese, pubbliche e private, con team multidisciplinari che integrano competenze di natura umanistica, economica, tecnologica, legale e organizzativa e riunisce manager, imprenditori e professionisti presenti sul mercato da oltre quarant’anni. All’interno delle sue tre Business Unit – Advisory, GOV e Connect- il Gruppo offre servizi che si sviluppano sui principali pillar della trasformazione digitale, diventando un vero abilitatore dell’evoluzione organizzativa e tecnologica delle aziende e delle organizzazioni.




Nato nel 2012 da un’iniziativa del Politecnico di Milano, il Gruppo Digital360 è oggi una Società Benefit, con headquarter in Italia, a Milano e a Roma, con oltre 1.300 persone e 140M € di ricavi nel 2025.




Attualmente siamo alla ricerca di un Data Analyst appassionato/a, capace di trasformare numeri complessi in storie chiare e strategie vincenti. Il/la candidato/a lavorerà nell’area di Business Information a diretto riporto della direzione IT e si occuperà di raccogliere requisiti e disegnare soluzioni a supporto del business, del board e dell’area finance.




Principali responsabilità:

Analisi e Reporting: estrarre, pulire e analizzare dati provenienti da diverse fonti per supportare il decision-making aziendale.
Data Visualization: progettare e mantenere report interattivi e dashboard d'impatto su Power BI.
Optimization: utilizzare Excel a livelli avanzati per analisi rapide, modelli finanziari o riconciliazioni dati.
Insight strategici: collaborare con i diversi team per identificare trend, anomalie e opportunità di crescita.
Data Quality: monitorare l'integrità dei dati e ottimizzare i processi di raccolta.




Competenze e capacità richieste:

Power BI: conoscenza di Power Query, modellazione dati e linguaggio DAX.
Excel: ottima padronanza (Pivot, Cerca.Vert/XLOOKUP, Formule nidificate, Power Pivot).
Data mindset: capacità di tradurre i requisiti di business in indicatori tecnici (KPI).
Curiosità intellettuale: non ti fermi al "cosa", vuoi capire il "perché".
Precisione: hai un occhio clinico per il dettaglio.
Comunicazione: sai spiegare dati complessi anche a chi non mastica i numeri.




Requisiti:

Esperienza: Almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli analoghi.
Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o percorsi affini, oppure diploma tecnico con competenze equivalenti.




Cosa offriamo:

Inserimento a tempo indeterminato con CCNL Commercio Terziario
RAL compresa tra 30.000€ e 35.000€, definita in funzione del profilo e dell’esperienza complessivamente maturata
Pacchetto welfare aziendale
Buoni pasto per ogni giorno lavorato.




Perché lavorare con noi:

Description:
PROPULSE IT accompagne ses clients grands comptes et PME dans la mise en œuvre des projets It et digitaux.

PROPULSE IT est un réseau de consultants à forte valeurs ajoutées, complètement associé à notre démarche qualité de suivi des besoins et projets de nos clients.

A ce jour, le réseau de freelance PROPULSE IT comporte plus de 30 000 consultants sur toute la France, et couvre l'ensemble des besoins IT et digitaux.

En constituant ce réseau par cooptation de clients ou de consultants, nous avons privilégié la constance dans le savoir-faire technique et le savoir-être, pour devenir un véritable partenaire privilégié de nos clients.

Parallèlement, nous avons développé un réseau de partenaires sélectionnés pour leur expertise technique, et l'adhésion aux valeurs de notre entreprise.

Aujourd'hui PROPULSE IT est une société en pleine croissance organique, Champion de la Croissance du journal Les Echos 5 années consécutives.

Ce développement s'appuie sur la qualité et la pérennité des missions réalisées.

La satisfaction client est ainsi liée à l'épanouissement des consultants !

Alors, n'hésitez pas à postuler !

POSTE / MISSIONS

Polyvalent.e, vous travaillerez sur des problématiques d'analyse de données, de traitements d'informations pour l'ensemble des directions métiers

Vous participerez à la mise en place de solutions innovantes et pérennes en utilisant vos compétences en Data.

En charge d'exploiter et d'analyser les données du groupe afin de suivre les performances business, de parfaire la connaissance de nos données et de contribuer aux actions métier.

Missions Principales

Vos principales missions seront :


Développer des indicateurs de pilotage à destination de différentes directions du groupe,
En lien avec le métier, analyser les données et spécifier aux développeurs les données et règles de gestion à appliquer
Mettre en place des reportings (Cockpit, Scorecard ...) via nos solutions de data visualisation,
Accompagner les projets transverses afin d'anticiper les impacts et enjeux à venir,
Accompagner les projets d'architecture Data/ couche sémantique sur Look ML
Réaliser des analyses et restituer les enseignements via des dashboards et supports clairs,
Être force de proposition pour déployer des suivis d'indicateurs pertinents,
Participer au développement de la culture Data du groupe


PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Compétences Techniques Requises


Maîtrise de Looker / Looker ML
Maîtrise du pack office (Excel niveau expert indispensable),
Parfaite connaissance du langage SQL Connaissances des langages de programmation (R ; Pyton…)
Pratique des logiciels du type QlikView, Microstrategy serait un plus


Qualités Attendues


Capacité à faire des analyses, des synthèses à valeur ajoutée pour le métier,
Capacité d'organisation et d'adaptabilité,
Rigoureux.se, vous êtes à l'aise pour travailler sur un projet de bout en bout,
Être autonome tout en gardant le sens du travail en équipe,
Faire preuve d'initiative, de curiosité, être bon(ne) communicant(e).


Formations/ Expériences


Formation Bac + 3 / 5 : formation scientifique, Université/écoles d'ingénieurs.
Vous justifiez idéalement d'une expérience de 6- 10 ans dans le domaine de traitement de la donnée de masse.
Une certification Looker ML


AVANTAGES

SELON PROFIL

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
As an F&B Data Analyst, you are at the center of complex challenges within the food and beverage industry. You translate large volumes of raw data, such as sales figures, inventory movements, consumer trends and production data, into clear strategic insights and concrete action points for our clients and internal teams.

Our company is based out of Vianen, Utrecht (NL). We are unable to offer work sponsorship for this role.

Who we are:

At Real Result, we are the independent purchasing experts for the dynamic foodservice industry. We help our clients maximize their procurement, whether it's through volume discounts, purchasing optimization, real-time cost price insights, or the realization of commercial kitchens and bars. We are looking for talent that helps our clients achieve their ambitions. Since 2025, Real Result has been part of Buyers Edge Platform, a digital procurement network/software platform for the foodservice industry that connects operators, distributors, and manufacturers. The platform offers group purchasing services, SaaS-based technology solutions, and supply chain consulting and procurement-related services to foodservice parties with the aim of reducing costs and improving supply chain decisions through data-driven technology. As a Buyer at Real Result, you are the linchpin in strategic purchasing processes. You work closely with various leading players in the sector, from hospitality to catering and from Leisure to on-the-move. Our client base is diverse and impressive. Think of names like Ron Blaauw, Perfect Serve, Albron, Beerze Bulten, Vue Cinemas, Koninklijk Theater Carré, and many others.

Your impact:


Data Analysis & Reporting: Develop, maintain and automate dashboards, KPI reports and analyses tailored to the food and beverage market.
Trend & Market Analysis: Identify consumption trends, seasonal effects and cost fluctuations within the F&B sector.
Advisory: Proactively advise clients and management based on data-driven insights to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
Data Quality Management: Safeguard the quality, integrity and reliability of supplied and processed data sources.
Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders to implement client-specific data solutions.
Accuracy and timeliness of delivered dashboards and analyses.
Measurable cost savings or efficiency gains realized for clients based on your recommendations.
Successful adoption and use of data tools by end users.


About you:


Education: Vocational (MBO) or bachelor's (HBO) degree in (Business) Mathematics, Data Science, Econometrics, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
Experience: 2 to 5 years of relevant work experience as a data analyst or in a similar role, preferably within the Food & Beverage, FMCG or retail sector.
Technical skills:
Excellent command of SQL and Excel.
Experience with visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Competencies: Strong analytical skills, results-oriented, communicative (able to translate complex data into understandable language for non-technical stakeholders) and commercially aware.


What We Offer:


A market-based salary aligned with your knowledge and experience, plus an attractive benefits package, including 25 vacation days, holiday allowance and flexible working hours.
Laptop and mobile phone.
Company car or mobility allowance
Excellent benefits and development opportunities.
Room for initiative and personal growth within an innovative and ambitious organization.
An inspiring work environment with passionate colleagues from the industry.


We welcome all.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.
