Title: Operations Data Analyst Associate
Description:
Standard Job Description

Responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to develop immersive stories that answer business questions. Using proven and sound statistical methods, the analyst draws insights from data, and translates those insights into action that drive business results. Data Analysts are extremely resourceful and able to find novel new data sources to enrich their analysis. They apply mathematical and statistical methods to business and risk management problems. Mine, process, and summarize data; Manage the quality assurance of data scraping, query databases for stakeholder requests, and triage data issues for timely resolutions; Analyze large datasets, draw valid inferences and prepare insights in narrative or visual forms, including dashboards; Set up and maintain data processes and new analytics capabilities; Produce and track key performance indicators; Ability to formulate functional and technical requirements from business problems; Program management of key tasks and resources to achieve cost and schedule.

Skills

This position is for a Chelmsford Production Operations Data Analyst. The selected candidate will leverage strong data analysis skills to provide key insights to manufacturing teams, support, and leadership to track and drive overall performance. The ideal candidate is someone who can:


Create and maintain interactive data analytics dashboards to measure and improve operations performance
Collect, analyze, and summarize data to communicate insightful information to key stakeholders
Work closely with leadership team, IT team, and other key stakeholders
Present thorough and detailed reports to identify areas of opportunity to drive future decision making
Perform data validation and maintain integrity of dashboards and databases
Maintain and optimize current Tableau dashboards
Complete Ad-hoc research request from senior leadership


Further Information About This Opportunity

MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN - This position is located at a facility that requires special access. The selected candidate must be able to obtain a Secret clearance.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree and 1-2 years of experience

Experience in Manufacturing, or Business Intelligence (BI) / Data Warehousing (DW) industry

Proficiency in SQL coding

Proficiency with Excel/MS Office Suite

Interest in machine learning or Natural Language Processing

Able to perform specialized data investigations to support analytics and custom reporting scenarios

Able to focus on results

Ability to interact and communicate effectively with colleagues on requirements

Ability to work independently as well as with a team

Energetic and a self-starter

Ability to obtain a secret security clearance within 1 year, which requires U.S. citizenship

Desired Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Data Analysis, Mathematics, or Business Analytics

Experience with SAP HANA

Experience with cloud-based data solutions (AWS preferred: EMR, Redshift, S3)

Experience with MS SharePoint

Experience with Grafana

Experience with VMware Tanzu / AWS Openshift

Proficiency with Tableau Desktop and Prep Builder

Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt certification)

Production Operations/Manufacturing background

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $65500.00 - $121700.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

Title: Senior GTM Data Analyst
Description:
About the company: LinkSquares is a Boston-based, AI-powered CLM SaaS leader trusted by organizations like DraftKings, Manscaped, and Vivid Seats. We automate the contracting process for legal, finance, and HR teams, helping them save time, cut costs, and improve business outcomes. For more information, visit linksquares.com.

About the team: Join our Revenue Operations organization, the central engine of our Revenue Team that sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, sales execution, and AI innovation. We are a detail-oriented and financially driven team dedicated to driving long-term value and growth by transforming internal processes into strategic advantages. We prioritize a "learn and get better" mentality, where you will not only execute proven processes but actively help refine them for the next generation of LinkSquares' growth.

About the role: As the Senior GTM Data Analyst, you will shape how we understand and optimize our growth engine by owning the analytical truth layer across the entire revenue organization. In this high-impact role, you will function as an internal revenue economist and independent partner to the VP of Revenue Operations and GTM executives, answering three critical questions: What is happening? Why is it happening? What should we do about it?

You’ll join a collaborative team where you have the autonomy to evolve an existing foundation while building new, scalable data models, KPI architectures, and executive reporting systems that directly influence strategic decisions. Sitting at the intersection of revenue analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, and strategic decision support, this is an ideal role for a strategic thinker who enjoys the balance of technical depth, commercial judgment, and hands-on execution.

Responsibilities:

Serve as an independent analytical partner to GTM leadership, analyzing performance across the full customer lifecycle (pipeline creation, conversion, bookings, retention, expansion, and churn) to surface emerging trends, quantify business impact, and recommend strategic actions.
KPI Architecture & Dashboards: Own the Revenue organization's KPI architecture, metric definitions, and calculation logic across Sales, CX, Marketing, Product, and Finance. Rationalize reporting, reduce dashboard sprawl, and create trusted, scalable reporting.
Planning & Scenario Analytics: Develop models that support revenue planning, pipeline coverage, conversion, velocity, push/slip, and productivity analysis. Model upside/downside scenarios and leading indicators of risk to improve organizational predictability.
Executive & Board Support: Own the analytical development of recurring executive and Board reporting, ensuring outputs are grounded in reconciled metrics, consistent business logic, and clear, decision-ready frameworks.
Data Modeling & Architecture: Own, build, and optimize durable transformation and semantic models across the modern data stack for core GTM concepts (accounts, pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention, expansion, churn, and customer lifecycle) while ensuring data quality and lineage.
Analytics Innovation & AI: Leverage AI tools and automation to accelerate analytical workflows, investigation, documentation, quality assurance, and insight generation while establishing responsible AI governance and patterns.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Product, and Finance to challenge assumptions, guide roadmap prioritization, and act as a trusted advisor on major GTM decisions.

Requirements:

B2B SaaS Experience: 6+ years supporting a B2B SaaS or recurring-revenue business, with deep fluency in SaaS/GTM economics, unit economics, and full customer lifecycle analysis across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Experience.
Technical & Modeling Depth: Advanced proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Looker (or comparable BI tool), Git, semantic-layer design, ETL/ELT concepts, and data quality monitoring, alongside strong familiarity with Salesforce and GTM data structures.
AI Integration: Demonstrated proficiency using AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows, documentation, automation, and insight generation, with a strong ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs against governed data.
Analytical & Commercial Mindset: Experience building and governing enterprise KPI frameworks, pipeline/forecasting models, and executive/Board reporting with the ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable commercial insights.
Collaborative Leadership: A track record of working across departments (Operations, Finance, Sales, CX, Product) to align on metric definitions, establish single-source-of-truth frameworks, and drive consensus.
Adaptability & Rigor: High standard of intellectual independence and curiosity, with the ability to bring clear recommendations—not just data—in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Compensation for this role includes an annual base salary range between $150,000 to $175,000. The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus. LinkSquares takes into consideration a number of factors when determining an employee’s starting salary, including work location, job-related skills, and relevant education, experience and training. The recruiter assigned to this role will share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

Candidates are eligible to participate in the company’s benefit programs. LinkSquares’ benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k retirement plan with a company match, equity awards (a new hire grant, along with opportunities for additional awards throughout your tenure), flexible paid time off, generous parental leave, life and disability insurances and more.

LinkSquares is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on any legally protected characteristics.

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst, Dealer
Description:
Who We Are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What We Do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to join our Dealer team which tackles a complex data environment, building out core assets, running experiments, and many more unstructured analytics tasks to support the growth of the dealer product suite.

Our Product Data Analytics org as a whole supports our Product and Engineering teams, providing the final word on all analytics for CarGurus’ user and dealer experiences. We are looking for thoughtful, curious, internally driven candidates who can dive into complex data and draw novel, insightful conclusions.

What You’ll Do


Conduct exploratory empirical analyses using SQL and Python that bridge disparate data sources (e.g. website usage, subscription records, inventory volumes, etc.). to quantify product performance, user behavior, and/or market trends. Distill unstructured “big data” around product performance, user behavior and/or market insights into actionable outcomes.
Creatively compress sweeping, high-level exploratory requests into specific calculations that address your stakeholders’ underlying needs. Relentlessly dig into the data, taking initiative to consult with other individuals and teams as you judge necessary. Go beyond the letter of the initial assignment, to hammer out any anomalies or self-direct your inquiry into other relevant issues.
Advocate and participate in brainstorming/planning sessions for specific, data-driven product innovations that help further high-level company strategy, primarily in partnership with the Product/Engineering teams.
Avoid passivity in the face of flawed proposals; tactfully and persuasively push back against potential missteps.

Title: Senior Analyst, Property Claims Analytics
Description:
Description

The Loss Insights Analytics team sits within US Retail Markets Property Claims organization and is at the center of some of the most consequential decisions in our claims organization. We quantify the financial impact of changes across the full lifecycle of a claim — from first notice of loss through final resolution — including the adoption of new tools, vendors, and process innovations. We are a team of rigorous, intellectually driven analysts who believe that the right question, asked at the right time, is just as powerful as the right answer. If you are energized by complex problems, motivated by meaningful work, and want your analysis to directly shape how one of the world's largest insurers handles billions of dollars in property claims, this is your team.


This role may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location**


Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote.

About The Role

We are hiring a Senior Analyst to join the Loss Insights team. In this role, you will design and execute high-complexity analyses that drive tangible improvements to claims handling processes and financial outcomes. You will serve as a trusted analytical voice to senior stakeholders, translating nuanced data findings into clear, compelling recommendations. This is not just a reporting role — it is a thinking role. You will be expected to challenge assumptions, identify the stories hidden in data, and advocate for evidence-based decisions.

What You Will Do


Drive Financial Insight: Design and conduct moderate-to-high complexity analyses evaluating the financial performance of claims operations, process changes, and newly adopted tools or vendor partnerships across the full claim lifecycle.
Measure What Matters: Build and maintain reporting frameworks that track initiative success, financial performance, and key operational metrics — ensuring stakeholders always have a clear, accurate picture of business outcomes.
Lead Analytical Projects: Own moderately complex, end-to-end analytical projects independently, partnering with Claims Process, Data Office, Product, and other key partners to develop rigorous solutions and see initiatives through to measurable impact.
Turn Data into Action: Synthesize complex, multi-source data into concise, actionable recommendations and present findings confidently to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
Shape the Future of Claims: Contribute to a team culture of intellectual curiosity and continuous improvement, proactively identifying new analytical opportunities that enhance customer outcomes and operational efficiency.


What We're Looking For


You are intellectually curious. You don't just answer the question asked — you interrogate it. You are energized by ambiguity, drawn to complex problems, and always looking for the insight beneath the surface.
You are analytically rigorous. You have hands-on experience gathering, interpreting, and synthesizing data across multiple sources. You are proficient in one or more of the following: SAS, SQL, Python, or R — and you know how to use these tools not just to pull data, but to build compelling analytical narratives.
You think critically and communicate clearly. You can translate a sophisticated analysis into a story that resonates with a non-technical audience. You are comfortable presenting to stakeholders and defending your methodology under scrutiny.
You are a proactive, organized self-starter. You manage your own workload with discipline, follow through without being prompted, and thrive in an environment where you are trusted to work independently.
You are a collaborative team player. You bring energy and engagement to the team, invest in the success of your colleagues, and build strong relationships across partner teams.


Qualifications


Bachelor's Degree plus a minimum 3 years, typically 4 or more years of experience, or equivalent, is required. Mathematics, Economics, Statistics or other quantitative field are preferred fields of study.
Advanced knowledge of data sources, tools, statistical principles and methodologies, and techniques.
Advanced proficiency in Excel (VBA, macros, scripts, formulas, data visualization, etc.), PowerPoint, and statistical software packages (SAS, Snowflake).
Must have good planning, analytical, decision-making and communication skills.
Solid understanding of business to improve business outcomes.

Title: Claims Analyst
Description:
The Claims Analyst will be responsible for supporting the effective management of claims portfolios through data analysis, forecasting, and reporting, providing insights into claim trends and financial performance to inform decision-making in line with Group Claims processes.




Responsibilities

Analyze claims data across managed portfolios to identify trends, patterns, and key drivers of loss performance
Support claims forecasting activities, including projections of loss development, reserves, and financial outcomes
Prepare and maintain regular management reporting on claims performance, key metrics, and emerging trends
Partner with Claims, Finance, Actuary, IT, and Operations teams to validate data accuracy and ensure consistency across reporting outputs
Monitor and analyze variances between actuals and forecasts, providing insights and recommendations to support decision-making
Develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data models to improve visibility into claims performance
Support the identification and remediation of unreconciled data, reporting, and systems-related gaps impacting claims analytics and forecasting capabilities
Contribute to initiatives aimed at improving consistency and standardization across claims processes, including controls, KPIs, and governance practices
Provide analytical support for portfolio reviews, including evaluation of resource needs, alignment with forecasted claims outcomes, and overview of portfolio performance
Assist in tracking and prioritizing operational and reporting improvements to enhance readiness, scalability, and overall claims performance
Ensure data integrity and compliance with internal controls, reporting standards, and Group Claims policies
Work with external stakeholders to fulfill any claims related requests, including loss runs, data calls and other time-sensitive matters
Support ad hoc analysis requests related to claims performance, portfolio trends, and emerging risks




Requirements

2–6+ years of relevant experience in insurance, claims analytics, or financial/data analysis
Experience working with large data sets, including reporting, trend analysis, and performance monitoring
Strong analytical capability and problem-solving skills, including experience with data modeling, forecasting, and variance analysis
Advanced Excel Skills (e.g., Pivot Tables and Lookup Formulas) proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL ,SAP, or similar analytics platforms) and PowerPoint skills strongly desired
Solid understanding of insurance and/or reinsurance business models, with exposure to claims operations preferred
Strong business writing and reporting skills, with the ability to present insights clearly and concisely
Demonstrated attention to detail and a high level of data accuracy
Ability to translate data into actionable insights to support business decision-making
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across all levels of the Claims, Finance, IT, and Operations teams
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
High level of motivation and creativity to identify and develop new strategies and approaches to problems, creating efficiencies in existing and new processes
Must be legally authorized to work in USA.
Limited travel may be required.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst – Utilities & Energy

Company: Aaratech Inc.

Employment Type: Full-Time, W2 (deployed to client projects)

Experience: 2–4 years

Compensation: $65,000 – $75,000 per year

Work Mode: On-Site / Hybrid

Work Authorization

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Why This Role?

The grid is going digital — smart meters, renewables, and AMI data have made utilities one of the most data-hungry industries in America. Get in early on an analytics niche with huge demand and surprisingly little competition.

Job Summary

Aaratech Inc. is seeking a Data Analyst – Utilities & Energy to turn smart-meter, outage, asset, and customer data into insight. You will build reliability and load reporting, support demand forecasting and grid-modernization analytics, and deliver findings that improve operations and customer programs.

Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, and analyze AMI/smart-meter, SCADA, outage, asset, and customer datasets using SQL and Python.
Design and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for load, reliability metrics (SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI), and asset performance.
Support demand forecasting, load research, and energy-efficiency/demand-response program analytics.
Analyze outage and asset-health data to support predictive maintenance and grid-modernization initiatives.
Prepare data for regulatory reporting and rate-case filings to public utility commissions.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reporting quality across platforms.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to operations, planning, and regulatory stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related field.
2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably in utilities, energy, or another asset-intensive industry.
Strong, hands-on SQL skills — complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization.
Proficiency with Power BI or Tableau, plus advanced Microsoft Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, advanced formulas).
Hands-on experience with operational, sensor/meter, time-series, or customer data at scale.
Strong analytical, data-storytelling, and stakeholder-communication skills.

Tools & Technologies You Will Use

Analytics & querying: SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL), Python (pandas, NumPy) including time-series analysis.
BI & visualization: Power BI (DAX, Power Query), Tableau, Excel.
Utility data & systems: AMI/MDM platforms, SCADA/OT historians (OSIsoft PI exposure a plus), CIS/billing data.
Geospatial & cloud: Esri ArcGIS, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure or AWS data services.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of energy markets, demand response, load forecasting, or renewable-integration concepts.
Familiarity with reliability metrics (SAIDI, SAIFI, CAIDI) and regulatory reporting.
Exposure to predictive maintenance or asset-analytics use cases.
Certifications such as Microsoft PL-300, Tableau Desktop Specialist, or Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate are a plus.

About Aaratech Inc.

Aaratech Inc. is a technology-driven organization delivering innovative solutions across cybersecurity, data & analytics, healthcare, and enterprise domains. We are committed to helping organizations transform data into actionable insights through advanced analytics, modern technologies, and data-driven innovation.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
At the MBTA, we envision a thriving region enabled by a best-in-class transit system. Our mission is to serve the public by providing safe, reliable, and accessible transportation. MBTA’s core values are built around safety, service, equity, sustainability, culture, and accessibility, and each employee that works for the MBTA performs their roles based on our vision, mission, and values. This includes attendance, participation, and contribution in local safety committee meetings as needed.

Job Summary

The Business Intelligence Analyst will bring experience in data visualization, data analytics, and storytelling to assist the MBTA to use data and performance metrics to drive decision making and to measure the health of its Capital Investment Program (CIP). The Capital Finance and Accounting (CFA) department is responsible for enterprise-wide capital program reporting across projects and departments for presentations to Senior Management and the Board of Directors. The Business Intelligence Analyst conducts deep data analysis using data management, data conversion and data governance, and is responsible for understanding, developing, enhancing, and maintaining the technical components to all the relevant data sources that inform reports and dashboards. This position is in the CFA Department and will work closely with various CFA staff as well as Capital Departments and respective IT stakeholders.


This requisition will close once the posting exceeds 200 applicants.**


Duties & Responsibilities


Develop complex visualizations using Tableau Desktop for consumption by the respective stakeholder groups dependent on the reporting needs, ensuring data is used correctly to explain narratives and storytelling.
Prepare capital reports utilizing several sources including Microsoft Excel spreadsheets and various systems.
Implement, execute, and optimize data extraction, cleansing, consolidation, and conversion processes and utilities, including the development of a data governance framework.
Analyze data and data models to understand data relationships and how they co-exist in different sources, writing SQL scripts to extract, consolidate and publish data to reports and data to visualization tools, e.g., Microsoft Excel and Tableau.
Write advanced SQL scripting to support ad-hoc reporting needs and to extract, consolidate, and publish data for reporting and visualization tools such as Tableau, and develop and maintain data models, databases, data warehouses, and related SQL processes.
Support the transition of our legacy Capital Management System (CMS) to a new Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system based in Oracle/Peoplesoft and conversion to Tableau Cloud as well as leveraging AI capabilities.
Evaluate potential future reporting solutions and dashboards for the capital program and facilitate and participate in the design and implementation of the solution.
Structure data for optimal presentation, access, performance, and integration.
Set standards for technical documentation and maintain business intelligence (BI) objects.
Perform data profiling to identify and understand anomalies.
Work closely with data modelers and developers.
Adhere to rules, regulations, collective bargaining agreements (if applicable) and policies of the MBTA including the EEO, anti-discrimination, anti-harassment, and anti-retaliation policies.
Perform all other duties and projects that may be assigned.


Additional responsibilities may include a focus on one or more departments or locations. See applicable addendum for department or location-specific functions.

Supervision


No direct reports.


Minimum Requirements & Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in computer science, engineering or related field.
Two (2) years of experience with development and maintenance of data models, databases, data warehouses, data lakes and/or SQL scripts.
Experience with data analysis, data cleansing, data extraction, data conversion, and data governance.
Experience with report development, data visualization, and storytelling.
Advanced expertise in Tableau Desktop, Tableau Cloud, Tableau Prep Builder, Microsoft Excel,and Microsoft PowerPoint.
Analytical and synthesis skills.
Flexibility and diplomacy in interpersonal relationships.
Organizational skills and ability to multitask (work on several projects at once).
Able to operate beyond policies and high-level business processes to define and document supporting standards and procedures.
Experience gathering requirements and developing reports that match those requirements.
Strong communication skills.
Implementation experience in agile methodology.

Description:
ERG is a research and consulting firm that provides a wide range of support to federal, state, and commercial clients. ERG offers multidisciplinary teams with nationally recognized skills in engineering, science, economics, public health, informational technology, and communications. We hire people with the best minds and then provide them with a vibrant and flexible environment in which to develop their careers. The qualified individual must be highly motivated with the skills to prioritize, perform, and communicate effectively in a fast-paced environment. 




ERG’s Environmental and Occupational Health Group has an immediate opening for an early career professional to join our multi-disciplinary team. This individual will support a range of environmental and sustainability-related projects, including a clean energy grant program. The qualified individual must be highly motivated with the skills to prioritize, perform, and communicate effectively in a fast-paced environment. Responsibilities include managing large datasets, working with applicants to meet grant program requirements, using grant management software and related database applications to support client needs, and interfacing directly with clients.




 




Ideal candidates will have direct experience developing and supporting data visualization tools; conducting independent research and data analysis; and providing client services. 




Job Description:


Review clean energy grant applications for eligibility and completeness


Process payment requests and interface with applicants throughout the grant process


Identify and categorize potential application errors and communicate them to applicants and clients


Help develop and maintain a public-facing government data dashboard


Analyze, collect, and organize data to support greenhouse gas, energy, and water reduction projects, benchmarking, and reporting


Research and develop briefing materials on sustainability topics, including decarbonization and building and fleet electrification


Provide additional data analysis and technical communications support on environmental, sustainability, and public health topics







Qualifications and Skills:


Bachelor’s degree in environmental science or a related field


Minimum of one year of experience working with environmental or sustainability-related data


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other data management tools preferred


Experience with data visualization software, such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik Sense


Familiarity with energy efficiency improvements, water conservation measures, and greenhouse gas emissions inventories


Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, including experience drafting technical reports and presenting findings


Experience working with and managing large, complex datasets


Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary team


Strong interpersonal skills with a customer service focus


Ability to take initiative, stay organized, and manage multiple tasks










ERG offers competitive salaries and excellent benefits, including health and dental insurance, life insurance, long-term disability, educational benefits, FSAs, a generous 401k plan, profit sharing, an EAP, 11-20 paid vacation days per year, 10 paid holidays per year, 56 hours or more of sick leave (based on the state you work in) per year (pro-rated for part-time) and more. The salary range for all positions depends on the years and type of experience.

Title: Medical Insights, Data Analyst Senior Manager
Description:
Role Summary

The Data Analyst, Medical Insights (Senior Manager) is accountable for delivering ad hoc and exploratory analysis that answers business and scientific questions the platform can't natively address, working globally across regions and the Medical Insights team. This role partners closely with the Insights Platform Lead, surfacing where recurring analytical requests reveal gaps the platform should be built to close. It's a strategic fit for an analyst who wants direct, high-visibility impact on real business decisions while helping shape the future direction of a fast-growing global analytics platform.

Role Responsibilities

Ad Hoc & Exploratory Analysis (~70-80%)


Respond to ad hoc business and medical questions that cannot currently be answered through InsightXplorer, going directly to underlying data sources as needed.
Investigate and synthesize findings into clear, decision-relevant outputs for Medical Affairs stakeholders.
Prepare, validate, and maintain datasets required for exploratory and recurring analyses.
Partner with Engagement Leads to clarify business questions, analytical scope, and timelines.


Experimentation & Innovation (~20-30%, protected)


Test, pilot, and evaluate new data sources, analytical methods, or AI-enabled approaches ahead of platform investment.
Produce proof-of-concept analyses that give the Product Director independent, evidence-based input into roadmap prioritization decisions.
Document findings, limitations, and recommendations from experimentation to inform go/no-go platform decisions.


Quality & Documentation


Maintain documentation for data sources, definitions, transformations, assumptions, and analytical methods.
Support responsible, compliant use of Medical Insights data in accordance with governance, privacy, and legal requirements.


Basic Qualifications

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of external stakeholders to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Clinical Informatics, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
6+ years of relevant experience conducting data analysis, interpretation, and reporting in a pharmaceutical, healthcare, or regulated environment.
Proficiency with analytical and data-visualization tools such as SQL, Tableau, Power BI, Dataiku, Python, or R.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical approaches and clear outputs, working independently.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to analytical accuracy, documentation, and reproducibility.


Preferred Qualifications


Advanced degree or certification in analytics, data science, statistics, or a related discipline.
Experience in Medical Affairs or a related pharmaceutical function.
Familiarity with natural-language processing, machine learning, or text-analytics approaches.
Experience running proof-of-concept or pilot analyses ahead of production build-out.


Professional Capabilities


Applies analytical and critical thinking to complex medical and business questions.
Balances reactive, time-sensitive analysis with protected proactive experimentation.
Communicates complex analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.


Other Job Details:


Last Date to Apply for Job: September 23rd, 2026.
Locations: NYHQ or PA-Collegeville or MA-Cambridge or CT-Groton or Europe any Pfizer site or QC - Montreal
NOT Eligible for Relocation Package
Position is hybrid and will require to work 2 to 3 days per week on site

Title: Advanced Analytics & Revenue Strategy Reporting Analyst
Description:
Ocean Spray is hiring for a(n) Advanced Analytics & Revenue Strategy Reporting Analyst! We’re a team of farmers, thinkers, creators, and doers. Whatever your title, whatever your role — it always comes back to this: we’re a farmer-owned co-op where everyone rolls up their sleeves to get the job done. Three maverick farmers started it all — and we’ve been making our own way ever since.

The Advanced Analytics & Revenue Strategy Reporting Analyst impacts the future success of Ocean Spray by developing and maintaining reports that address business questions and deliver insights that lead to greater sales and profit. The role requires the ability to work cross functionally with multiple business partners and stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple simultaneous projects and deadlines. The ability to translate multiple complex data sets into clear and concise reporting and dashboards is essential to the role.

They will also assist with the development, integration, and commercialization of learnings across Ocean Spray and functional partners to analyze data, standardize KPIs, develop internal score cards, all while driving best practices.

A Day in the Life...


Update sales, media, innovation, and buyer behavior reporting.
Assist with Sales & Trade spend reporting, data queries, pulls and analyses.
Support the optimization of existing reports inclusive of both front end and back-end improvements as well as support the transition to centralized reporting workspaces.
Help facilitate data driven decision making by providing insights and trends pertinent to the business.
Work to understand key business questions and assist in developing report tracking, KPIs and dashboards to help best manage the business.
The ability to analyze large, complex internal data sources, providing analytic solutions, cross-group guidance, and support training where necessary for interpretation and implementation of results.
Ability to perform ad hoc analyses to answer business questions and support decision-making


Required

What We Are Looking For:


Bachelor’s Degree
1+ years of relevant experience
Understanding of syndicated (e.g. Nielsen, IRI, SPINS) and POS data
Understanding of PowerBI (or other reporting platform) including establishment of data models, applications, reporting, and executive dashboards
Use tools like SQL, Excel, and visualization software to create reports, conduct ad hoc analyses, and communicate actionable insights to stakeholders
Understanding of key financial metrics and their drivers
Strong written and oral communication


Education

Bachelor's or University Degree (Required)

Work Experience

At least 1 Year of Experience

Annual Salary

$65,700 - $82,100

The base salary range information above serves as a guideline of the position’s typical hiring range. We value and appreciate what makes you unique and will consider a variety of factors when determining an offer. These factors include, but are not limited to, your skills and experience, external and internal benchmarks, as well as overall company considerations. Certain positions may be eligible for short-term and long-term incentive rewards. We also offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well-being.

Benefits


Complete insurance package on Day-1 that includes a plethora of health and wellness programs
Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
Health savings account
Flexible spending account
Life and accident insurance
Employee assistance program
Telehealth services
1:1 health coaching
Supportive benefits for all the stages of your life
401(k) with up to 6% Company matching; additional potential discretionary match at year-end
Short-Term Incentive/Performance bonuses
Flexible scheduling options
Vacation pay, up to three weeks of time (pro-rated for your first year of employment)
Holiday pay for 12 holidays
Career development and growth opportunities
Tuition/Education assistance programs
Access to LinkedIn Learning
Scholarship programs for children of employees
Parental leave
Bright Horizons Family Solutions – Back-up care, tutoring, etc.
Adoption assistance
Bereavement leave
Up to $300 fitness reimbursement
Up to $300 massage reimbursement
Employee appreciation events
Employee discounts
Charitable giving

Who We Are

You might have our iconic cranberry juice in your fridge or have gotten into heated holiday debate about what’s better - canned or fresh cranberry sauce. But did you know that the hardworking people growing the superfruit in our products are 700 family farmers that own our cooperative? They entrust us with what is most precious to them to create new and innovative products that will delight consumers and grow this beloved brand today and into the future.

Team Members, Farmers, Consumers And Communities Alike--we Value What Makes Us Unique And Strive To Connect Our Farms To Families For a Better Life By Living Our Values


Grower Mindset – We embrace our grower-owners innovative spirit and heritage through confidence, learning and focus on the future.
Sustainable Results – Guided by purpose, we are focused on delivering results for our grower-owners.
Integrity Above All – We are ethical, doing the right thing for our grower-owners, customers, consumers and each other
Inclusive Teamwork – We build diverse and inclusive teams that strengthen our cooperative.

Do you love to improve business processes and drive improvement through data analytics? Are you looking for a role that supports a diverse and growing portfolio developing and producing the most advanced electronic systems that protect our warfighters? Required Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related work experience
Experience with manufacturing standards, processes and techniques
Strong technical skills in data analysis
Strong communication skills
Experience working in cross functional teams
Experience using dashboards and reporting for business intelligence
Experience using GenAI models for analysis




Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a technical field
Background in data analytics or data science
Experience with Mat lab, Python, SQL, or other programming language
Experience in project management
Process or Product Engineering experience
New product introduction experience
Proven success with change management in a fast-paced, manufacturing environment



Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $118095 - $200762

However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems Electronic Systems


BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

Title: Senior Health Data Operations Analyst - Compass
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Senior Health Data Analyst, you will focus on analyzing health data within the Veeva Compass product suite. Veeva Compass delivers record-level prescription and medical claims data to power longitudinal, de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases—including patient journey, market landscape, and provider engagement.

You will be responsible for driving data quality, consistency, and standardization within the Terminology Reference Library (TRL) by managing reference data for key attributes found across prescription and medical claims—including drug information, ICD-10 diagnosis codes, procedure and lab codes, as well as payer and plan data. In this role, you will query prescription and medical claims datasets to support the evaluation and integration of new inbound data sources into core schemas. Additionally, you will define and track key quality metrics via interactive dashboards, contributing to technical documentation and validation reports to ensure our reference data remains accurate, scalable, and seamlessly integrated across all Veeva products.

What You’ll Do


Drive TRL Governance: Maintain and expand the Terminology Reference Library (TRL), managing core reference datasets across prescription and medical claims (including drug information, ICD-10 codes, procedure/lab codes, and payer/plan data).
Evaluate & Integrate New Data: Conduct deep-dive data querying, field mapping, and structural analysis on potential new data sources to evaluate fit and integrate them into existing core schemas.
Execute Quality & Cleansing Workflows: Perform exploratory data analysis to identify discrepancies, handle missing values, execute deduplication, and ensure data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.
Continuous Product Improvement: Investigate data anomalies within the Veeva Compass product suite, testing both planned and unplanned data changes to assess downstream customer impact.
Build Metrics & Documentation: Develop interactive dashboards to track key data quality metrics, contributing to technical documentation, validation reports, and team process improvements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Developers to articulate data quality nuances, uncover root causes, and build robust data pipelines.


Requirements


4+ years of experience analyzing record-level prescription and medical claims datasets.
4+ years of experience in health data quality analysis, data profiling, and data governance principles.
Advanced SQL proficiency, with extensive experience querying, manipulating, and aggregating large-scale relational databases.
Deep working knowledge of healthcare code sets and industry standards, including NDC, ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, LOINC, and payer/plan reference data.
Proven track record in data storytelling: Experience analyzing, visualizing, and demonstrating data quality findings to stakeholders using Excel, BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Sigma), or interactive dashboards.
Strong problem-solving mindset: Eagerness to dive deep into complex, unstructured healthcare data issues, identify root causes, and propose innovative solutions.
Bachelor’s degree in a STEM, quantitative, or healthcare informatics field, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have


Experience in Python
Experience with the BI tool Sigma
Experience in life science industry


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program


Compensation


Base pay: $80,000 - $125,000
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.


Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. Description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses (https://www.idexcorp.com/our-businesses/business-segments/) around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

JOB TITLE: Finance Data & Transformation Analyst

REPORTING TO: Finance Manager, IH&S

LOCATION: Remote

Who is IDEX Health & Science (IH&S)?

As a business unit of IDEX Corporation, IH&S has a long history of driving growth in life sciences and healthcare by embracing innovation and redefining the supplier-customer relationship. The work we do every day allows us to discover key insights and break new ground to create some of the most meaningful technologies that have a lasting impact on companies, industries, and society. One of business segments is called Life Science Fluidics and we are looking to add more talent to the team.

IDEX Health & Science (IH&S)

IH&S is comprised of six domestic and one international business unit. IH&S is a manufacturing and R&D focused team that sits at the leading edge of high-end fluidic and optical applications for life sciences. Focused on assisting partners at every stage of the development processes, we invest in people and infrastructure to drive bold ideas and pragmatic solutions. With the rich foundation of talent, universities, and supporting businesses, IH&S is the ideal location to elevate your career with fascinating work and endless opportunities.

Our formula for success is simple. We work hard to maintain a culture where you can own your work; you are encouraged to try new ideas in a collaborative environment; and you can apply your skillset to enable our clients to gain a competitive advantage in their own market. At IDEX Health & Science, you will have the opportunity to work with a great group of people, mentor others, and build a great future.

Scope Of Role

This position plays a critical role in advancing IH&S’s finance data transformation initiatives by focusing on developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, enabling standardized financial reporting, and translating complex financial and operational data into clear, decision-ready insights. In addition to supporting ongoing reporting needs, this individual will contribute to the design and implementation of scalable data models that support forecasting, KPI tracking, and executive-level performance visibility. Working within an Agile framework, this role will prioritize enhancements and ensure delivery of high-impact analytics solutions that support business performance and strategic decision-making.

Essential Duties


Building data models and creating processes for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting cycles, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of data
Analyze financial and operational data to identify ways to capture and report on trends, variances, risks, and opportunities, and present findings to finance leadership
Partner with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, IT, and Operations teams to ensure data consistency, and alignment between the tools (dashboards/reports) used for financial reporting and to monitor business performance drivers
Maintain and prioritize reporting and analytics backlogs leveraging the Agile framework.
Support executive-level reporting by creating clear, concise, and visually compelling dashboards and summaries.
Contribute to finance and business transformation initiatives, including automation of reporting processes and improvement of data accessibility and usability
Support various workflows by developing financial KPI calculation logic, creating PBI visuals for leadership consumption.
Support standardized reporting frameworks and ongoing transformation initiatives related to forecasting, reporting standardization, and data governance


Job Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field, with an emphasis in quantitative methods, statistical modeling, and data science.
3+ years of experience in financial analysis, business intelligence, or data analytics roles in a manufacturing financial environment.
Strong understanding of and experience with financial accounting concepts including financial reporting, cost accounting, FP&A. and KPI development
Understanding of ERP software is required, proficiency in JD Edwards is preferred.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology is preferred. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum outside of traditional software design is ideal.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into effective technical solutions.
Strong proficiency in Power BI, including DAX and data modeling.
Attention to detail, with consistent application of audit trails, versioning, and documented best practices.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization.


TOTAL REWARDS (May Vary by State)

While the full compensation range for this role is listed below, our anticipated hiring range is $90,000-$105,000 . This projected range is an estimate and will vary based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications, so it is not a guaranteed offer amount. This position may also be eligible for a performance-based bonus plan.

Location:

This position is a remote role; however, we are seeking candidates who reside within reasonable proximity to an IDEX Health & Science (IH&S) location. While day‑to‑day work is performed remotely, occasional on‑site collaboration, training, or team events may be required. Applicants should be located close enough to commute to an IH&S facility when needed.

IDEX Health & Science LLC., a Unit of IDEX Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity

Are you ready to join a different kind of company where our people, our culture, and our commitments are centered around providing trusted solutions that improve lives around the world?

Total Rewards

The compensation range for this position is $78,200.00 - $117,200.00, depending on experience. This position may be eligible for performance based bonus plan.

Benefits Package

Our comprehensive U.S. benefit offerings include: Health benefits, 401(k) retirement savings program with company match, PTO, and more. More information on our benefits and rewards can be found on our career page: https://www.idexcorp.com/careers/our-benefits-and-rewards/

Title: Associate Data Analyst
Description:
At MarketOnce, we empower businesses with the insights and strategies they need to excel in today's dynamic market. With a strong foundation in market research, we offer innovative solutions in research, software, consulting, advertising, and marketing to corporate, private equity firms, and other organizations seeking to achieve their goals.

Our team is distinguished by their client-centric approach—treating each client's business with the dedication and care as if it were their own. This commitment enables us to deliver personalized service and achieve the highest standards of success and innovation in everything we do. Together, our family of companies, including MarketOnce, ROI Rocket, and eAccountable, work towards delivering unparalleled solutions. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, our global team collaborates from locations across the US and Europe.

We value curiosity, creativity, collaboration, and expertise, continuously striving to push boundaries and exceed our clients' expectations. Join us to be part of a culture that drives meaningful results.

About The Opportunity

We are seeking a data analyst with a minimum of three years’ experience to clean, structure and process data from primary market research. An understanding of quantitative marketing research techniques, tools, processes, and procedures is preferred. Experience in primary market research is required. You must have strong interpersonal and organizational skills and be detail-oriented, flexible and above all, collaborative. The range of duties includes enforcing data quality control protocols, cleaning and structuring data sets, generating data cross tabulations and conducting a variety of analytical procedures.

In this role, you will be working closely with the Sr. Director of Custom Research, various Research Managers, the Director of Marketing Sciences, fellow Data Analysts and various Publishing department personnel.

What You'll Do


Clean and structure complex data sets in SPSS/alternate platforms, including AI-based apps
Analyze/interpret results using common statistical techniques in SPSS and other programs as assigned
Produce client-friendly data cross-tabulations in WinCross, JMP and alternate platforms, including our in-house survey platform, MarketOnce
Perform various quality assurance tasks, including QA on in-progress surveys
Develop and maintain databases/data systems
Develop new process improvements as necessary


What We’re Looking For


3+ years of relevant experience as a data analyst/data processor with a track record of high performance
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to plan, prioritize, manage, and effectively deliver on multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment
Understanding of market research processes highly desired
Strong knowledge of and experience with statistical packages for analyzing large datasets, specifically, SPSS, R, WinCross and/or Excel
Knowledge of Python, Javascript and/or XML helpful but not required provided you can demonstrate an understanding of survey logic and the potential to acquire the necessary expertise
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
BS or MS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics
Superior customer focus, and willingness to work evenings and weekends if needed to support our clients
A can-do, positive and collaborative attitude, with a willingness to support the development of team members across the organization


What We Offer


Competitive base salary: $72,000-$90,000/year
Flexible vacation policy – take the time you need to recharge
Comprehensive health, vision & dental insurance
401k with company contribution
Beautiful downtown Denver office with company-paid commuter benefits (parking or RTD/MBTA Pass)
Opportunity for career progression with plenty of room for personal growth


What To Expect


1st Round: 30-45 minute interview with the Recruiter
2nd Round: 60-minute interview with the Hiring Manager
3rd Round: 2 hours of onsite interviews with the Hiring Team


Please note that we are fully onsite work environment, and require daily presence at our LoDo/Union Station (Denver) or Back Bay (Boston) office. We are not considering remote, hybrid, or out-of-area candidates, and do not work with outside recruiting agencies.

MarketOnce will accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis.

MarketOnce is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We are committed to hiring individuals based on their skills and qualifications, regardless of race, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic. We welcome and encourage applications from all backgrounds.

TJX Companies

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description


This is a HYBRID role, with weekly in-person office days required.


The Opportunity: Grow Your Career.

This role is responsible for delivering actionable insights through advanced analytics and reporting to support business decision-making. The Senior Analyst partners with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business needs, translate requirements into scalable reporting solutions, and drive continuous improvement in data, reporting, and analytics capabilities.

Business Partnership


Partner with Merchandising, Planning, Finance, DC, Logistics teams to understand business needs and translate them into analytics and reporting solutions
Manage and prioritize reporting requests, identifying opportunities to leverage existing solutions vs. new builds
Communicate insights clearly to stakeholders and tailor outputs to support effective decision-making


Analytics & Insights


Analyze large and complex data sets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities impacting merchandise flow and operational performance
Apply strong critical thinking and business acumen to validate outputs and proactively identify areas requiring deeper analysis


Reporting & Dashboard Development


Leverage BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel, Fabric, Snowflake) to develop data models, visualizations, and reporting
Identify opportunities to standardize and streamline reporting processes to improve efficiency
Explore and prototype new analytics tools and technologies to enhance reporting capabilities
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements to increase efficiency and scalability


What We Are Looking For: You.


3–5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or reporting (retail, supply chain, or operations preferred)
Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or related field preferred
Strong communication and interpersonal skills; ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional partners
Strong analytical skills with ability to synthesize large volumes of data into meaningful insights
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with Power BI, Snowflake, Alteryx/Fabric, or similar BI tools preferred
Experience building dashboards, reports, and automated reporting solutions
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time management skills; ability to manage multiple priorities

Title: Sr. Marketing Analyst
Description:
About Us

Founded in 1992 in Dover, NH, Planet Fitness is one of the largest and fastest-growing franchisors and operators of fitness centers in the world by number of members and locations. As of March 31, 2026, Planet Fitness had approximately 21.5 million members and 2,909 clubs in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Canada, Panama, Mexico, Australia and Spain. The Company’s mission is to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment, which we call the Judgement Free Zone®. Approximately 90% of Planet Fitness clubs are owned and operated by independent business owners.

At Planet Fitness, our unique mission has always been to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment. And we’re proud of the amazing Planet Fitness team that supports our clubs and team members. They are comprised of dynamic, dedicated, and talented individuals who represent our values of integrity, transparency, passion, respect, and excellence (while having fun!) in everything they do.

Joining the PF family means being part of a company that cares about bettering the health and wellbeing of our communities. It means being a part of a supportive, engaging workforce with an inclusive culture that values diversity and creates an environment where everyone can feel they belong. It means encouraging professional growth and development. It means making true, lasting connections with your co-workers with celebrations, team building activities and engaging corporate events! It means creating a positive impact in our local communities through our Judgement Free Generation® philanthropic initiative. It means being part of a brand that you can be proud of!

For the past 30 years, we’ve helped millions of people in their fitness journey and revolutionized the industry along the way. And we’re just getting started!




Overview

Reporting to the Director, Marketing Analytics & Data Science, the Senior Marketing Analyst is responsible for supporting marketing strategy and business decision-making through data analysis, performance measurement, experimentation, and reporting.

This role partners with Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Technology to evaluate marketing performance, measure campaign effectiveness, and deliver actionable insights that drive member growth, engagement, and marketing effectiveness.

The Senior Marketing Analyst will analyze marketing and member performance, develop insights that drive strategic marketing decisions, build/support dashboards and KPI reporting, design and support experimentation and measurement initiatives, and provide senior leaders with clear insights through skilled data-driven story telling.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities, marketing business acumen, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for translating complex data into compelling, actionable insights and strategies.

This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires regular, in-person work at our Boston, MA or Hampton, NH office. Our hybrid model is M/T/W in office and TH/F are optional work-from-home. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of one of these locations. Fully remote work is not available for this role.




Responsibilities

Marketing Analytics & Performance Measurement

Analyzes marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital channels, campaigns, and member engagement initiatives
Drives measurement of marketing initiatives through KPI development, reporting, trend analysis, and performance insights
Develops analytical recommendations that identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes
Supports testing and measurement initiatives including campaign analysis, segmentation, and performance evaluations
Develops and maintains dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and analytical tools that provide visibility into marketing performance
Monitors key performance indicators, identify trends, and communicate insights to business stakeholders
Ensures data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting and analysis.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Co-owns the design, development, and execution of marketing insights and measurement strategy with Marketing Team counterparts
Partners with Strategy, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to support business initiatives through data analysis
Translates analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences
Supports ad hoc analyses and business requests related to marketing performance, member growth, and strategic initiatives.




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
3+ years of experience in marketing analytics, customer analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, marketing science, or a related analytical discipline
Demonstrated experience partnering with Marketing and business leaders to deliver analytics, reporting, and actionable recommendations that influence strategic and operational decisions
Experience analyzing marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, campaign effectiveness, and customer engagement
Strong understanding of marketing measurement methodologies, including attribution, A/B testing, incrementality, customer segmentation, and marketing ROI
Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, reporting solutions, and self-service analytics that improve visibility into business performance
Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize large, complex datasets into clear business insights and recommendations
Proficiency with SQL and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar reporting platforms
Experience working with modern analytics and marketing platforms such as Snowflake, Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics, CRM platforms, or similar technologies
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and recommend data-driven solutions
Extremely detail-oriented, efficient, and organized with an exceptional ability to establish priorities and objectives
Excellent presentation and written and oral communication skills along with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization
Able to establish and maintain effective, collaborative work relationships with diverse individuals, internally and externally
Dedicated learner with a natural curiosity for consistent growth
Cooperative team player with an upbeat, positive, “can-do” attitude!

Perks

Planet Fitness cares about you and your well-being. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees which includes the core medical, dental, vision, life and disability as well as supplemental accident, hospital and critical illness coverage options. In addition, we are proud to offer eligible employees a generous time off program (including volunteer time), childcare reimbursement, paid parental leave, pet care reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, free Black Card membership, learning and development programs and a whole host of engagement activities. We offer a 401(k) Plan with safe harbor employer matching and an employee stock purchase plan. This role is also eligible to participate in an annual corporate bonus incentive program based on company financial and personal performance.

The salary for MA-based and NH-based employees hired into this role will be aligned with the range below. This is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with a candidate’s professional experience, qualifications and internal equity.

Annual Base Salary Range: $110,000-$135,000




Note to Applicants: We have been made aware of an increasing number of hiring fraud schemes across numerous platforms. Planet Fitness never requires advance payments of any kind for computer equipment or any other purpose at the start of employment. Any request for you to provide payment information during the application process is part of a fraud scheme. Further, we recommend that you do not provide sensitive personal information (SSN, DOB, driver’s license number) as part of the initial application process.

Title: Associate Data Scientist
Description:
Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As Our Business Continues To Expand, There Is Growing Demand For More Data Science Team Members. We Are Hiring 4-6 People To Drive Impact In These Areas


Growth Marketing
Product Development
AI & Automation
Strategic Partnerships


On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here


No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.
Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.


What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.


Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.
Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.
Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.


Who You Are


First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"
Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.
Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.


What You'll Bring


1+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.
Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.
Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.
Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.


Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at recruiting@jerry.ai
