Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and have been profitable since 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We are a remote-first company, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Remote)
Description:
The Senior Data Analyst will help build trusted Finance data products and expand self-service analytics across FP&A. Working within the enterprise architecture and standards established by Shared Data Services, this role will translate Finance needs into scalable data solutions, validate and operationalize delivered assets, and directly build data models, transformations, pipelines, and dashboards when needed.

This is a highly technical individual-contributor role combining hands-on SQL and Python development, advanced analytics, data quality, business intelligence, and stakeholder partnership. The role will help Finance move from manual and fragmented analysis toward reusable data products that support driver-based forecasting, portfolio performance analysis, ad hoc decision support, and executive reporting.

Primary Responsibilities

Build Trusted Finance Data Products


Build, enhance, and maintain Finance tables, views, transformations, pipelines, and analytical models within established enterprise architecture, security, development, and governance standards.
Develop reusable data products supporting bookings, customers, billing, revenue, operational activity, and portfolio performance.
Use SQL and Python to automate data preparation, validation, and analytical workflows, and convert repeatable analyses into scalable assets.
Apply appropriate source control, testing, deployment, monitoring, and documentation practices to Finance data products.


Partner, Validate, and Operationalize


Translate FP&A and Portfolio Analytics needs into clear source requirements, data grain, business rules, transformation logic, quality controls, and acceptance criteria.
Own Finance requirements, prioritization, validation, and acceptance for data products delivered in partnership with onshore and offshore Shared Data Services teams.
Reconcile outputs to source systems, financial reporting, operational reporting, and approved methodologies; identify and resolve data quality issues, logic gaps, hierarchy problems, and incomplete coverage.
Maintain documentation for metric definitions, data lineage, business rules, assumptions, and known limitations, and coordinate issue resolution through Finance sign-off.


Deliver Advanced Analytics and Self-Service


Use SQL, Python, and appropriate analytical methods to solve complex customer, revenue, pricing, forecasting, portfolio, and operational questions.
Build semantic models, dashboards, and analytical tools using Power BI or a comparable enterprise business intelligence platform.
Enable FP&A users to independently answer recurring business questions with trusted data, reducing manual extracts, spreadsheet-based preparation, and one-off reporting.
Use approved AI-assisted development tools to improve coding, testing, documentation, and analytical productivity while validating outputs and protecting confidential data.


Education and Experience


Bachelor's degree in a technical, quantitative, analytical, Finance, or business discipline; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
Five or more years of relevant experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience independently delivering complex data and analytical solutions. Finance, FP&A, commercial analytics, or executive reporting experience is helpful but not required.


Required Qualifications


Advanced SQL and strong dimensional and analytical data-modeling skills.
Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and advanced analytics.
Experience developing or supporting ETL/ELT pipelines and reusable analytical datasets.
Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse environment.
Experience with data reconciliation, quality assurance, troubleshooting, and documentation.
Experience developing semantic models, dashboards, or business intelligence solutions.
Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into scalable analytical and technical solutions.
Familiarity with source control, testing, deployment, and production support practices.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services, including lakehouses, warehouses, notebooks, pipelines, or related analytical workloads.
Power BI experience, including semantic modeling and DAX.
Experience with Git, CI/CD, orchestration, monitoring, or production support.
Experience supporting Finance, FP&A, commercial analytics, or executive reporting.
Familiarity with forecasting, customer analytics, revenue analytics, or portfolio analytics.
Experience working with centralized or shared enterprise data teams.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to execute independently.
Consultative approach and the ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Strong attention to data accuracy, controls, validation, and methodological consistency.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, and deliverables with clear follow-through.
Curiosity, sound judgment, and a bias toward action and iterative delivery.
Ability to learn new technologies, data sources, and business concepts quickly.


Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.EEO/AA/Minorities/Females/Disabled/Vets.

Title: HR Platform Data Analyst - WORKDAY HCM
Description:
To meet the challenges of the university’s continued growth and expansion, the HR Platforms (HRIT) team is looking for a qualified candidate who will contribute to the support and data analytics of Workday HCM.




***HYBRID _Required to be ON CAMPUS in BOSTON Mon, Tues, Thurs, Fri (Wed is remote).




The HR Platforms (HRIT) Reporting & Data Analyst serves as a key data and reporting resource within HR Platforms, partnering with HR functional areas, Payroll, Finance, and college/division HR stakeholders to understand complex business requirements and deliver accurate, meaningful workforce data and analytics.




This role requires a strong understanding of Workday HCM and Payroll business processes, particularly within the complexities of a decentralized higher education environment with diverse employee populations, organizational structures, and business practices.




The Reporting & Data Analyst translates business needs into effective reporting and analytical solutions, developing and maintaining Workday reports, SQL queries, and other data solutions. The role analyzes complex datasets to identify trends, discrepancies, anomalies, and data integrity issues; investigates root causes; and provides insights that support operational and strategic decision-making.




This position also partners closely with HR Platforms Business Systems Analysts and other technical and functional teams to test, validate, and resolve data and reporting issues.




Success in this role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, expert proficiency in Excel, proficiency in SQL, attention to detail, and a naturally curious mindset. The successful candidate will be comfortable asking questions, challenging data that does not appear correct, investigating complex issues, and translating analytical findings into clear, actionable information for both technical and non-technical audiences. The role requires sound judgment, initiative, strong customer service skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines in a high-volume environment while maintaining confidentiality and the highest standards of data integrity.




Key responsibilities include:

· Partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, and college/division HR stakeholders to understand complex business requirements and translate data needs into accurate, sustainable reporting and analytical solutions.

· Develop, maintain, and enhance reports and queries using Workday HCM/Payroll, Prism, SQL, Excel, and other reporting and analytical tools.

· Analyze and reconcile complex HR and Payroll datasets to identify trends, anomalies, discrepancies, and data integrity issues and investigate root causes.

· Collaborate with HR Platforms Business Systems Analysts and other technical and functional partners on requirements, testing, validation, system changes, and resolution of data and reporting issues.




To support the University's essential services and business operations, this position may occasionally be required to work outside of regular business hours, including during critical system activities, reporting deadlines, or other periods of operational need.




Minimum Qualifications




Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Human Resources, Data Analytics, or a related field required.
3–5 years of progressive experience in HR data analytics, HR systems, reporting, or a related field, with demonstrated experience analyzing complex HR and payroll data.
Strong understanding of Workday HCM and Payroll business processes, including the ability to understand how transactions, business processes, organizational structures, compensation, time, absence, payroll, and employee lifecycle events impact downstream data and reporting.
Experience with Workday reporting across HCM and Payroll, including developing, maintaining, interpreting, and troubleshooting reports and identifying opportunities to improve reporting accuracy and effectiveness.
Higher education HR and Payroll experience is strongly preferred, with an understanding of the unique organizational structures, academic populations, employee types, appointments, positions, grants/funding, faculty/staff populations, and other complexities common to higher education.

Title: Marketing Analyst
Description:
The primary role of this individual will be to build, enhance, and maintain a business intelligence platform to support business intelligence and advanced analytics requirements. The selected candidate will engage with our business and operations teams from initial project definition through to project completion and will engage on multiple projects. Primary responsibilities will include the development of reporting and analytical solutions, a full suite of documentation, as well as some light application updates to enable such solutions.

Deliverables include company reporting and dashboard solutions, documentation, light application enhancements, and custom analysis. The results of your work will allow us to streamline our reporting operations and enable the generation of new insights that will allow us to transform our Analytics & Insights efforts to support business strategy, as well as marketing and operations.

What You'll Do:
Analyze complex datasets, extracted using SQL, to deliver actionable insights for the Lottery’s digital initiatives to drive good business decisions
Analyze and benchmark performance across multiple channels and platforms, and provide recommendations for areas of future growth
Analyze CRM bonus campaign performance and provide recommendations for the generation of new campaigns
Perform industry monitoring and reporting to keep the management team well informed of interactive market trends and innovations
Elicit analytical and reporting requirements from the Lottery and work with Product Owners to ensure the requirements are delivered
Attend the Lottery meetings and internal meetings to stay informed of new requests, features, and improvement areas, and provide support when necessary
Attend training and conferences as necessary to build knowledge and refine skills
Coordinate projects or requirement elicitation between the Lottery and vendors, when assigned


What We're Looking For:
3+ years of experience working within a Marketing Analytics/Business Analytics environment, with a focus on strategy, operations, and marketing data analysis
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience with a focus in Business, Marketing, or Economics preferred
Knowledge of SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) with writing complex SQL Queries
Advanced Excel (Power Pivot, Power View, Power Query, Pivot Tables, Lookups, etc.)
Expertise in gathering and documenting internal and external client requirements
Expertise in analyzing complex data sets and converting them into actionable insights, which drives business decisions
Experience in ensuring data integrity and validating results, with high attention to detail and accuracy
Support, advise, and collaborate to deliver ad-hoc reports and data, as necessary to meet the needs of the department
Experience with the Power BI reporting tools.
Capable of investigating, familiarizing, and mastering new data sets quickly
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong problem-solving skills
Motivated individual with technical-functional expertise who can collaborate with both business and technology teams
Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to work independently
Gaming analysis experience preferred but not required


Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Title: Data Analyst - Power BI
Description:
Piper Companies is seeking a Data Analyst to join a mission‑driven Digital Transformation team focused on reshaping how patients and providers interact through innovative digital solutions. This role plays a key part in enabling data‑driven decision making by transforming complex data into actionable insights that drive operational efficiency, product performance, and meaningful business outcomes. This position is fully remote, with occasional travel for team‑building on client site.

Overview

In this role, you will partner with product, clinical, operational, and analytics stakeholders to understand business objectives, prepare and model data, and deliver reporting that clearly communicates progress toward key product goals. You will support the development of KPIs, build Power BI dashboards, and provide analytical insights that guide product and operational decisions. You will work under the supervision of the Sr. Director of Data & Analytics and collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams across the organization.

Identify, define, and document key performance metrics for digital products, ensuring consistent and repeatable KPI definitions.
Clean, model, and prepare data from the enterprise data warehouse and other primary sources using SQL, Python/Pandas, and Databricks.
Develop, maintain, and optimize Power BI dashboards and visualizations that clearly communicate product performance to stakeholders.
Respond to ad‑hoc reporting requests by gathering and analyzing data to answer business and operational questions.
Communicate analytical findings through clear written summaries, presentations, and discussions with product, clinical, and operational teams.
Collaborate with data scientists and analytics staff to operationalize data workflows and support modeling efforts.
Partner with product teams to understand business needs, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide data‑driven recommendations.
Participate in departmental meetings, cross‑functional committees, and quality/service improvement initiatives.
Adhere to departmental policies, procedures, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
Perform additional duties as assigned.


Qualifications

Education & Training


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.


Experience


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis or a related field.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Strong data modeling and analysis skills, including experience with Databricks, Python/Pandas, and SQL.
Proficiency working with large relational databases (Microsoft SQL Server preferred).
Experience with version control tools such as GitHub or Azure DevOps.
Advanced Power BI skills, including building dashboards, visuals, and DAX measures.
Strong Excel proficiency.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights for diverse audiences.


Compensation & Benefits

Work Environment: Fully remote with occasional travel for team‑building.
Comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO, holidays, and sick leave as required by law.

Ambulatory, acute & post-acute quality, clinical performance, and operations reporting & analysis

Job Summary

The Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) is seeking experienced candidates for a Data Analyst IV - Advanced Analytics & Reporting position within Access & Eligibility Services (AES), Data Management & Reporting team. The position supports HHSC’s mission to connect Texans to essential services by delivering advanced analytics, ensuring data quality, and providing operational decision support to internal teams.

Data Analyst IV functions as a senior individual contributor and hybrid analyst/mentor. The role performs complex analytical work under minimal supervision, applies independent judgment, mentors and reviews the work of other analysts, and delivers clear, actionable insights to non‑technical stakeholders. These positions do not have formal supervisory authority.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

Advanced Analytics & Insight Generation (30%)


Performs advanced SQL analysis to identify trends, patterns, and performance drivers.
Develops predictive and trend analyses to support operational planning and proactive decision‑making.
Translates complex analyses into clear findings and actionable recommendations for internal stakeholders.
Creates reusable analytical methods and standardized approaches to improve efficiency and consistency.


Data Quality & Validation (25%)


Designs and executes data validation, reconciliation, and quality audits across SQL Server, Oracle, and Snowflake.
Establishes and documents data quality rules, business definitions, and acceptance criteria.
Partners with business and technical teams to resolve data quality issues and prevent recurrence.
Monitors key data quality indicators and supports continuous improvement efforts.


Operational Decision Support & Reporting (20%)


Develops and maintains Power BI semantic models, dashboards, and reports tailored to business needs.
Provides clear data narratives, briefings, and written summaries in plain language.
Implements Power Automate workflows to streamline recurring reporting and operational processes.
Supports self‑service analytics while ensuring usability, accuracy, and performance.


Data Pipelines & Performance (15%)


Designs, optimizes, and troubleshoots ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple data platforms.
Collaborates with peers on data modeling and performance tuning.
Contributes to future‑state analytics solutions, including readiness for Databricks adoption.


Mentorship & Peer Review (10%)


Mentors and reviews the work of lower‑level data analysts.
Shares best practices for SQL, data modeling, validation, visualization, and documentation.
Assists with onboarding and skill development for analysts within the team.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities (KSAs)


Skill in advanced proficiency in SQL, including complex queries, window functions, and performance tuning.
Skills in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, and dashboard development.
Skill in designing and supporting ETL/ELT data pipelines.
Skill in using Power Automate to support operational workflows.
Strong understanding of data quality, validation, reconciliation, and documentation practices.
Ability to perform predictive and trend analysis aligned with business needs.
Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to non‑technical audiences.
Demonstrated accuracy, attention to detail, data integrity, curiosity, and problem‑solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with business analysts, developers, and program staff.
Ability to exercise independent judgment and work effectively with minimal supervision.
Ability to perform predictive or trend analysis in an operational or program environment.
Knowledge of health and human services or government/public sector settings.
Knowledge in working with Snowflake and cross‑platform SQL environments (SQL Server and Oracle).
Skilled with R, Python, SPSS, and advanced Excel.


Registrations, Licensure Requirements, or Certifications


Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL‑300) – Preferred
Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP‑600) – Preferred
Microsoft Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL‑200) – Preferred
Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) – Preferred
IIBA Certification in Business Data Analytics (CBDA) – Preferred
DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) – Preferred


Initial Screening Criteria


Two (2) years of professional experience as a data analyst performing advanced SQL analysis, data transformation, advanced reporting (Power BI or Tableau), and data quality validation.
Minimum of four (4) years of relevant professional experience.


Additional Information


This position is 100% remote within the State of Texas.
Candidates must reside in the State of Texas by their official start date.
Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
Employees must maintain reliable internet connectivity and webcam capability during work hours.
Selected applicants must pass a background check and other required due diligence.

Title: Principal Data Analyst

Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.

Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

Role Overview
The Principal Data Analyst will play a key role in executing Filevine’s data and analytics initiatives. Reporting directly to executive leadership, this individual will manage daily analytics operations, deliver corporate metrics, and produce actionable insights to support operational excellence and strategic decision-making across the organization. This position requires a balance of strong technical proficiency, business acumen, and solid communication skills.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on analytical practitioner who can design and deliver high-quality analyses while engaging confidently with executive stakeholders.

Responsibilities:


Work closely with the CEO on ad-hoc or other impromptu projects, providing rapid analytical support and insights.
Lead daily operations for the corporate analytics function, overseeing the development and delivery of executive-level dashboards, KPIs, and routine reporting.
Partner with functional leaders to identify and interpret key trends across product usage, customer health, financial performance, and organizational initiatives.
Conduct complex analyses that inform strategic priorities and operational decisions.
Build and maintain robust data pipelines and models within Domo, integrating data from Salesforce, Snowflake, HubSpot, the Filevine Platform, and other enterprise systems.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and precision across all reporting outputs.
Implement frameworks for tracking key SaaS metrics and KPIs, including ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, customer engagement, and retention.
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex data into actionable business insights.
Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Product, and Customer Success teams to align analytics outputs with organizational goals.





Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, or a related field.
4–6+ years of experience in data analytics or business intelligence, with experience leading ad-hoc projects.
Demonstrated ability to guide projects and support team development.
Expertise in SQL and hands-on experience working with large, complex data environments.
Strong proficiency with Domo or equivalent BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
Solid understanding of Salesforce data structures and data integration practices.
Familiarity with SaaS business models and key financial metrics.
Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively present insights to senior stakeholders.
High attention to detail, with a commitment to accuracy, data governance, and analytical rigor.





Work Location Expectation: This position is based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Salt Lake City or New York offices. Candidates residing in or near these metro areas are expected to work on a hybrid (2-3 days in-office/week) or fully onsite basis.

A dynamic, rapidly growing company, focused on helping organizations thrive
Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (for full-time employees)
Competitive & Fair Pay
Maternity & paternity leave (for full-time employees)
Short & long-term disability
Opportunity to learn from a dedicated leadership team
Top-of-the-line company swag

Description:
***An English version will follow***




À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.

About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.




What We Offer

** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
A MacBook computer on your first day.
3 weeks vacation.
5 personal days to use at your discretion.
A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.




About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.




Key Responsibilities

Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
Special projects, and other duties as required.




Candidate Qualifications

Strong problem solving skills.
2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
Understanding of statistical principles.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Fully bilingual in English and French.
Ability to coordinate across teams.




Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

Title: Data Analyst - Servicing Operations
Description:
As a Data Analyst for Rocket Loans, you'll be a strategic partner to our leadership, collecting, analyzing, and reporting on data that drives operational excellence. You'll work closely with our Senior Data Analyst leadership to support operations, call center, and servicing reporting needs ultimately enabling our team leaders to make data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency and performance. You'll use a range of tools and methodologies, including statistics, technical expertise, and modern data platforms, to generate actionable insights and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. As a storyteller, you'll collect data from various sources to guide strategic decisions and support our transition to advanced analytics platforms.

About The Role


Identify and communicate patterns in operations and call center data in response to business needs using data manipulation, statistics, and data visualization
Create and support business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, reports, and methods with a focus on operations/servicing metrics and call center activity
Use data to support and challenge business solutions with stakeholders, particularly operations and collections teams
Identify, document, and use exploratory data analysis to investigate assumptions around operational performance and team efficiency
Maintain strong relationships and alignment among operations stakeholders to meet reporting and analytical objectives
Define, gather, and validate data requirements; evaluate and ensure data quality standards are met
Develop and maintain KPIs and metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Support the team's transition to Sigma as our primary reporting and visualization platform
Stay proactive and strategic—identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting before being asked
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in operations, call center management, and data analytics


About You

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology, or a related field
3+ years of experience using SQL or other querying languages to create and analyze data sets in a business setting
Experience creating KPIs/metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools
Experience executing end-to-end data analysis projects in a business environment
Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences
Working knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory, and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
Conceptual knowledge of software programming fundamentals


Preferred Qualifications


Domain expertise in operations/call center reporting and supporting operations teams with collections and call center activity metrics
Exceptional communication skills and ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders
Proven track record in data quality management and establishing data governance practices
Strategic, proactive mindset allowing you to identify opportunities and propose solutions rather than waiting for requests
Databricks SQL experience
Sigma experience for reporting and visualization
AI utilization experience and understanding of AI applications for use cases in business analytics
AWS experience


What You’ll Get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

About Us

Headquartered in Detroit, Rocket Loans was established to create the most simple, rocket fast personal loan process. We assembled a top-notch team of individuals combining new, passionate team members with some of the best veterans from Rocket Mortgage to create the most user-friendly lending platform in the world. We have given it our best to create an experience that is best-of-breed in the personal loan industry and commit even more to continuously improving it. At Rocket Loans, you’ll build a career that helps you achieve your professional goals while helping clients get the loans they need to reach their financial goals. We’re looking for innovators and those unafraid to disrupt the status -quo. With an inclusive culture and opportunities to make a positive impact, we’re here to help you foster your career growth.

Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

The direct measurability of digital media.
Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

 

Job Category

In this role you will become an expert on optimal performance and strategy of digital marketing campaigns. You will work with fellow analysts to analyze, conjecture, and manage investigations, product fixes, and optimizations to increase our yield and support our relationships with Media Partners.

You will be required to develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions. You will be required to develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making. You will need to leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment.

You will be expected to delve into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth. You will be a locus for understanding advantages, weaknesses, and deploying creative approaches to analytical problems; you will be expected to communicate these insights in an effective and timely manner, responding to the analytical needs of the business, and delivering actionable plans for improving our business.

Develop a deep understanding of the related data sources and leverage them to inform business decisions
Develop a deep understanding of our analytical tools and the automation of business processes and decision-making
Leverage diverse problem solving strategies and balance multiple simultaneous efforts in a dynamic and high velocity environment
Dive into business problems and analyze opportunities for growth
You will be a locus for understanding advantages, weaknesses, and deploying creative approaches to analytical problems
Communicate these insights in an effective and timely manner, responding to the analytical needs of the business, and delivering actionable plans for improving our business.

Requirements

3+years of experience in an analytical role is required
Inquisitive mindset that is willing to challenge status quo and various stakeholders
Ability to digest disparate datasets and visualize key trends or takeaways from raw datasets
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to synthesize key takeaways and present data-proven results
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills including abnormality detection, predictive analysis, market segmentation, and competitive analysis.
Experience in using SQL with enterprise datasets is required
Experience in R or Python is required
Experience with Tableau or other related Business Intelligence Tool is required
Experience with automation in an enterprise setting is a major place

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Position Highlights

As a Data Analyst II within the Enterprise Data & Analytics team, you will play a key role in advancing the university's data-informed culture by supporting strategic and operational analytics initiatives. In this position, you will work across the full data lifecycle, including data acquisition, validation, transformation, analysis, reporting, and visualization to deliver actionable insights for campus partners.

Partnering with stakeholders across the university, you will translate business needs into meaningful data products, dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions that support institutional effectiveness and strategic decision-making. This role is ideal for a curious, collaborative professional who is passionate about leveraging data to solve complex problems, uncover opportunities, and tell compelling stories through analytics.

This position offers a hybrid work arrangement, with weekly on-campus presence required.

Enterprise Data & Analytics

The Enterprise Data & Analytics team is dedicated to connecting people, data, and technology to deliver trusted insights that empower informed decision-making across the university. Through modern data management, analytics, reporting, and governance practices, the team supports institutional priorities and advances the university's strategic goals.

Working collaboratively with partners across campus, the department develops and maintains data solutions that enhance transparency, improve operational effectiveness, and enable evidence-based planning and decision-making. The team is committed to fostering a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and responsible data stewardship in support of the university's mission.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities


Identifies and assesses requirements to develop data files and reports using query tools
Monitors and coordinates mass data uploads and exports. Maintains databases for tracking information. Consolidates data from multiple sources, interprets data, and generates ongoing reports
Troubleshoots processing errors and makes changes /corrections independently. Assists in developing new processes to respond to issues that deviate from standard operating procedures
Supports, designs, develops, and/or maintains studies, presentations, analytics, reports, and dashboards that support institutional goals, planning, and strategic decision making
Aggregates, manipulates, and analyzes large data structures. Summarizes and communicates information using a variety of graphical and tabular formats and media
Creates and maintains data files in accordance with RIT information security standards and data management best practices
Other duties as assigned


Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities


Knowledge of data visualization tools and best practices for creating dashboards and interactive reports
Knowledge of database systems and query languages for data manipulation and retrieval
Skill in analyzing and interpreting large, complex datasets to generate actionable insights
Skill in consulting with stakeholders to define data requirements and deliver tailored analytics solutions
Ability to collect, organize, analyze and disseminate information with attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to communicate findings effectively through well-structured visuals and narratives tailored to target audiences


Minimum Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in related field
3 years of related experience
Equivalent combination of experience & education may be considered


Job Level Overview

Specialized Contributor Level 2 - A fully functional role requiring established knowledge of the profession or field of work. Responsible for completing substantive assignments and projects. Problems are varied and non-routine, and resolution requires exercising judgment, analysis, advisement, creativity, and understanding broader sets of issues. Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
About Us

TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.

We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview

TRC’s Advanced Energy Strategic Deployment team is seeking a Data Analyst II to support data management, analysis, and reporting across strategic projects that advance the energy sector. The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing metrics and building reports for a variety of projects, with the knowledge and expertise to create, edit, and modify data sets and produce accurate, timely, and clear analytics for the team and our clients.

The ideal candidate is an independent, detail-oriented contributor with a positive attitude who excels at multitasking while maintaining a high degree of accuracy, efficiency, and reliability. They will bring curiosity about emerging tools—including AI—and a desire to apply data analytics, visualization, and geospatial techniques to real-world advanced energy challenges. A sufficient understanding of the energy industry to interpret the data required for the position is preferred.

Why Consider This Job Opportunity?


Advance your career through ongoing learning and development
Maintain a healthy work-life balance with supportive policies
Collaborate within an inclusive and respectful team environment
Contribute to a rapidly expanding and future-focused industry
Support impactful projects driving the clean energy transition


Responsibilities


Provide valuable insight to program teams based on the data collected, enabling informed decision-making.
Build and maintain customized dashboards and reporting for clients, subcontractors, management, and cross-functional team members in our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) database.
Sort through and interpret high quantities of data, identifying, diagnosing, and correcting discrepancies to ensure accuracy.
Develop data models through reporting and visualization to support decision-making.
Monitor and report program key performance metrics and provide updates to management.
Support program platform tasks, including configuration, dashboards, and data import/export as directed.
Provide input for troubleshooting, process improvements, automation, and system enhancements.
Research and present market intelligence and customer trends to support strategic advanced energy projects.
Explore and pilot AI-enabled and geospatial (GIS) approaches to streamline data-intensive processes and enhance analysis.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Geography/GIS, Engineering, Environmental Studies, a related field, or equivalent experience.
3+ years of experience performing data analysis and using tools to create reports, dashboards, and data exploration.
Residency in the Denver, Colorado area preferred.
Advanced computer skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams); advanced Excel skills preferred.
Experience with data analysis and visualization software (e.g., Power BI, SQL, Tableau, R, or Python).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong time-management skills, and attention to detail.
Ability to contribute to multiple projects simultaneously with demonstrated accuracy and reliability.
Experience applying AI / machine-learning tools to data analysis, automation, or reporting.
Strong Power BI development skills (data modeling, DAX, interactive dashboards).
Microsoft Enterprise ecosystem experience, including Microsoft Dynamics (a plus), Power Platform, and SharePoint.
ArcGIS / Esri experience for spatial data creation, analysis, and visualization.
Additional data analytics skills such as SQL, Python, R, or data-pipeline/API integration.
Ability to multitask, prioritize, and self-direct across many concurrent stretch assignments in a high-paced, high-accountability environment with minimal oversight.
Strong interest or experience supporting projects in the energy space, such as energy efficiency (EE), demand response (DR), distributed energy resource management systems (DERMS), or similar utility/clean-energy projects.


Benefits*: TRC offers a competitive benefit package consisting of:


Medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance.
401k package that includes both traditional and Roth IRA options and Company match.
Paid time off contingent upon full time or part time status and level of seniority (ranging from 15 to 25 days per year).
All full-time employees enjoy a minimum of 8 Paid Holidays per year.
TRC ensures that all employees, including those that work part-time, receive paid sick, family, and disability leave in accordance with the laws of their state of residence.
These benefits are applicable to US employees depending on their employment status (full time, part time, or temporary). TRC offers jurisdiction specific benefit packages for International and Puerto Rico employees.


Compensation: In accordance with local law, the below salary range is applicable for the job and location associated with this requisition. Compensation will vary based upon experience, education, skill level, geographical location, and other compensable factors.

Other Compensation: Employee may be eligible for participation in the Company’s annual Discretionary Bonus Program which is contingent on Company, Business Segment, and Individual performance against Key Performance Indicators which vary by year and employee.

Disclaimers

TRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The complete job description and application are available on TRC’s career site.

TRC accepts applications for this position on an ongoing, rolling basis and reserves the right to cancel this posting at any time.

Salary Range

USD $70,586.88 - USD $85,000.00 /Yr.

Title: Data Analyst, Administration & Finance
Description:
Pay Range

The UMass President’s Office expects to pay within an approximate hiring range between $60,000 - $75,000 for this position. The specific pay for this position will be determined by the University based on consideration of all relevant factors when and if it decides to extend an offer of employment.

Primary Work Location:

Westborough, MA. Hybrid schedule.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President of Administration & Finance Support Services (Access) Team, the Data Analyst is responsible for developing analysis, reporting, and dashboard capabilities that support operational and strategic decision-making across Administration & Finance.

The Data Analyst will collaborate with data and analytics professionals across the Administration & Finance function, as well as product owners/stakeholders, and A&F leadership, to understand business requirements and translate them into effective analytics solutions. The position will monitor data quality and performance, validate data for accuracy and consistency, and identify opportunities to strengthen reporting processes and controls.

Working closely with IT and other technical partners, the Data Analyst will support the development of data models and the automation of data workflows and reporting processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and reliability. The position is also responsible for designing and developing intuitive, insightful dashboards, reports, and presentations that effectively communicate key performance indicators (KPIs), trends, and actionable insights to stakeholders and leadership.

Essential Functions


Design, develop, maintain, and enhance interactive dashboards and data visualizations that effectively communicate key metrics, trends, and insights.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities, and translate findings into meaningful and actionable insights.
Acquire, integrate, and prepare data from multiple sources for analysis and reporting.
Perform data validation and quality assurance to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data; investigate discrepancies and collaborate with IT and other technical partners to resolve data issues.
Develop and maintain KPI calculations, business rules, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistent and accurate reporting.
Identify opportunities to streamline and automate data preparation, validation, and recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across Administration & Finance to understand business requirements and develop appropriate analytical solutions.
Conduct ad hoc analyses and prepare reports, presentations, and analytical summaries that clearly communicate findings to managers and leadership.
Maintain documentation of data sources, calculations, business rules, reporting processes, and identified data issues and resolutions.
Perform testing and validation of new data sources, data models, system enhancements, and reporting solutions to ensure accuracy and alignment with business requirements.
Perform other related duties and support special projects and initiatives as assigned.



Other Functions

Perform other duties as may be assigned.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education, Experience)


BS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics.
1-3 years' experience as a data analyst or business data analyst.
Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.
Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
Advanced skills in creating interactive and visually compelling dashboards and reports that communicate data insights and findings clearly to business stakeholders.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Power Query), Python, or R.
Knowledge of data governance, compliance, and reporting best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Adept at queries, report writing, and presenting findings.



Preferred Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education, Experience)


Master’s degree in a related field



Working Conditions


Hybrid work environment. Primarily located at the UMass President’s Office located at 50 Washington St., Westborough, MA with remote work.
Must be able to travel occasionally to all UMass campuses and the Boston central office.



Additional Details

All offers are contingent on the successful completion of a background check.

Title: Data Analyst - DDI Research and Innovations
Description:
Join Cleveland Clinic’s Main Campus where research and surgery are advanced, technology is leading-edge, patient care is world class and caregivers are family. Here, you will work alongside a passionate and dedicated team, receive endless support and appreciation, and build a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world.

As a Data Analyst for DDI Research and Innovations, you will provide operational and financial data and analysis to support informed management decision-making. In this role, you will export, clean, and pool data for investigators across the Institute, with a focus on five major projects: CIRA - AI Agent for DDI Clinical Research, CIRA - Evolution of Autoimmune Pancreatitis (AIP) Diagnosis and Treatment, CIRA - Patient Directed First Visit (PDFV), CIRA - AI-Enabled Communication of Endoscopy and Pathology Results in the HER, and CIRA - GI Quality & Continuity (GI-QC) Initiative. This position manages data requests and prepares data for statisticians, principal investigators (PIs), and data scientists.

A caregiver in this role works days from 8:00 a.m. -- 5:00 p.m.

A caregiver who excels in this role will:


Provide operational and financial data and analysis to support informed management decision-making.
Assist assigned department and leadership in obtaining information from various systems.
Establish and maintain detailed knowledge and documentation of all databases within the assigned department.
Analyze databases and provide timely responses to customer requests.
Provide database research and assist other analysts in completing requests.
Other duties as assigned.


Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:


Bachelor’s degree in a related field and three years of professional analytical experience
OR High School Diploma and seven years of experience
OR Associate’s degree and five years of experience
OR Master’s degree and one year of experience
Experience with multiple software packages, including Microsoft Office, SQL, Visual Basic, and others
Analytical, organizational and project management skills
Ability to conduct complex analysis


Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:


Healthcare experience
Understanding of Snowflake
Epic healthcare data experience
Experience with Azure, GCP or Databricks


Physical Requirements:


Ability to perform work in a stationary position for extended periods
Ability to operate a computer and other office equipment
Ability to communicate and exchange accurate information
In some locations, ability to move up to 25 pounds


Personal Protective Equipment:


Follows standard precautions using personal protective equipment as required.


Pay Range

Minimum Annual Salary: $43,200.00

Maximum Annual Salary: $65,880.00

The pay range displayed does not include any applicable pay practices (e.g., shift differentials, overtime, etc.). The pay range does not include the value of Cleveland Clinic’s benefits package (e.g., healthcare, dental and vision benefits, retirement savings account contributions, etc.).
